editorialPolicy.meta.description: Otu Medsafar si ede, lelee ma melite ozi dị na weebụsaịtị a.
editorialPolicy.heading: Iwu ndezi
editorialPolicy.intro: Ndị ọrịa na-eme nnukwu mkpebi dabere n'ihe ha gụrụ. Nke a bụ otu anyị si ahụ na ihe anyị na-ebipụta doro anya, kwụ ọtọ ma zie ezie.
editorialPolicy.updated.label: Mmelite ikpeazụ
editorialPolicy.sections.0.heading: Okwu dị mfe
editorialPolicy.sections.0.body.0: Ozi ahụike bụ ibu ọrụ. Onye ọrịa ọ bụla kwesịrị inweta ozi ziri ezi, doro anya, dị mfe nghọta ma bụrụ nke a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi.
editorialPolicy.sections.0.body.1: Med Safar India kpebisiri ike inyere ndị ọrịa na ezinụlọ ha aka ịghọta nhọrọ ahụike na ịga njem ọgwụgwọ n'ugwu na nlekọta. Ihe anyị na-ede bụ iji nye ozi, kụzie ihe ma kwado mkparịta ụka ndị ọrịa ghọtara nke ọma ha na ndị ọkachamara ahụike tozuru etozu. Ọ gaghị amanye mmadụ ime mkpebi banyere ọgwụgwọ, ụlọ ọgwụ, dọkịta ma ọ bụ njem.
editorialPolicy.sections.0.body.2: Anyị na-ebute ọdịmma ndị ọrịa, eziokwu, ịdị n'ihu ọha, nzuzo na nkwurịta okwu kwụ ọtọ ụzọ karịa mmasị mgbasa ozi.
editorialPolicy.sections.1.heading: Dọkịta lelere ya
editorialPolicy.sections.1.body.0: Iwu a na-edobe ụkpụrụ maka ike, inyocha, ịkwado, ibipụta, ịkpọsa, imelite na imezi ihe Med Safar India ma ọ bụ ndị na-anọchite anya ya na-ewepụta.
editorialPolicy.sections.1.body.1: Ọ metụtara ihe niile na nkwurịta okwu niile anyị na-achịkwa, gụnyere:
editorialPolicy.sections.1.body.2: Peeji weebụsaịtị, nkọwa ọrụ, blọọgụ, edemede, ajụjụ a na-ajụkarị na ihe a pụrụ ibudata.
editorialPolicy.sections.1.body.3: Ozi soshal midia, reels, vidiyo, podcast, webinar, akwụkwọ akụkọ na mgbasa ozi email.
editorialPolicy.sections.1.body.4: Ngwugwu ozi ndị ọrịa, ntụziaka maka obodo a na-aga, nkọwa ọgwụgwọ na ozi tupu mbata.
editorialPolicy.sections.1.body.5: Ndepụta, nkọwa, ntụnyere na ajụjụ ọnụ banyere ụlọ ọgwụ, ndị dọkịta, ngalaba ọgwụ na ọgwụgwọ.
editorialPolicy.sections.1.body.6: Ozi nye ndị nta akụkọ, mgbasa ozi, broshuọ, ngosi na ihe e mere maka ndị mmekọ.
editorialPolicy.sections.1.body.7: Ihe ndị ọrụ, ndị ndụmọdụ, ụlọ ọrụ mgbasa ozi, ndị na-arụ ọrụ n'onwe ha, ndị na-akpali mmadụ n'ịntanetị (influencer) ma ọ bụ ndị nnọchite anya ndị ọzọ kwadoro maka Med Safar India.
editorialPolicy.sections.1.body.8: Ebe ọ bụ ụlọ ọgwụ, dọkịta ma ọ bụ onye mmekọ ọzọ kere ma ọ bụ na-achịkwa ihe ahụ, onye mmekọ ahụ ka na-aza maka okwu ọkachamara na ọgwụgwọ nke ya. Med Safar India agaghị ama ama bipụta ihe onye mmekọ dere nke megidere iwu a ma ọ bụ iwu metụtara ya.
editorialPolicy.sections.2.heading: Ebe e si nweta ya
editorialPolicy.sections.2.body.0: Med Safar India na-arụ ọrụ dị ka ọrụ nhazi ọgwụgwọ na nhazi njem ọgwụgwọ. Ọ gwụla ma e kwuru ya n'ụzọ ọzọ kpọmkwem, ọ bụghị ụlọ ọgwụ, klinik, ụlọ nyocha, dọkịta, ọrụ mberede ma ọ bụ onye na-enye nlekọta ọgwụgwọ.
editorialPolicy.sections.2.body.1: Ihe anyị na-ede nwere ike ịkọwa usoro ahụike ma nyere aka inweta ozi, oge nzukọ, izipu akwụkwọ, nhazi njem na enyemaka ndị ọzọ na-abụghị ọgwụgwọ. Anyị anaghị achọpụta ọrịa n'onwe anyị, edere ọgwụ, atụ aro ọgwụgwọ dochiri dọkịta, akọwa nsonaazụ nyocha dị ka ọkachamara na-agwọ gị, ma ọ bụ ekwe nkwa nsonaazụ ọgwụgwọ.
editorialPolicy.sections.2.body.2: Onye ọrịa ga-eme mkpebi ọgwụgwọ site n'ịgba ndị ọkachamara ahụike tozuru etozu ma debanye aha izu. A gaghị egosi ọrụ onye na-ahazi ọgwụgwọ dị ka mkpebi ahụike dọkịta kwụụrụ onwe ya.
editorialPolicy.sections.3.heading: Enweghị nkwa
editorialPolicy.sections.3.body.0: Nkwupụta eziokwu na nkwupụta ọgwụgwọ niile dị mkpa ga-adị ziri ezi, dị ọhụrụ, bụrụ ihe a pụrụ ikwenye ma gosi ya n'ọnọdụ ya. Ihe e dere ga-akọwa ọdịiche dị n'etiti ihe akaebe guzosiri ike na nchọpụta ọhụrụ, echiche ọkachamara, akụkọ onye ọ bụla na okwu mgbasa ozi.
editorialPolicy.sections.3.body.1: Jiri isi mmalite a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi ma ọ bụ nke nwere ikike ebe ọ bụla ha dị, dị ka nchọpụta ndị ọkachamara nyochara, otu ndị ọkachamara ahụike a ma ama, ndị ọchịchị ahụike gọọmentị na akwụkwọ gọọmentị ụlọ ọgwụ.
editorialPolicy.sections.3.body.2: Lelee ụbọchị e bipụtara ya, ókè nchọpụta ahụ, ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị e nyochara, ma ọ metụtara ndị mmadụ ahụ na ma nchọpụta ahụ ka bụ nke mbụ ma ọ bụ nke e nabatara n'ebe niile.
editorialPolicy.sections.3.body.3: Emela ka otu nchọpụta, otu akaebe ma ọ bụ otu nsonaazụ bụrụ nkwa ma ọ bụ mmesi obi ike izugbe.
editorialPolicy.sections.3.body.4: Zere isiokwu na-akpali akpali, okwu na-eji egwu eme ihe, ngosi tupu na mgbe e mesịrị na-eduhie eduhie na nkwupụta na-erigbu adịghị ike onye ọrịa.
editorialPolicy.sections.3.body.5: Ebipụtala ọnụ ọgụgụ e mepụtara, ọmụmaatụ okwu a chepụtara, ọnụ ọgụgụ ihe ịga nke ọma na-enweghị ihe nkwado ma ọ bụ ọkwa a na-apụghị ikwenye.
editorialPolicy.sections.3.body.6: Ebe e ji ọnụ ọgụgụ, kwuo ebe o si, ụbọchị ya, ndị mmadụ ọ metụtara na ókè ya. Egosila na ndị ọzọ kwụụrụ onwe ha nyochara nsonaazụ ụlọ ọgwụ ma ọ bụ dọkịta ma ọ bụrụ na nke ahụ abụghị eziokwu a pụrụ igosi.
editorialPolicy.sections.3.body.7: Okwu a machibidoro iwu ma ọ bụ nke nwere nnukwu ihe ize ndụ gụnyere nkwupụta dị ka “ọgwụgwọ 100%”, “ihe ịga nke ọma e kwere nkwa”, “ịwa ahụ na-enweghị ihe ize ndụ”, “ngwọta ebighị ebi”, “dọkịta kacha mma n'India”, “ụlọ ọgwụ nke mbụ” ma ọ bụ “nsonaazụ e mesiri obi ike” ọ gwụla ma e nwere ihe nkwado doro anya, iwu kwere ma a pụrụ igosi n'onwe ya, ma ndị ọka iwu nyochaa ma kwado okwu ahụ kpọmkwem. N'okwu ahụike, a naghị ejikarị nkwupụta dị otú ahụ.
editorialPolicy.sections.4.heading: Nnwere onwe
editorialPolicy.sections.4.body.0: Ihe e dere banyere mgbaàmà, ọrịa, nchọpụta ọrịa, nhọrọ ọgwụgwọ, usoro ọgwụgwọ, ọgwụ, mgbake, nsogbu, nsonaazụ ọgwụgwọ ma ọ bụ nchọpụta ahụike ga-enwerịrị nyocha site n'aka onye ọkachamara ahụike tozuru etozu tupu e bipụta ya.
editorialPolicy.sections.4.body.1: Onye na-enyocha kwesịrị inwe ọkachamara metụtara isiokwu ahụ. Enwere ike igosi aha ya, ntozu ya, ngalaba ọgwụ ya na ụbọchị o nyochara ya ebe ọ kwesịrị ma ya kwenye. A gaghị akọwa onye na-enyocha dị ka onye nyocha ahụike kwụụrụ onwe ya ma ọ bụrụ na o nwere mmekọrịta azụmahịa dị mkpa a na-ekwupụtaghị.
editorialPolicy.sections.4.body.2: Ọ bụrụ na Med Safar India enweghị onye nyocha tozuru etozu, a ga-amachi ihe ahụ naanị n'ozi usoro na-abụghị ọgwụgwọ, nke e ji nlezianya chọta isi mmalite ya, ma ọ bụ debe ya ruo mgbe e nwetara nyocha kwesịrị ekwesị.
editorialPolicy.sections.4.body.3: Nyocha ahụike anaghị edochi mkpa nyocha iwu, nzuzo, mgbasa ozi ma ọ bụ ndezi.
editorialPolicy.sections.5.heading: Ime ka ọ dị ọhụrụ
editorialPolicy.sections.5.body.0: Nkọwa onye na ndepụta ga-abụ eziokwu, kwụ ọtọ, dị ọhụrụ ma nwee nkwado site n'ndekọ a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi ma ọ bụ nkwenye sitere n'aka ụlọ ọrụ ma ọ bụ ọkachamara metụtara ya.
editorialPolicy.sections.5.body.1: Kwenye aha dọkịta, ntozu ya, ngalaba ọgwụ ya, nkọwa ndebanye aha ya na ebe ọ na-arụ ọrụ ugbu a site n'isi mmalite gọọmentị ma ọ bụ nke ụlọ ọrụ kwesịrị ekwesị, ebe ha dị.
editorialPolicy.sections.5.body.2: Kwenye aha ụlọ ọgwụ, ebe ha dị, ihe ha nwere, nnabata, asambodo na ọrụ ngalaba ọgwụ pụrụ iche site n'aka ụlọ ọrụ ahụ ma ọ bụ otu na-enye nnabata metụtara ya. Kwuo ókè na oge nnabata ọ bụla dị irè ebe ọ dị mkpa.
editorialPolicy.sections.5.body.3: Egosila na Med Safar India enyochala n'ụzọ ahụike, nye ọkwa, nye asambodo ma ọ bụ kwado dọkịta ma ọ bụ ụlọ ọgwụ ma ọ bụrụ na enweghị usoro e dekọrọ nke a pụrụ ịgbachitere na-akwado okwu ahụ.
editorialPolicy.sections.5.body.4: Egosila na ndepụta zuru ezu ma ọ bụ na onye na-enye ọrụ na-anọghị na ndepụta adịghị mma.
editorialPolicy.sections.5.body.5: Nweta ikike tupu iji logo, foto, ihe njirimara azụmahịa, okwu ma ọ bụ ihe ndị ọzọ ụlọ ọgwụ ma ọ bụ dọkịta nwe.
editorialPolicy.sections.5.body.6: Nye ndị mmekọ ụzọ ha ga-esi rịọ ka e mezie njehie eziokwu, n'enyeghị ha ikike n'onwe ya izochi ihe e dere n'ụzọ kwụ ọtọ na ziri ezi.
editorialPolicy.sections.5.body.7: Ọ bụrụ na a pụghị ikwenye ozi, kọwaa ókè ya nke ọma ma ọ bụ ebipụtala ya.
editorialPolicy.sections.6.heading: Mmezi
editorialPolicy.sections.6.body.0: Med Safar India nwere ike inwe ndokwa azụmahịa, nkwekọrịta nhazi, ndokwa ntụaka, nkwado ego ma ọ bụ mmekọrịta azụmahịa ndị ọzọ na ụlọ ọgwụ, ndị dọkịta, ndị na-enye ebe obibi, ndị na-enye ụgbọ njem ma ọ bụ ndị mmekọ ọrụ ndị ọzọ. A gaghị ezochi mmekọrịta ndị a ebe ha nwere ike imetụta otu onye na-agụ si aghọta ndụmọdụ, ndepụta, ntụnyere ma ọ bụ nkwado.
editorialPolicy.sections.6.body.1: Kwupụta ọnọdụ a kwụrụ ụgwọ maka ya, nkwado ego, kọmịshọn, ndokwa ntụaka ma ọ bụ mmekọrịta azụmahịa ndị ọzọ dị mkpa n'okwu doro anya, nke a na-ahụ anya, n'akụkụ ihe ahụ metụtara ya.
editorialPolicy.sections.6.body.2: Akọwala ọnọdụ a kwụrụ ụgwọ maka ya ma ọ bụ nke azụmahịa metụtara dị ka ọkwa kwụụrụ onwe ya, onyinye nsọpụrụ, nyocha ma ọ bụ ndụmọdụ ọgwụgwọ.
editorialPolicy.sections.6.body.3: Erela ma ọ bụ gosi nkwado ọgwụgwọ. Ndokwa azụmahịa agaghị ekpebi ma ọgwụgwọ kwesịrị otu onye ọrịa.
editorialPolicy.sections.6.body.4: Ebe e bipụtara ntụnyere, kọwaa ụkpụrụ e ji tụnyere, ebe e si nweta ozi, ụbọchị e lere ya na ókè ọ bụla dị mkpa.
editorialPolicy.sections.6.body.5: Ndị ọrụ, ndị edemede, ndị na-enyocha na ndị na-enye aka ga-ekwupụta mmasị onwe, ego ma ọ bụ ọrụ nwere ike imetụta ihe ha dere.
editorialPolicy.sections.6.body.6: Ekwela nkwa na dọkịta ma ọ bụ ụlọ ọgwụ ga-enye otu mbelata ọnụ ahịa, nsonaazụ ọgwụgwọ ma ọ bụ ọkwa nlekọta ọ gwụla ma e kwenyere ya n'ederede ma gosi ya ya na nkọwa ókè kwesịrị ekwesị.
editorialPolicy.sections.6.body.7: Nkwupụta kwesịrị ịdị mfe ma doo anya, dịka ọmụmaatụ: “Med Safar India nwere ike ịnata ụgwọ nhazi n'aka ụfọdụ ndị mmekọ ahụike. Mmekọrịta a abụghị nkwado ọgwụgwọ. Ndị ọrịa kwesịrị iso dọkịta na-agwọ ha kparịta ozugbo ma ọgwụgwọ kwesịrị ha.” A ga-agbanwe okwu ahụ ka o kwekọọ na ndokwa ahụ n'ezie, onye ọka iwu ga-enyochakwa ya.
editorialPolicy.sections.7.heading: 8. Akụkọ ndị ọrịa, akaebe, foto na ọmụmaatụ okwu
editorialPolicy.sections.7.body.0: Ahụmịhe ndị ọrịa bụ ihe dị nro, a ga-ejikwa nlezianya pụrụ iche edozi ha. Akaebe bụ akụkọ otu onye, ọ bụghị ihe akaebe na onye ọrịa ọzọ ga-enwe otu ahụmịhe ma ọ bụ nsonaazụ ahụ.
editorialPolicy.sections.7.body.1: Nweta nkwenye tupu oge ahụ, kpọmkwem, nke onye ahụ ghọtara nke ọma ma e dekọrọ ya tupu iji aha onye ọrịa, foto, olu, vidiyo, akụkọ ahụike, nchọpụta ọrịa, nkọwa ọgwụgwọ ma ọ bụ akụkọ a pụrụ iji mata ya.
editorialPolicy.sections.7.body.2: Kọwaa ụzọ a ga-eji ya, ndị ga-ahụ ya, ebumnuche ya, ogologo oge ya na ma enwere ike iji ya mee mgbasa ozi a kwụrụ ụgwọ ma ọ bụ kọọrọ ndị mmekọ ya.
editorialPolicy.sections.7.body.3: Mee ka ọ doo anya na ịjụ inye nkwenye agaghị emetụta inweta ọrụ nhazi ma ọ bụ nhazi ọgwụgwọ.
editorialPolicy.sections.7.body.4: Edezila akaebe n'ụzọ na-agbanwe ihe ọ pụtara ma ọ bụ na-eduhie eduhie.
editorialPolicy.sections.7.body.5: Echepụtala, azụla, ewepụtala naanị akụkụ na-eduhie eduhie ma ọ bụ nye ihe mkpali maka akaebe n'ụzọ a na-ekwupụtaghị ma ọ bụ nke aghụghọ.
editorialPolicy.sections.7.body.6: Ebe e nyere ihe mkpali, onyinye, mbelata ọnụ ahịa ma ọ bụ uru ọzọ, kwupụta ya nke ọma ma hụ na ndokwa ahụ dị n'iwu.
editorialPolicy.sections.7.body.7: Jiri ọmụmaatụ okwu e wepụrụ aha ma ọ bụ ihe njirimara ebe ọ bụla o kwere omume. Wepụ ihe ndị nwere ike ime ka a mata onye ahụ n'ụzọ ọzọ, tinyere aha na ihu.
editorialPolicy.sections.7.body.8: Ebipụtala ihe na-egosi ọnyá ọjọọ, na-eweda mmadụ ala ma ọ bụ na-akpata nchegbu naanị iji dọta uche.
editorialPolicy.sections.7.body.9: Nkwenye maka ọgwụgwọ, ịkọrọ ndị ọzọ akwụkwọ ụlọ ọgwụ na ibipụta maka mgbasa ozi bụ ihe dị iche iche. A gaghị ewere nkwenye maka otu n'ime ha dị ka nkwenye maka ndị ọzọ.
editorialPolicy.sections.8.heading: 9. Nzuzo, ihe nzuzo na ozi ahụike dị nro
editorialPolicy.sections.8.body.0: Anyị ga-edobe ozi ndị ọrịa na ndị nwere ike ịbụ ndị ọrịa na nzuzo siri ike. A ga-abanye ma jiri ozi ahụike, akwụkwọ njirimara, nkọwa nkwurịta okwu, akwụkwọ njem, foto na nkwurịta okwu ndị ọrịa naanị maka ebumnuche e nyere ikike.
editorialPolicy.sections.8.body.1: Etinyela nkọwa a pụrụ iji mata onye ọrịa n'ederede mbụ, foto ihuenyo, ngosi ma ọ bụ ozi ọha ọ gwụla ma e nwetara nkwenye na nkwado a chọrọ.
editorialPolicy.sections.8.body.2: Nakọta ma jiri naanị ozi onwe a chọrọ n'ezie maka ebumnuche e kwuru, ma gbasoo ọkwa nzuzo na usoro nkwenye metụtara ya.
editorialPolicy.sections.8.body.3: Kọọrọ ụlọ ọgwụ, ndị dọkịta, ndị mmekọ njem ma ọ bụ ndị na-enye ọrụ ozi ndị ọrịa naanị ebe e nyere ikike, ọ dị mkpa ma ndokwa nzuzo metụtara ya na ihe iwu kwere kpuchiri ya.
editorialPolicy.sections.8.body.4: Jiri sistemụ echekwara a kwadoro maka nchekwa na izipu ozi. Ekesala akwụkwọ ahụike site n'akaụntụ onwe ma ọ bụ otu na-abụghị nke ọrụ ọ gwụla ma e nyere ikike kpọmkwem ma chekwaa ya nke ọma.
editorialPolicy.sections.8.body.5: Machie ịbanye n'ozi ndị ọrịa naanị nye ndị kwesịrị ịma ya, ma gbasoo usoro idebe, ihichapụ, ịkọ ihe mberede na nchịkwa ịbanye.
editorialPolicy.sections.8.body.6: Ejila ozi ndị ọrịa maka mgbasa ozi, nyocha omume, akaebe, ngwa AI ma ọ bụ ebumnuche ndezi na-enweghị njikọ na-enweghị ihe kpatara ya dị irè e dekọrọ iche.
editorialPolicy.sections.8.body.7: Iwu Nzuzo nke ụlọ ọrụ ahụ, fọm nkwenye, nkwekọrịta ndị na-ere ihe na otu e si edozi ozi n'ezie ga-ekwekọrịta n'akụkụ a na iwu nchekwa ozi metụtara ya.
editorialPolicy.sections.9.heading: 10. Mgbasa ozi, nkwalite na nkwurịta okwu ọha
editorialPolicy.sections.9.body.0: Ihe mgbasa ozi niile ga-abụ eziokwu, nwee ihe nkwado, doo anya ma dị iche n'ihe ndezi ma ọ bụ mmụta kwụụrụ onwe ya. Echiche zuru ezu ozi na-enye dị mkpa, gụnyere isiokwu ya, foto, ọkwa nkọwa, nhazi na ihe a hapụrụ.
editorialPolicy.sections.9.body.1: Kọwaa nke ọma mgbasa ozi, ihe a kwụrụ ụgwọ ka e bipụta, mmekọrịta a kwụrụ ụgwọ na ọnọdụ nkwalite.
editorialPolicy.sections.9.body.2: Ekwula okwu na-eduhie eduhie banyere nsonaazụ ọgwụgwọ, ọnụ ahịa dị ala, ọsọ, nchekwa, ihe dị n'ụlọ ọgwụ, ntozu dọkịta ma ọ bụ ma onye ọrịa tozuru.
editorialPolicy.sections.9.body.3: Emela ka mmadụ chee na ọ dị ngwa n'ụzọ adịghị adị, erigbu egwu ma ọ bụ gosi na onye ọrịa ga-eme ihe ozugbo iji zere mmerụ ọ gwụla ma dọkịta tozuru etozu kwenyere na ọ dị ngwa n'ezie n'ụzọ ahụike.
editorialPolicy.sections.9.body.4: Gosi ọnụ ahịa, ihe gụnyere, ihe na-agụnyeghị, ụtụ isi, atụmatụ ego, usoro nkagbu na ụgwọ ọzọ nwere ike ịdị n'ụzọ ziri ezi ya na nkọwa ókè kwesịrị ekwesị.
editorialPolicy.sections.9.body.5: Atụnyerela ụlọ ọgwụ ma ọ bụ ndị dọkịta site n'iji ozi a họpụtara n'ụzọ ele mmadụ anya n'ihu, ozi ochie ma ọ bụ ozi a na-apụghị ikwenye.
editorialPolicy.sections.9.body.6: Ejila aha dọkịta, foto ya, okwu ya ma ọ bụ ihe yiri nkwado ya n'ụzọ nwere ike imebi iwu ọkachamara ma ọ bụ duhie ọha.
editorialPolicy.sections.9.body.7: Tupu e bipụta, nyocha iwu kwesịrị ilebara Consumer Protection Act, 2019 anya, ntụziaka mgbasa ozi na nkwado CCPA metụtara ya, ASCI Code ebe ọ metụtara ya, na mmachi mgbasa ozi maka ndị ọkachamara ahụike.
editorialPolicy.sections.10.heading: 11. Usoro iwu na nchịkwa India
editorialPolicy.sections.10.body.0: E mere iwu a iji kwado ibipụta ihe n'ụzọ kwesịrị ekwesị n'India. Ọ bụghị nkọwa zuru ezu nke iwu, ọ naghịkwa edochi ndụmọdụ onye ọka iwu. Iwu na usoro metụtara ya dabere n'ihe ahụ, ọrụ ahụ, ndị ọ na-elekwasị anya, ọrụ nkwekọrịta na otu e si edozi ozi n'ezie.
editorialPolicy.sections.10.body.1: Consumer Protection Act, 2019 na ntụziaka CCPA — Zere mgbasa ozi na-eduhie eduhie, omume azụmahịa na-ezighị ezi, nkwupụta ụgha, nkwado aghụghọ na ihe dị mkpa a hapụrụ. Gụọ CCPA Guidelines for Prevention of Misleading Advertisements and Endorsements for Misleading Advertisements, 2022, dịka e mezigharịrị ma ọ bụ gbakwunyere ya.
editorialPolicy.sections.10.body.2: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 na DPDP Rules, 2025 — Jiri ozi onwe dijitalụ mee ihe n'ụzọ doro anya na n'ụzọ iwu kwere, ya na ọkwa kwesịrị ekwesị, nkwenye ma ọ bụ ihe ndị ọzọ e kwere, nchekwa, nlekọta ikike na usoro ịza mmebi nchekwa mgbe akụkụ ndị metụtara ya malitere ma metụta ya. A na-amalite ya n'usoro n'usoro; kwenye akụkụ ndị na-arụ ọrụ n'oge ọrụ ọ bụla.
editorialPolicy.sections.10.body.3: Information Technology Act, 2000 na usoro metụtara ya — Nyochaa ọrụ metụtara ọrụ ịntanetị, nchekwa ịntanetị, ndekọ eletrọnịkị, ọrụ onye etiti na nkwurịta okwu dijitalụ. Echela na iwu ọ bụla gbasara onye etiti ma ọ bụ midia dijitalụ metụtara Med Safar India; nweta ndụmọdụ dabere n'ọrụ ọ na-arụ.
editorialPolicy.sections.10.body.4: Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954 — Ebipụtala mgbasa ozi ma ọ bụ nkwupụta a machibidoro iwu metụtara ọrịa, ọnọdụ, ọgwụ ma ọ bụ ngwọta ndị a kpọrọ aha. Nweta nyocha iwu tupu ibipụta ihe mgbasa ozi metụtara ọgwụ ma ọ bụ ịgwọ ọrịa.
editorialPolicy.sections.10.body.5: Iwu ndị ọkachamara ahụike na ihe NMC chọrọ — Sọpụrụ National Medical Commission Act, 2019 na ihe omume ọkachamara metụtara ya chọrọ n'aka ndị dọkịta debanyere aha. NMC wepụtara Guidelines on Ethical Advertising and Public Communication by Hospitals/Medical Institutions and Registered Medical Practitioners n'ụbọchị 6 Ọktoba 2026. Onye ọka iwu India ga-enyocha ma ha metụtara onye na-ahazi ọgwụgwọ ozugbo, na ọrụ ọ bụla dị ebe Med Safar na-eme ihe maka ma ọ bụ n'aha ụlọ ọgwụ ma ọ bụ dọkịta.
editorialPolicy.sections.10.body.6: Copyright Act, 1957 na Trade Marks Act, 1999 — Jiri ederede, foto, vidiyo, eserese, egwu, ọnụ ọgụgụ nchọpụta, logo na akara azụmahịa naanị mgbe e nwetara ikike, akwụkwọ ikike dị irè, ihe iwu wepụrụ ma ọ bụ ihe ọzọ iwu kwere. Ịkpọ aha onye nwe ya naanị anaghị edochi ikike.
editorialPolicy.sections.10.body.7: Iwu ndị ọzọ metụtara ya na usoro ngalaba — Dabere n'ọrụ na ihe ahụ, nyochaa Clinical Establishments Act na iwu Steeti metụtara ya, usoro ọgwụgwọ site n'ịntanetị (telemedicine), ụkpụrụ mgbasa ozi, iwu ọkachamara, ihe azụmahịa ịntanetị chọrọ, ihe ụtụ isi na nkwekọrịta ndị ahịa chọrọ, na iwu ndị ọzọ metụtara ya.
editorialPolicy.sections.10.body.8: Med Safar India agaghị ekwu ma ọ bụ gosi na iwu a na-ekwe nkwa irube isi n'iwu. Ndị isi ga-edebe ndekọ iwu dị ọhụrụ ma nweta ndụmọdụ banyere iwu metụtara usoro azụmahịa ya kpọmkwem, ndokwa ndị mmekọ na ahịa ọ na-elekwasị anya.
editorialPolicy.sections.11.heading: 12. Ndị ọrịa si mba ọzọ na ihe metụtara ọtụtụ mba
editorialPolicy.sections.11.body.0: Ebe ọ bụ na Med Safar India nwere ike iso ndị ọrịa na ezinụlọ nọ na mpụga India kwurịta okwu, a ga-enyocha ihe e dere na otu e si edozi ozi maka iwu nke mba ma ọ bụ mpaghara a na-elekwasị anya na ebe ndị mmadụ nọ.
editorialPolicy.sections.11.body.1: Dabere n'ọnọdụ, nke a nwere ike ịgụnye ihe iwu nzuzo, nchekwa ndị ahịa, mgbasa ozi, ndị ọkachamara ahụike, azụmahịa eletrọnịkị na ozi ahụike chọrọ na mba dị ka United Kingdom, mba ndị otu European Union, Kenya, Naịjirịa, Bangladesh, mba ndị dị n'Ọwara Persia (Gulf) na ahịa CIS. Ma ọ metụtara ya dabere n'eziokwu nke okwu ọ bụla; iwu a ekwughị na iwu mba ọzọ ọ bụla metụtara mmekọrịta ọ bụla.
editorialPolicy.sections.11.body.2: Tupu ịmalite mgbasa ozi maka otu mba, e kwesịrị inweta ndụmọdụ iwu nke obodo ahụ ebe a chọrọ ya. Zere ikwu na ọgwụgwọ a kwadoro, dị, a na-akwụghachi ego ya ma ọ bụ iwu kwere ya na mba ọzọ ọ gwụla ma e kwenyere ya maka ahịa ahụ.
editorialPolicy.sections.12.heading: 13. Ikike nwe ihe, isi mmalite, foto na ikike
editorialPolicy.sections.12.body.0: Jiri ihe mbụ e kere, ihe e nwetara akwụkwọ ikike nke ọma, ihe nke ọha nwe ma ọ bụ ihe e ji n'okpuru ihe iwu wepụrụ doro anya na ọ metụtara ya.
editorialPolicy.sections.12.body.1: Debe ndekọ adreesị weebụ isi mmalite, nkọwa mbipụta, akwụkwọ ikike, ikike na ihe a chọrọ maka ịkpọ aha onye nwe ya.
editorialPolicy.sections.12.body.2: Edepụtala edemede, broshuọ ụlọ ọgwụ, eserese ahụike, foto, vidiyo ma ọ bụ ihe soshal midia na-enweghị ikike naanị n'ihi na ọha nwere ike ịhụ ha.
editorialPolicy.sections.12.body.3: Jiri foto ezi okwu na-egosi isiokwu ahụ n'ụzọ ziri ezi. Ejila foto ọha (stock) n'ụzọ na-egosi n'ụgha na ọ bụ onye ọrịa, dọkịta, ụlọ ọgwụ ma ọ bụ usoro ọgwụgwọ a kpọrọ aha.
editorialPolicy.sections.12.body.4: Agbanwela foto ahụike ma ọ bụ foto ọgwụgwọ n'ụzọ na-emebi ihe ha pụtara n'ọgwụgwọ.
editorialPolicy.sections.12.body.5: Nweta ikike e dere ede maka logo ndị mmekọ na ihe njirimara azụmahịa ha, ma gbasoo ọnọdụ ọ bụla maka iji ha.
editorialPolicy.sections.13.heading: 14. Ọgụgụ isi arụrụ arụ (AI) na ngwa na-arụ ọrụ n'onwe ha
editorialPolicy.sections.13.body.0: Enwere ike iji ngwa AI nyere aka n'ide ederede mbụ, imeziwanye asụsụ, ntụgharị asụsụ, nhazi, nchịkọta ma ọ bụ iche echiche. A gaghị ewere ha dị ka isi mmalite nwere ikike maka ahụike, iwu ma ọ bụ nchịkwa.
editorialPolicy.sections.13.body.1: Onye ndezi mmadụ ga-ekwenye nkwupụta eziokwu, ntụaka, aha, ntozu, ọnụ ọgụgụ, ntụgharị asụsụ na njikọ tupu e bipụta.
editorialPolicy.sections.13.body.2: Nkwupụta ọgwụgwọ ga-enwerịrị nyocha ahụike tozuru etozu n'agbanyeghị ma ọ bụ mmadụ dere ha ma ọ bụ e ji AI mepụta ha.
editorialPolicy.sections.13.body.3: Etinyela ozi a pụrụ iji mata onye ọrịa, akwụkwọ ahụike, akwụkwọ njirimara ma ọ bụ ozi nzuzo ndị mmekọ n'ime ngwa AI ọ gwụla ma e kwadoro ngwa ahụ na iji ya kpọmkwem ma e nwee nchekwa nzuzo na nchekwa kwesịrị ekwesị.
editorialPolicy.sections.13.body.4: Emepụtala akaebe ndị ọrịa adịgboroja, ndị dọkịta a chepụtara, ihe akaebe ọgwụgwọ a kpụrụ akpụ ma ọ bụ foto na-eduhie eduhie banyere nsonaazụ ọgwụgwọ.
editorialPolicy.sections.13.body.5: Kwupụta ihe AI mepụtara ma ọ bụ nke AI gbanwere n'ụzọ dị mkpa ebe iwu, iwu ikpo okwu ma ọ bụ ọnọdụ chọrọ ya, ma ọ bụ ebe ịhapụ ya nwere ike iduhie ndị na-agụ ya.
editorialPolicy.sections.14.heading: 15. Usoro ndezi na nkwado
editorialPolicy.sections.14.body.0: E kwesịrị ịgbaso usoro ndị a tupu e bipụta. Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ ga-ekenye ndị a kpọrọ aha ọrụ ọ bụla, ọ gaghịkwa ekwu na usoro nyocha dị ruo mgbe ọ malitere ịrụ ọrụ.
editorialPolicy.sections.14.body.1: Nkọwa ọrụ na nhazi — chọpụta ndị a na-ede maka ha, ebumnuche, ụdị ihe ahụ, ihe ize ndụ ahụike, mmasị azụmahịa, mmetụta nzuzo na mba a na-elekwasị anya.
editorialPolicy.sections.14.body.2: Ide ederede — dee ihe ahụ site n'iji isi mmalite a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi na okwu azụmahịa a kwadoro.
editorialPolicy.sections.14.body.3: Nyocha eziokwu — kwenye aha, ụbọchị, ọnụ ọgụgụ, nkwupụta, ntozu, njikọ, ọnụ ahịa na ozi ndị mmekọ.
editorialPolicy.sections.14.body.4: Nyocha ahụike — nweta nyocha tozuru etozu maka ihe metụtara ọgwụgwọ ma dekọọ onye nyochara ya na ụbọchị.
editorialPolicy.sections.14.body.5: Nyocha iwu, nzuzo na mgbasa ozi — zigaa ihe nwere ihe ize ndụ ka elu, akaebe, nkwupụta, mgbasa ozi a kwụrụ ụgwọ, ozi ndị ọrịa na mgbasa ozi metụtara ọtụtụ mba n'ọkwa dị elu.
editorialPolicy.sections.14.body.6: Nkwado ndezi — onye ndezi nwere ikike na-enyocha ịdị mfe nghọta, nhazi kwụ ọtọ, olu, nkwupụta na irube isi n'iwu a.
editorialPolicy.sections.14.body.7: Mbipụta na idebe ndekọ — bipụta ụdị a kwadoro ma debe isi mmalite, nkwado, ndekọ nkwenye na ụbọchị mbipụta.
editorialPolicy.sections.14.body.8: Nlekọta na nyocha — na-elekọta maka eziokwu gbanwere, mkpesa, ihe akaebe ọhụrụ, ntozu gwụrụ oge, mgbanwe iwu na mmelite ndị mmekọ.
editorialPolicy.sections.14.body.9: Ọkwa ihe ize ndụ a tụrụ aro: ihe nkịtị na-abụghị ọgwụgwọ nwere ike ịnata nyocha ndezi na nke eziokwu; ihe metụtara ọgwụgwọ, ntụnyere, akaebe, mgbasa ozi a kwụrụ ụgwọ, ihe a pụrụ iji mata onye ọrịa ma ọ bụ ihe metụtara ọtụtụ mba chọrọ nyocha ọkachamara ọzọ.
editorialPolicy.sections.15.heading: 16. Mmezi, mmelite na mkpesa
editorialPolicy.sections.15.body.0: Anyị ga-eme ihe kwesịrị ekwesị iji mezie njehie dị mkpa ozugbo na n'ụzọ doro anya.
editorialPolicy.sections.15.body.1: Ndị na-agụ ihe, ndị ọrịa, ndị ọkachamara ahụike na ndị mmekọ nwere ike ịkọ njehie a na-enyo enyo, ozi ochie, nchegbu nzuzo ma ọ bụ ihe na-eduhie eduhie site n'ụzọ nkwurịta okwu e bipụtara na weebụsaịtị anyị.
editorialPolicy.sections.15.body.2: Kwenye na i natara mkpesa n'ime oge kwesịrị ekwesị ma nyochaa ka o si dị ngwa, karịsịa ebe ọ nwere ike imetụta nchekwa ma ọ bụ nzuzo onye ọrịa.
editorialPolicy.sections.15.body.3: Mezie ma ọ bụ wepụ ihe ahụ ebe e gosiri njehie dị mkpa, nchegbu iwu, nsogbu nkwenye ma ọ bụ ihe ize ndụ nchekwa.
editorialPolicy.sections.15.body.4: Ebe njehie na-emetụta nghọta onye na-agụ ya n'ụzọ dị mkpa, tinye ederede mmezi ma ọ bụ ụbọchị mmelite kama ịgbanwe ihe ahụ na nzuzo, ebe ọ kwesịrị.
editorialPolicy.sections.15.body.5: Debe ndekọ ime ụlọ nke mkpesa ahụ, nyocha, mkpebi, mmezi na ụbọchị.
editorialPolicy.sections.15.body.6: Maka nchegbu nchekwa ma ọ bụ nzuzo dị ngwa, e kwesịrị iwepụ ihe ahụ nwa oge ma ọ bụ machie ya ka a na-enyocha okwu ahụ.
editorialPolicy.sections.16.heading: 17. Ịdị mfe iji, asụsụ na nkwurịta okwu nsọpụrụ
editorialPolicy.sections.16.body.0: E kwesịrị iji asụsụ dị mfe, nke nwere nsọpụrụ dee ihe ma hazie ya ka ndị ọrịa na ezinụlọ si n'ọnọdụ dị iche iche ghọta ya. Kọwaa okwu ahụike ebe ha dị mkpa. Zere ịkpa ike, ịkpa oke, echiche ọjọọ a kpọkọtara, ozi na-eweta ihere na ichere banyere afọ ndụ, nkwarụ, mba, ego, okpukpe ma ọ bụ ọnọdụ ahụike mmadụ.
editorialPolicy.sections.16.body.1: Ntụgharị asụsụ ga-echekwa ihe ederede mbụ pụtara, ókè ya na ozi nchekwa ya. Onye nyocha mmadụ tozuru etozu kwesịrị inyocha ntụgharị asụsụ dị mkpa e mere maka ndị ọrịa.
editorialPolicy.sections.17.heading: 18. Ịza ajụjụ na nyocha iwu a
editorialPolicy.sections.17.body.0: Ndị isi Med Safar India na-aza maka itinye iwu a n'ọrụ, ikenye ọrụ ndezi na nyocha, idebe ndekọ nkwado na ịhụ na ndị ọrụ nkwekọrịta na ụlọ ọrụ na-arụ ọrụ n'aha ya maara ụkpụrụ ndị a.
editorialPolicy.sections.17.body.1: Ndị ọrụ niile, ndị na-enye aka na ụlọ ọrụ ga-ezigara ndị isi ozugbo ihe ọ bụla nwere ike ịbụ nke na-ezighị ezi, na-eduhie eduhie, megidere iwu, na-emebi nzuzo ma ọ bụ na-ekwekọrịtaghị n'ụkpụrụ ibute onye ọrịa ụzọ.
editorialPolicy.sections.17.body.2: A ga-enyocha iwu a ma ọ dịkarịa ala otu ugboro n'afọ na mgbe ọ bụla enwere mgbanwe dị mkpa n'iwu metụtara ya, ntụziaka NMC ma ọ bụ ndị ọzọ na-achịkwa, ọrụ Med Safar India, ndokwa azụmahịa, teknụzụ ma ọ bụ ahịa ọ na-elekwasị anya.

cancellations.sections.0.heading: 13. Nkagbu, nkwụghachi ego na ịkwụsị ọrụ
cancellations.sections.0.body.0: Ikike nkagbu na nkwụghachi ego dabere n'ụdị ọrụ ahụ, ọkwa ebe nkagbu mere, ọrụ e meelarị na usoro metụtara onye na-enye ọrụ ahụ.
cancellations.sections.0.body.1: Ebe iwu nkagbu ma ọ bụ nkwụghachi ego metụtara ya, Med Safar India ga-akọwa ọnọdụ ndị metụtara ya site n'atụmatụ ego, nkwenye ndokwa, akwụkwọ ụgwọ ma ọ bụ akwụkwọ ọzọ e dere ede.
cancellations.sections.0.body.3: Ọ bụrụ na Onye Ọrịa kagbuo tupu ọ gaa India, Onye Ọrịa kwesịrị ịgwa Med Safar India n'ederede ozugbo o kwere omume.
cancellations.sections.0.body.4: A ga-enyocha nkwụghachi ego a kwụrụ Med Safar India dịka usoro ọrụ a kwekọrịtara, ọrụ e nyerelarị, ụgwọ nkagbu metụtara ya na iwu metụtara ya si kwuo.
cancellations.sections.0.body.5: Ego a kwụlarị ụlọ ọgwụ, ndị dọkịta, ụlọ nkwari akụ, ụlọ ọrụ ụgbọelu ma ọ bụ ndị ọzọ na-enye ọrụ kwụụrụ onwe ha ga-adabere n'iwu nkwụghachi na nkagbu nke onye na-enye ọrụ metụtara ya.
cancellations.sections.0.body.6: Med Safar India enweghị ike ikwe nkwa ịnwetaghachi ego a kwụrụ onye na-enye ọrụ kwụụrụ onwe ya ebe usoro onye ahụ ekweghị nkwụghachi ego.
cancellations.sections.0.body.8: Ọ bụrụ na Onye Ọrịa ekpebie ịghara ịga n'ihu na ọgwụgwọ a tụrụ aro mgbe ọ rutere ma ọ bụ hụ dọkịta, ụgwọ e jirilarị maka ndụmọdụ dọkịta, nyocha, ebe obibi, ụgbọ njem, ọrụ nchịkwa ma ọ bụ ndokwa ndị ọzọ nwere ike ịka bụrụ ụgwọ a ga-akwụ.
cancellations.sections.0.body.9: Nkwụghachi ego mbụ ọ bụla a kwụrụ ụlọ ọgwụ ma ọ bụ maka ọgwụgwọ ga-adabere n'usoro onye na-enye ọrụ metụtara ya, n'okpuru iwu metụtara ya.
cancellations.sections.0.body.10: 13.3 Nkagbu nke onye na-enye ọrụ mere
cancellations.sections.0.body.11: Ọ bụrụ na Onye Na-enye Ọrụ Ahụike kagbuo, yigharịa ma ọ bụ jụ usoro ọgwụgwọ, Med Safar India ga-enyere aka, ebe o kwere omume, na nkwurịta okwu na nhazi nhọrọ ndị ọzọ dị.
cancellations.sections.0.body.12: A ga-ekpebi nkwụghachi ọ bụla nke ụgwọ onye na-enye ọrụ ahụ n'okpuru usoro ya na iwu metụtara ya.
cancellations.sections.0.body.14: Ebe Med Safar India kwadoro nkwụghachi ego ọ natara, a na-ahazikarị nkwụghachi ahụ site n'ụzọ e ji kwụọ ụgwọ na mbụ, n'okpuru ihe onye na-enye ọrụ ịkwụ ụgwọ chọrọ na iwu metụtara ya.
cancellations.sections.0.body.15: A ga-akọwa ego ọ bụla e kwere ka e wepụ, gosi ihe kpatara ya, ọ ga-ekwekọkwa n'usoro a kwekọrịtara na iwu metụtara ya.
cancellations.sections.0.body.16: Ọ dịghị ihe dị n'akụkụ a na-ewepụ nkwụghachi ego ma ọ bụ ụzọ ngwọta iwu metụtara ya mere ka ọ bụrụ iwu.
cancellations.sections.1.heading: 14. Mgbanwe na ndokwa na usoro njem
cancellations.sections.1.body.0: Arịrịọ ịgbanwe ụbọchị ndụmọdụ dọkịta, usoro oge ọgwụgwọ, ebe obibi, ụgbọ njem ma ọ bụ ndokwa njem dabere n'ohere dị na iwu onye na-enye ọrụ metụtara ya.
cancellations.sections.1.body.1: Mgbanwe nwere ike ibute ụgwọ ọzọ, atụmatụ ego e degharịrị ma ọ bụ ụgwọ nkagbu.
cancellations.sections.1.body.2: Usoro oge ọgwụgwọ nwere ike ịgbanwe n'ihi mkpa ọgwụgwọ, ịdị adị nke ndị ọrụ ahụike, ohere dị n'ụlọ ọgwụ, nyocha ma ọ bụ ọnọdụ ndị ọzọ karịrị ike Med Safar India.
cancellations.sections.1.body.3: Med Safar India ga-agba mbọ kwesịrị ekwesị ịkọ mgbanwe a gwara ya ma nyere aka na nhazi ebe ọ gụnyere n'ọrụ a kwekọrịtara.
cancellations.sections.1.body.4: Ndị Ọrịa kwesịrị izere ime ndokwa njem ma ọ bụ ntụrụndụ a na-agaghị akwụghachi ego ya nke dabere n'usoro oge ọgwụgwọ a na-akwadobeghị.

questionnaireText.list.meta.description: Zaa ajụjụ ole na ole tupu dọkịta na-awa ahụ elee okwu gị. Ọ bụ n'efu, ọ na-ewekwa ihe dị ka nkeji atọ.
questionnaireText.list.heading: Buru ụzọ zaa ajụjụ ole na ole
questionnaireText.list.intro: Dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-agụ azịza gị tupu oku mbụ, ka ndụmọdụ i nwetara dabara n'okwu gị. Ọ na-ewe ihe dị ka nkeji atọ.
questionnaireText.contact.heading: Olee ebe anyị ga-eziga azịza ahụ?
questionnaireText.contact.intro: Onye na-ahụ maka okwu gị ga-aza na WhatsApp ma ọ bụ site n'oku, gwa gị ihe dọkịta na-awa ahụ chere.
questionnaireText.done.heading: Daalụ. Anyị enwetala azịza gị.
questionnaireText.done.body: Onye na-ahụ maka okwu gị na Medsafar ga-akpọtụrụ gị ozugbo dọkịta na-awa ahụ gụchara ha.
questionnaireText.errors.required: Biko zaa ajụjụ ọ bụla a na-akaraghị dịka ọ bụghị iwu.
questionnaireText.note: A na-eji azịza gị naanị maka ịhazi nlekọta gị. Ha abụghị nchọpụta ọrịa: dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-ekpebi ihe kwesịrị gị mgbe ọ gụchara akwụkwọ nyocha gị ma nyochaa gị.
Ajụjụ maka ịwa ahụ ibelata ibu. Medsafar India.
Chọpụta ma ịwa ahụ ibelata ibu nwere ike ikwesị gị. Zaa ajụjụ ole na ole, dọkịta na-awa ahụ n'India ga-agụ ha n'efu.
Ajụjụ maka ịwa ahụ ibelata ibu
Ogologo gị, ibu gị na ahụike gị n'ajụjụ ole na ole, ka dọkịta na-awa ahụ wee gwa gị ma ịwa ahụ nwere ike ikwesị gị.
questionnaires.weight-loss-surgery.headi: Ajụjụ maka ịwa ahụ ibelata ibu
questionnaires.weight-loss-surgery.intro: Gwa anyị banyere ibu gị na ahụike gị. Dọkịta na-awa ahụ maka ibelata ibu (bariatric) n'ụlọ ọgwụ anyị na ya na-arụkọ ọrụ ga-agụ azịza gị ma gwa gị ma ịwa ahụ nwere ike ikwesị gị.
questionnaires.weight-loss-surgery.bmi.n: BMI bụ ntuziaka nkịtị. Ndị dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-atụlekarị ịwa ahụ ibelata ibu site na BMI dị ihe dị ka 35, ma ọ bụ nke dị ala karịa maka ụfọdụ ndị nwere ọrịa shuga ụdị 2. Dọkịta na-awa ahụ ga-ekpebi maka okwu gị.
questionnaires.weight-loss-surgery.secti: Ị nwere nke ọ bụla n'ime ndị a?
Nkwụsị iku ume n'ụra (sleep apnoea) ma ọ bụ oke ngụ
Mgbu nkwonkwo ma ọ bụ azụ
Gịnị ka i nwaala iji belata ibu?
Ọgwụ ma ọ bụ ịgba ọgwụ maka ibelata ibu
Ịwa ahụ ibelata ibu na mbụ
Aha na ọnụọgụ ha, ma ọ bụrụ na ị ma ha
Ọ dị ịwa ahụ i nwere n'uche?
Ejighị m n'aka, achọrọ m ndụmọdụ
Ihe ọ bụla ọzọ dọkịta na-awa ahụ kwesịrị ịma
Ịwa ahụ gara aga, nsogbu ahụike ndị ọzọ, ajụjụ
questionnaires.cosmetic-surgery.treatmen: Ịwa ahụ plastik, nrụzi na mma ahụ
questionnaires.cosmetic-surgery.meta.tit: Ajụjụ maka ịwa ahụ mma. Medsafar India.
questionnaires.cosmetic-surgery.meta.des: Gwa dọkịta na-awa ahụ plastik n'India ihe ị chọrọ ịgbanwe. Zaa ajụjụ ole na ole ma nweta ndụmọdụ n'efu maka okwu gị.
questionnaires.cosmetic-surgery.card.bod: Ihe ị chọrọ ịgbanwe na ntakịrị banyere ahụike gị, ka dọkịta na-awa ahụ wee dụọ gị ọdụ tupu ị gaa njem.
questionnaires.cosmetic-surgery.heading: Ajụjụ maka ịwa ahụ mma
questionnaires.cosmetic-surgery.intro: Gwa anyị ihe ị chọrọ ịgbanwe na ntakịrị banyere ahụike gị. Dọkịta na-awa ahụ plastik n'ụlọ ọgwụ anyị na ya na-arụkọ ọrụ ga-agụ azịza gị ma dụọ gị ọdụ banyere ihe o kwere omume.
questionnaires.cosmetic-surgery.sections: Akụkụ ahụ ole ka ị na-eche maka ha?
Ihu, nkpuchi anya ma ọ bụ egedege ihu
Liposuction ma ọ bụ ịkpụzi ahụ
N'okwu ole na ole, gịnị ka ị chọrọ ịgbanwe?
Dịka ọmụmaatụ: imi pere mpe nwere ọkpụkpụ kwụ ọtọ karịa
Ị wara ahụ mma na mbụ?
Ị nwere nke ọ bụla n'ime ndị a?
Nsogbu ọbara ọgbụgba ma ọ bụ ọbara ịkpụkọ
Ị dị ime, ị na-enye nwa ara, ma ọ bụ ị na-eme atụmatụ ịtụrụ ime n'ime otu afọ na-abịa?
Aha na ọnụọgụ ha, ma ọ bụrụ na ị ma ha
Ogologo oge ole ka ị nwere ike ịnọ n'India?
specialities.organ-transplant.name: Ntụgharị akụkụ ahụ
specialities.organ-transplant.summary: Ntụgharị akụrụ, imeju na akụkụ ahụ ndị ọzọ, nke na-esitekarị n'aka onye ezinụlọ dị ndụ nyere ya. Ndị otu ntụgharị na-enyocha onye ọrịa na onye na-enye ya, kọmitii ụlọ ọgwụ na-enyochakwa akwụkwọ tupu a hazie ihe ọ bụla.
specialities.oncology.name: Ọgwụgwọ kansa (oncology)
specialities.oncology.summary: Nlekọta kansa: ịwa ahụ, chemotherapy, ọgwụgwọ radieshọn na ọgwụgwọ ọhụrụ ndị ọzọ. Ndị otu dọkịta kansa na-agụ akwụkwọ nyocha ma jikọta aka hazie ọgwụgwọ.
specialities.haematology-bmt.name: Ọgwụgwọ ọrịa ọbara na ntụgharị ụmị ọkpụkpụ
specialities.haematology-bmt.summary: Nlekọta maka ọrịa ọbara na kansa ọbara, gụnyere ntụgharị ụmị ọkpụkpụ maka ndị okenye na ụmụaka.
specialities.neurology-neurosurgery.name: Ọgwụgwọ akwara ụbụrụ na ịwa ahụ ụbụrụ
specialities.neurology-neurosurgery.summ: Nlekọta na ịwa ahụ maka ụbụrụ, ọkpụkpụ azụ na akwara, site n'etuto ruo na nsogbu mmegharị ahụ.
specialities.bariatric-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ maka ibelata ibu (bariatric)
specialities.bariatric-surgery.summary: Ịwa ahụ na-enyere ndị nwere oke ibu aka ibelata ibu ma gbochie ya ịlaghachi, mgbe nri na mmega ahụ ezughị.
specialities.fertility-ivf.name: Ọmụmụ nwa na IVF
specialities.fertility-ivf.summary: Enyemaka maka di na nwunye na-anwa ịmụ nwa, gụnyere IVF na ICSI, mgbe e nyochachara ha abụọ.
specialities.orthopaedics.name: Ọgwụgwọ ọkpụkpụ (orthopaedics)
specialities.orthopaedics.summary: Ịwa ahụ maka ọkpụkpụ na nkwonkwo, dịka ngbanwe ukwu na ikpere na nrụzi mmerụ ahụ egwuregwu.
specialities.cardiology.name: Ọgwụgwọ obi na ịwa ahụ obi
specialities.cardiology.summary: Nyocha, usoro ọgwụgwọ na ịwa ahụ maka obi, site na angioplasty ruo na ịwa ahụ bypass na ngbanwe valvụ.
specialities.general-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ izugbe na nke obere oghere
specialities.general-surgery.summary: Ịwa ahụ a na-emekarị dịka iwepụ akpa nkụ (gallbladder), ịrụzi hernia na iwepụ appendix, nke a na-emekarị site n'obere oghere ma ọ bụ site na robot ka mgbake dị ngwa.
specialities.gastroenterology.name: Ọgwụgwọ afọ na imeju (gastroenterology)
specialities.gastroenterology.summary: Nyocha na ọgwụgwọ maka afọ, eriri afọ, imeju na pancreas, gụnyere endoscopy, ERCP na nlekọta maka abụba imeju na cirrhosis.
specialities.urology.name: Urology
specialities.urology.summary: Nlekọta maka akụrụ, eriri afọ mamịrị na prostate, na akụkụ ahụ ọmụmụ nwoke, site na nkume akụrụ ruo n'ịwa ahụ akụrụ na prostate site na robot.
specialities.gynaecology.name: Ọgwụgwọ ụmụ nwanyị (gynaecology)
specialities.gynaecology.summary: Nlekọta na ịwa ahụ maka akpanwa, akpa nwa (ovaries) na eriri akpanwa (fallopian tubes), nke a na-emekarị site n'obere oghere ma ọ bụ site na robot.
specialities.ent.name: Ntị, imi na akpịrị (ENT)
specialities.ent.summary: Ọgwụgwọ maka ntị, imi, sinus, akpịrị na igbe olu, gụnyere ịwa ahụ sinus.
specialities.cosmetic-plastic-surgery.na: Ịwa ahụ plastik, nrụzi na mma ahụ
specialities.cosmetic-plastic-surgery.su: Ịwa ahụ iji wughachi ma ọ bụ kpụgharịa ahụ na ihu, na ntụgharị ntutu, a na-ahazi mgbe gị na dọkịta na-awa ahụ kparịtara ụka.
specialities.ophthalmology.name: Ọgwụgwọ anya (ophthalmology)
specialities.ophthalmology.summary: Ịwa ahụ na nlekọta maka anya, site na cataract na LASIK ruo n'ọgwụgwọ cornea, glaucoma na retina, mgbe e nyochachara anya nke ọma.
specialities.dentistry.name: Ọgwụgwọ ezé
specialities.dentistry.summary: Implant, ọgwụgwọ root canal, braces na ọgwụgwọ ezé maka mma, a na-ahazi mgbe nlele na X-ray gasịrị.
treatments.kidney-transplant.name: Ntụgharị akụrụ
treatments.kidney-transplant.summary: Ịwa ahụ na-etinye akụrụ dị mma sitere n'aka onye nyere ya n'ime onye akụrụ nke ya kwụsịrị ịrụ ọrụ.
treatments.kidney-transplant.what: A na-etinye akụrụ dị mma sitere n'aka onye nyere ya n'akụkụ ala afọ ma jikọọ ya na akwara ọbara na eriri afọ mamịrị. A na-ahapụkarị akụrụ nke onye ahụ ebe ha dị. Onye na-enye ya na-abụkarị onye ezinụlọ dị ndụ; ebe ụdị ọbara ha adabaghị, ntụgharị mgbanwe (paired) ya na ezinụlọ ọzọ nwere ike mgbe ụfọdụ ime ka o kwe omume. Mgbe nke ahụ gasịrị, onye ọrịa na-aṅụ ọgwụ kwa ụbọchị ka ahụ ghara ịjụ akụrụ ọhụrụ ahụ.
treatments.kidney-transplant.who: Ndị akụrụ ha mebiri emebi (ọrịa akụrụ nke ọkwa ikpeazụ), ma ha amalitela dialysis ma ọ bụ na ha amalitebeghị, ndị ahụ ha siri ike nke ọma maka ịwa ahụ ma nwee onye kwesịrị ekwesị ga-enye ha.
treatments.kidney-transplant.stay: Ihe dị ka ụbọchị 8: 3 n'ICU na 5 n'ụlọ ndị ọrịa na Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.kidney-transplant.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'obere ọrụ kwa ụbọchị n'ime izu 4 ruo 6. Mee atụmatụ ịnọ n'India ihe dị ka izu 4 ruo 6 mgbe ịwa ahụ gasịrị maka nlele siri ike na nyocha ọbara.
treatments.kidney-transplant.faq.0.quest: Onye ezinụlọ m si n'obodo m nwere ike ịbụ onye ga-enye akụrụ?
treatments.kidney-transplant.faq.0.answe: Ee. Iwu India na-ekwe ka ndị ikwu dị nso dị ndụ nye akụkụ ahụ, kọmitii nkwado ụlọ ọgwụ na-enyochakwa akwụkwọ onye ọ bụla na-enye tupu ntụgharị ahụ. Anyị ga-enyere gị aka ịkwadebe akwụkwọ ndị a tupu ị gaa njem.
treatments.kidney-transplant.faq.1.quest: Ọ bụrụ na ụdị ọbara onye na-enye m adabaghị nke m ọ̀ bụ?
treatments.kidney-transplant.faq.1.answe: Ntụgharị mgbanwe (paired) ya na ezinụlọ ọzọ, ma ọ bụ ntụgharị n'agbanyeghị ụdị ọbara ya na ọgwụgwọ ọzọ tupu oge eruo, nwere ike ikwe omume. Ndị otu ntụgharị ga-ekpebi mgbe nyocha gasịrị.
treatments.dialysis.name: Dialysis (haemodialysis na haemodiafiltration)
treatments.dialysis.summary: Igwe na-asachapụ ọbara mgbe akụrụ enweghịzi ike ime ya, na-abụkarị n'oge ihe dị ka awa anọ, ugboro atọ n'izu.
treatments.dialysis.what: A na-agafe ọbara n'ihe nzacha dị n'èzí ahụ nke na-ewepụ unyi na mmiri karịrị akarị, wee laghachi ya n'ahụ. Haemodiafiltration bụ ụdị ọgwụgwọ a nke na-asacha nke ọma karịa. Enwekwara ike ime ya n'abalị (nocturnal dialysis) maka ụfọdụ ndị ọrịa.
treatments.dialysis.who: Ndị akụrụ ha mebiri emebi, gụnyere ndị na-eche ntụgharị, na ndị ọrịa nọworị na dialysis chọrọ ya mgbe ha nọ n'India maka ọgwụgwọ.
treatments.dialysis.stay: A na-emekarị ya dịka onye ọrịa nke ehihie: ị na-abịa maka oge ọ bụla ma laa n'ụlọ n'otu ụbọchị ahụ.
treatments.dialysis.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-ada mbà awa ole na ole mgbe dialysis gasịrị. Dialysis na-aga n'ihu ruo mgbe akụrụ anaghị arụ ọrụ, ma ọ bụ ruo mgbe ntụgharị.
treatments.dialysis.faq.0.question: Anọworị m na dialysis. Enwere m ike ịga n'ihu na ya n'India?
treatments.dialysis.faq.0.answer: Ee. Zitere anyị nkọwa dialysis gị ugbu a, anyị ga-edebere gị oge n'ụlọ ọgwụ maka oge niile ị ga-anọ.
treatments.dialysis.faq.1.question: Dialysis ọ na-anọchi ntụgharị?
treatments.dialysis.faq.1.answer: Mba. Dialysis na-arụ akụkụ nke ọrụ akụrụ. Ntụgharị, ebe o kwesịrị, na-enyekarị ndụ ka mma. Dọkịta akụrụ (nephrologist) ga-adụ gị ọdụ nke dabara gị.
treatments.liver-transplant.name: Ntụgharị imeju
treatments.liver-transplant.summary: Ịwa ahụ na-eji imeju dị mma, ma ọ bụ akụkụ ya, sitere n'aka onye nyere ya dochie imeju na-ada ada.
treatments.liver-transplant.what: A na-ewepụ imeju rịara ọrịa ma dochie ya na nke dị mma. Na ntụgharị site n'aka onye dị ndụ, onye ezinụlọ na-enye akụkụ imeju ya; akụkụ abụọ ahụ na-etolite ọzọ ruo ihe fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ nha zuru ezu n'ime izu ole na ole. Na ntụgharị site n'aka onye nwụrụ anwụ, a na-eji imeju zuru ezu.
treatments.liver-transplant.who: Ndị imeju ha na-ada n'ihi cirrhosis, hepatitis, mmanya na-aba n'anya ma ọ bụ ọrịa abụba imeju, ụfọdụ kansa imeju, ma ọ bụ ụfọdụ ọrịa a na-adịghị ahụkebe e ketara eketa, n'ime ndị okenye na ụmụaka.
treatments.liver-transplant.stay: Ihe dị ka ụbọchị 21 na Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.liver-transplant.recovery: Mee atụmatụ ịnọ n'India ihe dị ka ọnwa 2 ruo 3 n'ozuzu. Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi ná ndụ kwa ụbọchị nkịtị n'ime ọnwa 3 ruo 6, ha na-aṅụkwa ọgwụ mgbochi ịjụ akụkụ ahụ ndụ ha niile.
treatments.liver-transplant.faq.0.questi: Ogologo oge ole ka onye dị ndụ nyere imeju na-anọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ?
treatments.liver-transplant.faq.0.answer: Ọ na-abụkarị ihe dị ka ụbọchị 7 ruo 10, ọtụtụ ndị na-enye ya na-alaghachikwa ná ndụ nkịtị n'ime izu 6 ruo 8.
treatments.liver-transplant.faq.1.questi: Kedu nyocha a chọrọ tupu anyị agaa njem?
treatments.liver-transplant.faq.1.answer: Zitere anyị akwụkwọ nyocha, foto nyocha (scan) na nyocha ọbara ọhụrụ nke onye ọrịa, na ụdị ọbara ndị nwere ike inye ya. Ndị otu ntụgharị ga-agwa gị ihe ọzọ a chọrọ.
treatments.pancreas-transplant.name: Ntụgharị pancreas
treatments.pancreas-transplant.summary: Ịwa ahụ na-etinye pancreas dị mma sitere n'aka onye nyere ya n'ime onye nwere ọrịa shuga, ka ahụ ya malite ọzọ ịmepụta insulin nke ya. A na-emekarị ya ọnụ na ntụgharị akụrụ.
treatments.pancreas-transplant.what: A na-etinye pancreas sitere n'aka onye nwụrụ anwụ n'akụkụ ala afọ ma jikọọ ya na akwara ọbara na eriri afọ ma ọ bụ eriri afọ mamịrị. A na-ahapụ pancreas nke onye ahụ ebe ọ dị. Mgbe pancreas ọhụrụ ahụ malitere ịrụ ọrụ, a naghịzi achọ ịgba insulin. A na-emekarị ya n'otu oge ahụ na ntụgharị akụrụ.
treatments.pancreas-transplant.who: Ọkachasị ndị nwere ọrịa shuga ụdị 1: ndị na-anaghịzi ama ihe ịdọ aka ná ntị na shuga ọbara ha adala n'ụzọ dị egwu (hypoglycaemia unawareness), ndị akụrụ, akwara ma ọ bụ anya ha na-emebi n'agbanyeghị insulin, na ndị nwekwara ọrịa akụrụ na-adịghị ala ala. Ụfọdụ ndị nwere ọrịa shuga ụdị 2 kwesịkwara ekwesị. Ọrịa shuga ya na ọrịa akụrụ dị njọ: ihe ize ndụ ọnwụ dị ihe dị ka okpukpu abụọ nke ọrịa akụrụ naanị, ogologo ndụ n'ozuzu bụ ihe dị ka afọ 4 ruo 5, a na-atụfukwa ihe dị ka afọ 16 nke ndụ.
treatments.pancreas-transplant.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ihe dị ka izu 2 ruo 3 n'ụlọ ọgwụ, karịa mgbe e mere ya na ntụgharị akụrụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.pancreas-transplant.recovery: Mee atụmatụ ịnọ n'India ihe dị ka ọnwa 2 ruo 3. A na-aṅụ ọgwụ mgbochi ịjụ akụkụ ahụ ndụ niile.
treatments.pancreas-transplant.faq.0.ans: Ee. Pancreas ahụ na-esi n'aka onye nwụrụ anwụ, ya mere enwere ndepụta ndị na-eche. Ndị otu ahụ ga-akọwa otu o si arụ ọrụ maka ndị ọrịa si ná mba ọzọ.
treatments.pancreas-transplant.faq.1.ans: Ọ bụrụ na pancreas ọhụrụ ahụ na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma, mba. Ndị dọkịta gị ga-elele shuga ọbara gị nke ọma n'izu ole na ole mbụ.
treatments.intestine-transplant.name: Ntụgharị eriri afọ
treatments.intestine-transplant.summary: Ịwa ahụ na-eji eriri afọ dị mma sitere n'aka onye nyere ya dochie obere eriri afọ dara ada ma ọ bụ nke furu efu.
treatments.intestine-transplant.what: A na-ejikọ obere eriri afọ sitere n'aka onye nyere ya na akwara ọbara na eriri afọ onye ọrịa, ka o wee nwee ike ịmịkọrọ nri ọzọ ma kwụsị inweta nri site na drip. Ọ bụ otu n'ime ntụgharị kacha sie ike, ọ chọkwara nsochi siri ike ogologo oge.
treatments.intestine-transplant.who: N'ime ụmụaka, ọdịda eriri afọ mgbe necrotising enterocolitis (NEC), gastroschisis ma ọ bụ nsogbu mmegharị eriri afọ gasịrị. N'ime ndị okenye, mfu eriri afọ n'ihi mesenteric ischaemia (ọbara na-anaghị eru ya), midgut volvulus (eriri afọ gbagọrọ agbagọ) ma ọ bụ etuto nke mesentery.
treatments.intestine-transplant.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị izu 4 ruo 8 n'ụlọ ọgwụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.intestine-transplant.recovery: Mee atụmatụ ịnọ n'India ihe dị ka ọnwa 3 ma ọ bụ karịa. A na-eji nwayọọ eweghachi iri nri, a na-aṅụkwa ọgwụ mgbochi ịjụ akụkụ ahụ ndụ niile.
treatments.intestine-transplant.faq.0.qu: Onye ka ọ bụ maka ya ma ọ bụrụ na a na-enye m nri site na drip n'ụlọ?
treatments.intestine-transplant.faq.0.an: Ndị na-adabere na nri site na drip (parenteral nutrition) ma nwee nsogbu site na ya, dịka mmebi imeju ma ọ bụ ọrịa na-eso ọkpọkọ drip ugboro ugboro, ka a na-enyochakarị maka ntụgharị.
treatments.intestine-transplant.faq.1.an: Ee. A na-eme ọtụtụ ntụgharị eriri afọ n'ime ụmụaka. Ndị otu ahụ na-enyocha nwata ọ bụla iche iche.
treatments.hand-transplant.name: Ntụgharị aka
treatments.hand-transplant.summary: Ịwa ahụ na-ejikọ otu aka ma ọ bụ aka abụọ sitere n'aka onye nwụrụ anwụ nye onye tụfuru nke ya, na-ejikọ ọkpụkpụ, akwara ọbara, akwara ike (tendon), akwara mmetụta na akpụkpọ ahụ.
treatments.hand-transplant.what: Ntụgharị aka na-ebugharị akpụkpọ ahụ, anụ ahụ, tendon, ọkpụkpụ, akwara ọbara na akwara mmetụta ọnụ, ọ bụ ya mere a na-akpọ ya ntụgharị anụ ahụ jikọtara ọnụ (composite tissue transplant). Ndị dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-edozi ọkpụkpụ, jikọọ akwara ọbara, rụzie tendon ma jikọọ akwara mmetụta. Mgbe nke ahụ gasịrị, onye ọrịa na-aṅụ ọgwụ iji gbochie ahụ ịjụ aka ọhụrụ ahụ, ma na-eme physiotherapy ogologo oge. Mgbe ọ gara nke ọma, ntụgharị aka nwere ike iweghachi mmetụta, ịma ebe aka dị na mmegharị a na-achịkwa nke ọma karịa ihe aka arụrụ arụ nwere ike inye.
treatments.hand-transplant.who: Ndị tụfuru otu aka ma ọ bụ aka abụọ, mgbe e mechara nyocha ahụike, nke uche na nke usoro ahụ ji alụso ọrịa ọgụ nke ọma. A ga-achọta onye kwesịrị ekwesị ga-enye ya, ya mere enwekarị oge a ga-eche.
treatments.hand-transplant.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ihe dị ka izu 3 ruo 4 n'ụlọ ọgwụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.hand-transplant.recovery: Mee atụmatụ ịnọ n'India ihe dị ka ọnwa 3 ruo 6 maka ọgwụgwọ aka kwa ụbọchị. Mmegharị na mmetụta na-aga n'ihu na-aka mma ruo otu afọ ma ọ bụ afọ abụọ ka akwara mmetụta na-eto.
treatments.hand-transplant.faq.0.questio: Olee oge m ga-enwe ike iji aka ọhụrụ ahụ?
treatments.hand-transplant.faq.0.answer: Mmegharị dị mfe na-amalitekarị n'ime izu ole na ole. Mmetụta na njikwa nke ọma na-eji nwayọọ alaghachi n'ime ọtụtụ ọnwa, site n'ọgwụgwọ kwa ụbọchị.
treatments.hand-transplant.faq.1.questio: M ga-aṅụ ọgwụ ndụ m niile?
treatments.hand-transplant.faq.1.answer: Ee. Dịka ntụgharị ọ bụla, ọ chọrọ ọgwụ mgbochi ịjụ akụkụ ahụ kwa ụbọchị, na nlele mgbe niile.
treatments.bone-marrow-transplant.name: Ntụgharị ụmị ọkpụkpụ (ntụgharị stem cell)
treatments.bone-marrow-transplant.summar: Ọgwụgwọ na-eji stem cell dị mma na-emepụta ọbara dochie ụmị ọkpụkpụ mebiri emebi ma ọ bụ nke rịara ọrịa, a na-eji ya maka ụfọdụ kansa ọbara na ọrịa ọbara.
treatments.bone-marrow-transplant.what: Nke mbụ, chemotherapy siri ike, mgbe ụfọdụ ya na radieshọn, na-ekpochapụ ụmị ọkpụkpụ rịara ọrịa. E mesịa, a na-enye stem cell dị mma site na drip, dịka ịnye ọbara, ha na-ebikwa n'ọkpụkpụ ma mepụta ọbara ọhụrụ. Mkpụrụ ndụ ndị ahụ na-esi n'onwe onye ọrịa (autologous), n'aka onye na-enye ya dabara (allogeneic), ma ọ bụ n'aka onye ezinụlọ dabara ọkara (haploidentical), nke pụtara na ọtụtụ ndị ọrịa nwere ike ịchọta onye ga-enye ha.
treatments.bone-marrow-transplant.who: Ndị nwere ụfọdụ kansa ọbara, dịka leukaemia, lymphoma na myeloma, na ụfọdụ ọrịa ọbara, dịka thalassaemia, ọrịa sickle cell na aplastic anaemia, n'ime ndị okenye na ụmụaka.
treatments.bone-marrow-transplant.stay: Ihe dị ka ụbọchị 30 na Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.bone-marrow-transplant.recove: Mee atụmatụ ịnọ n'India ihe dị ka ọnwa 2 ruo 3 mgbe ntụgharị gasịrị maka nsochi siri ike. Usoro ahụ ji alụso ọrịa ọgụ na-ewe ọnwa 6 ruo 12 iji gbakee nke ọma.
Onye nwere ike ịbụ onye ga-enye m?

A na-ebu ụzọ nyochaa nwanne nwoke ma ọ bụ nwanne nwaanyị. Ọ bụrụ na ọ dịghị onye dabara nke ọma, nne ma ọ bụ nna, nwa ma ọ bụ nwanne dabara ọkara nwere ike inye ya. A na-eme nyocha tupu ị gaa njem ma ọ bụ obere oge mgbe i rutere.
Onye na-enye ya ọ ga-awa ahụ?
Ọ bụkarịghị. Taa, a na-anakọta ọtụtụ stem cell site n'ọbara onye na-enye ya site na drip, n'ime awa ole na ole.
treatments.car-t-cell-therapy.name: Ọgwụgwọ CAR-T cell (adoptive cell therapy)
treatments.car-t-cell-therapy.summary: A na-anakọta mkpụrụ ndụ nchekwa ahụ nke onye ọrịa n'onwe ya, gbanwee ha n'ụlọ nyocha ka ha mata kansa ya, wee weghachi ha site na drip. A na-eji ya maka ụfọdụ leukaemia, lymphoma na myeloma.
treatments.car-t-cell-therapy.what: A na-anakọta mkpụrụ ndụ ọbara ọcha a na-akpọ T cell site n'ọbara onye ọrịa. N'ụlọ nyocha, a na-enye ha onye nnata ọhụrụ (CAR) nke na-enyere ha aka ịchọta ma lụso kansa ahụ ọgụ. Mgbe obere usoro chemotherapy gasịrị, a na-eweghachi mkpụrụ ndụ ndị ahụ site na drip, ebe ha na-amụba ma lụso kansa ahụ ọgụ.
treatments.car-t-cell-therapy.who: Ndị okenye na ụfọdụ ụmụaka nwere ụfọdụ leukaemia, lymphoma ma ọ bụ multiple myeloma laghachiri ma ọ bụ na-anabataghị ọgwụgwọ ndị ọzọ.
treatments.car-t-cell-therapy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ihe dị ka izu 2 n'ụlọ ọgwụ mgbe e nyechara mkpụrụ ndụ ndị ahụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.car-t-cell-therapy.recovery: Mee atụmatụ ịnọ nso n'ụlọ ọgwụ ihe dị ka izu 4 mgbe e nyechara ya, n'ihi na mmetụta ndị ọzọ dịka ahụ ọkụ nwere ike ịpụta n'oge a. Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-ala n'ụlọ n'ime ọnwa 1 ruo 2.
treatments.car-t-cell-therapy.faq.0.ques: Ogologo oge ole ka ọ na-ewe ịmepụta mkpụrụ ndụ ndị ahụ?
treatments.car-t-cell-therapy.faq.0.answ: Ọ na-abụkarị izu ole na ole site na nnakọta ruo na nnye. Dọkịta gị nwere ike inye ọgwụgwọ ọzọ ka ị na-eche.
treatments.car-t-cell-therapy.faq.1.ques: Kedu isi mmetụta ndị ọzọ ya?
treatments.car-t-cell-therapy.faq.1.answ: Ahụ ọkụ, ọbara mgbali dị ala na, mgbe ụfọdụ, mgbagwoju anya n'izu ole na ole mbụ. Ndị otu ahụ na-elele nke ọma ma na-agwọ ha n'oge.
treatments.childhood-cancer-treatment.na: Ọgwụgwọ kansa na ọrịa ọbara ụmụaka
treatments.childhood-cancer-treatment.su: Nlekọta maka ụmụaka nwere leukaemia, lymphoma, etuto siri ike na ọrịa ọbara na-abụghị kansa, nke ndị dọkịta na-agwọ naanị ụmụaka hazịrị.
treatments.childhood-cancer-treatment.wh: Dọkịta ọkachamara n'ọrịa ọbara na kansa ụmụaka (paediatric haemato-oncologist) na-ahazi ọgwụgwọ ahụ niile, nke nwere ike ijikọ chemotherapy, ịwa ahụ, radiotherapy na ntụgharị ụmị ọkpụkpụ. Ọnụọgụ ọgwụ na nlekọta na-adaba nwata na-eto eto, ya na nkwado maka ezinụlọ n'oge niile.
Ụmụaka nwere kansa ọbara dịka leukaemia na lymphoma, etuto siri ike, ma ọ bụ ọrịa ọbara dịka thalassaemia na aplastic anaemia.
treatments.childhood-cancer-treatment.st: Ọ dabere n'atụmatụ ọgwụgwọ. Ọtụtụ chemotherapy bụ nke ehihie; ntụgharị ụmị ọkpụkpụ chọrọ ihe dị ka otu ọnwa n'ụlọ ọgwụ.
treatments.childhood-cancer-treatment.re: Ọgwụgwọ na-ewekarị ọtụtụ ọnwa. Dọkịta ga-akọwa akụkụ ndị a ga-eme n'India na ndị nwere ike ịga n'ihu n'ụlọ.
treatments.childhood-cancer-treatment.fa: Otu nne ma ọ bụ nna nwere ike iso nwata ahụ nọrọ?
Ee. Nne ma ọ bụ nna nwere ike iso nwata ahụ nọrọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ. Anyị na-enyere aka n'ebe obibi dị nso maka ndị ezinụlọ fọdụrụ.
Akụkụ ọgwụgwọ ahụ nwere ike ịga n'ihu n'ụlọ?
Ọtụtụ mgbe, ee. Dọkịta nwere ike ịkọrọ dọkịta nọ n'obodo gị atụmatụ ahụ maka akụkụ ndị enwere ike ime n'ụlọ n'enweghị ihe ize ndụ.
treatments.chemotherapy.name: Chemotherapy
treatments.chemotherapy.summary: Ọgwụ na-egbu mkpụrụ ndụ kansa ma ọ bụ na-egbochi ha ito, a na-enye site na drip, ịgba ọgwụ ma ọ bụ mkpụrụ ọgwụ n'usoro oge dị iche iche.
treatments.chemotherapy.what: Dọkịta kansa (medical oncologist) na-ahọrọ ọgwụ, ọnụọgụ na oge dabara ụdị na ọkwa kansa ahụ. A na-enyekarị ọgwụgwọ ahụ n'okirikiri, ya na izu ezumike n'etiti ka ahụ wee gbakee. Enwere ike inye ya tupu ịwa ahụ iji mee ka etuto belata, mgbe ịwa ahụ gasịrị iji belata ohere ọ ga-eji laghachi, ma ọ bụ naanị ya.
treatments.chemotherapy.who: Ndị nwere ọtụtụ ụdị kansa, gụnyere kansa ara, ngụgụ, eriri afọ, akpa nwa (ovary), isi na olu, ọbara na ọkpụkpụ. Dọkịta kansa gị ga-ekpebi ma ọ dabara okwu gị.
treatments.chemotherapy.stay: Ọtụtụ oge bụ nke ehihie: ị na-abịa, nweta drip ahụ ma laa n'ụlọ n'otu ụbọchị ahụ.
treatments.chemotherapy.recovery: Ike ọgwụgwụ na mmetụta ndị ọzọ na-ebelatakarị n'ime ụbọchị ole na ole ruo izu ole na ole mgbe okirikiri ọ bụla gasịrị. Usoro zuru ezu na-ewekarị ọnwa 3 ruo 6.
treatments.chemotherapy.faq.0.question: Ọ dị mkpa ka m nọrọ n'India maka usoro ahụ niile?
treatments.chemotherapy.faq.0.answer: Ọ bụghị mgbe niile. Ọtụtụ mgbe, a na-enye okirikiri mbụ n'India, ndị fọdụrụ nwere ike ịga n'ihu n'ụlọ, a na-ekesakwa atụmatụ ahụ na dọkịta kansa nọ n'obodo gị.
treatments.chemotherapy.faq.1.question: Ntutu isi m ga-agbapụ?
treatments.chemotherapy.faq.1.answer: Na ụfọdụ ọgwụ, ee, ọ na-etokwa ọzọ mgbe ọgwụgwọ gasịrị. Ọtụtụ ọgwụ ọgbara ọhụrụ anaghị eme ka ntutu gbapụ.
treatments.targeted-therapy-immunotherap: Ọgwụ kansa ọhụrụ na-awakpo otu adịghị ike a kapịrị ọnụ n'ime kansa ahụ, ma ọ bụ na-enyere usoro ahụ ji alụso ọrịa ọgụ aka ịlụso ya ọgụ.

Nyocha e mere n'etuto ahụ na-achọ mgbanwe n'ime mkpụrụ ndụ ihe nketa (genes) ma ọ bụ protein ya. Ọgwụ targeted na-egbochi mgbanwe ndị ahụ, ya mere ha na-arụ ọrụ ọkachasị na mkpụrụ ndụ kansa. Immunotherapy na-enyere usoro ahụ ji alụso ọrịa ọgụ aka ịmata ma wakpo kansa ahụ. A na-akpọkarị ha precision ma ọ bụ molecular oncology, a na-enyekwa ha site na drip ma ọ bụ dịka mkpụrụ ọgwụ.
Ndị kansa ha gosiri mgbanwe dabara adaba na nyocha, ma ọ bụ ndị ụdị kansa ha a maara na ọ na-anabata ya, dịka ụfọdụ kansa ngụgụ, ara, akụrụ, eriri afọ, akpụkpọ ahụ na isi na olu.
Ọ na-abụkarị nke ehihie, ma ọ bụ mkpụrụ ọgwụ a na-aṅụ n'ụlọ.
Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-aga n'ihu ná ndụ kwa ụbọchị nkịtị ha n'oge ọgwụgwọ, ya na nlele na foto nyocha (scan) mgbe niile.
Kedu ka m ga-esi mara ma ọ dabara m?
Dọkịta kansa gị ga-elele nsonaazụ nyocha etuto gị. Ọ bụrụ na e meghị nyocha ahụ, enwere ike ime ya ọtụtụ mgbe na biopsy i nweburu.
Ọ bụ otu ihe ahụ na chemotherapy?
Mba. Ọ na-arụ ọrụ n'ụzọ dị iche, ọ na-enwekarịkwa mmetụta ndị ọzọ dị iche, nke na-adịkarị nro. Mgbe ụfọdụ, a na-enye ya ọnụ na chemotherapy.
treatments.radiation-therapy.name: Ọgwụgwọ radieshọn (external beam, EBRT)
treatments.radiation-therapy.summary: Ọgwụgwọ na-eji ụzarị ike dị elu a na-eche nke ọma ebibi mkpụrụ ndụ kansa n'otu akụkụ ahụ.
treatments.radiation-therapy.what: Foto nyocha (scan) maka nhazi na-egosi ebe etuto ahụ dị, igwe wee na-eche ụzarị n'ebe ọ dị site n'akụkụ dị iche iche, na-echebe anụ ahụ dị mma gbara ya gburugburu dị ka o kwere omume. Oge ọ bụla na-ewe nkeji ole na ole, ọ dịghịkwa egbu mgbu. A na-enyekarị ọgwụgwọ ahụ n'ụbọchị ọrụ maka otu izu ruo ọtụtụ izu.
treatments.radiation-therapy.who: Ndị nwere ọtụtụ ụdị kansa, naanị ya ma ọ bụ ya na ịwa ahụ na chemotherapy, mgbe ụfọdụ kwa iji belata mgbu sitere na kansa gbasaala.
treatments.radiation-therapy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị na ị gaghị anọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ: ị na-abịa maka oge mkpụmkpụ ọ bụla.
treatments.radiation-therapy.recovery: Ike ọgwụgwụ na mgbu akpụkpọ ahụ n'ebe a gwọrọ bụ ihe a na-ahụkarị, ha na-adakwa n'ime izu ole na ole mgbe usoro ahụ gasịrị.
treatments.radiation-therapy.faq.0.answe: Mba. Na radiotherapy ụzarị si n'èzí, ahụ gị anaghị enwe radieshọn, ọ dịkwa mma ịnọnyere ezinụlọ gị.
treatments.radiation-therapy.faq.1.quest: Ogologo oge ole ka m ga-anọ n'India?
treatments.radiation-therapy.faq.1.answe: Ogologo oge usoro ahụ na-ewe, nke na-abụkarị izu 1 ruo 7, gbakwunye ụbọchị ole na ole maka nhazi. Dọkịta gị ga-agwa gị kpọmkwem ogologo oge ya.
treatments.cancer-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ kansa (surgical oncology)
treatments.cancer-surgery.summary: Ịwa ahụ iji wepụ etuto na, ebe ọ dị mkpa, anụ ahụ dị nso ma ọ bụ lymph node.
treatments.cancer-surgery.what: Dọkịta na-awa ahụ kansa na-ewepụ etuto ahụ ya na oke anụ ahụ dị mma, ọtụtụ mgbe kwa lymph node dị nso iji lelee ma o gbasaala. Ebe ọ dabara okwu ahụ, a na-eme ya site n'obere oghere (laparoscopic) ma ọ bụ site na robot, nke na-apụtakarị obere ọnya na mgbake ngwa ngwa. A na-enyocha anụ ahụ e wepụrụ iji hazie ọgwụgwọ ọ bụla ọzọ.
treatments.cancer-surgery.who: Ndị nwere etuto siri ike, dịka kansa isi na olu, ara, afọ, eriri afọ, imeju, pancreas, akụrụ, eriri afọ mamịrị, prostate, akpa nwa, ovary, ọkpụkpụ na anụ ahụ dị nro.
treatments.cancer-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 2 ruo 10 n'ụlọ ọgwụ, dabere n'ịwa ahụ ahụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.cancer-surgery.recovery: Site n'izu 2 maka obere ịwa ahụ ruo izu 6 ruo 8 maka nnukwu ndị. Mee atụmatụ ịnọ n'India ruo mgbe a lechara ebe a kwachiri akwachi ma kparịta nsonaazụ nyocha ahụ.
treatments.cancer-surgery.faq.0.question: M ga-achọ ọgwụgwọ ọzọ mgbe ịwa ahụ gasịrị?
treatments.cancer-surgery.faq.0.answer: Mgbe ụfọdụ. Nsonaazụ nyocha anụ ahụ e wepụrụ na-egosi ma chemotherapy ma ọ bụ radiotherapy ga-enyere aka. Ndị otu ahụ ga-esoro gị kparịta nke a tupu ị laa n'ụlọ.
treatments.cancer-surgery.faq.1.question: Enwere ike iji robot mee ya?
treatments.cancer-surgery.faq.1.answer: Maka ọtụtụ kansa, ee. Dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-ekpebi dabere n'etuto ahụ na foto nyocha gị.
treatments.head-neck-cancer-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ kansa isi na olu
treatments.head-neck-cancer-surgery.summ: Ịwa ahụ maka kansa ọnụ, ire, akpịrị, igbe olu, gland ọnụ mmiri na sinus, na-echekwa ikwu okwu na ilo ihe ebe ọ bụla o kwere omume.
treatments.head-neck-cancer-surgery.what: A na-ewepụ etuto ahụ, ọtụtụ mgbe ya na lymph node dị n'olu. Ebe ọ dabara okwu ahụ, a na-eme ya site n'ọnụ site na laser ma ọ bụ robot (transoral surgery), na-ezere nnukwu ọnya. Mgbe igbe olu metụtara, a na-ahọrọ ịwa ahụ na-echekwa olu ebe o kwere omume, a na-enyekwa ọgwụgwọ iweghachi olu mgbe o kweghị omume. Nrụzi nwere ike iwughachi ebe ahụ n'otu ịwa ahụ ahụ.
treatments.head-neck-cancer-surgery.who: Ndị nwere kansa ọnụ, ire, ntì ihu, akpịrị, igbe olu (larynx), gland ọnụ mmiri, imi ma ọ bụ sinus.
treatments.head-neck-cancer-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 3 ruo 10 n'ụlọ ọgwụ, karịa ma ọ bụrụ na a chọrọ nrụzi. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.head-neck-cancer-surgery.reco: Ọ na-abụkarị izu 3 ruo 6. Enwere ike ịchọ ọgwụgwọ ikwu okwu na ilo ihe. Mgbe ụfọdụ, a na-enye radiotherapy ma emechaa.
M ga-enwe ike ikwu okwu na iri nri nke ọma?
Dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-achọ ichekwa ikwu okwu na ilo ihe ebe ọ bụla o kwere omume, ndị ọkachamara ọgwụgwọ na-enyekwa gị aka iweghachi ha mgbe ịwa ahụ gasịrị.
Ịwa ahụ e mere site n'ọnụ meghere emeghe site n'iji aka robot ma ọ bụ laser, ya mere ọ dịghị ọnya n'ihu ma ọ bụ n'olu maka etuto ahụ n'onwe ya.
treatments.thyroid-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ thyroid na parathyroid (thyroidectomy)
treatments.thyroid-surgery.summary: Ịwa ahụ iji wepụ akụkụ ma ọ bụ thyroid niile ma ọ bụ gland parathyroid dị n'olu, maka kansa, nnukwu akpụ ma ọ bụ gland na-arụ ọrụ karịa akarị.
treatments.thyroid-surgery.what: Site n'obere ọnya n'ihu olu, dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-ewepụ ọkara ma ọ bụ gland thyroid niile, ma ọ bụ gland parathyroid na-arụ ọrụ karịa akarị, na-akpachara anya ichebe akwara na-aga n'igbe olu. Ọ bụrụ na e wepụ thyroid niile, mkpụrụ ọgwụ kwa ụbọchị na-anọchi hormone ya.
treatments.thyroid-surgery.who: Ndị nwere kansa thyroid, akpụ thyroid buru ibu ma ọ bụ nke a na-enyo enyo, thyroid na-arụ ọrụ karịa akarị nke na-anaghị ada site n'ọgwụ, ma ọ bụ gland parathyroid na-arụ ọrụ karịa akarị.
treatments.thyroid-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 1 ruo 3 n'ụlọ ọgwụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.thyroid-surgery.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 1 ruo 2.
treatments.thyroid-surgery.faq.0.answer: Ọ dịkarịghị. Dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-echebe akwara olu, olu ọ bụla dara mgbe ịwa ahụ gasịrị na-adịkarị mma n'ime izu ole na ole.
treatments.thyroid-surgery.faq.1.questio: M ga-aṅụ mkpụrụ ọgwụ ma emechaa?
treatments.thyroid-surgery.faq.1.answer: Ọ bụrụ na e wepụ thyroid niile, ee, mkpụrụ ọgwụ hormone thyroid kwa ụbọchị ndụ gị niile. Ọ bụrụ na e wepụ ọkara, ọtụtụ mgbe mba.
treatments.breast-cancer-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ kansa ara
treatments.breast-cancer-surgery.summary: Ịwa ahụ iji wepụ kansa ara, na-echekwa ara ma ọ bụ na-arụzi ya ebe ọ bụla o kwere omume.
treatments.breast-cancer-surgery.what: Ebe ọ dị mma, a na-ewepụ naanị etuto ahụ na oke gbara ya gburugburu (ịwa ahụ na-echekwa ara), a na-akpụgharịkwa ara ahụ n'otu ịwa ahụ ahụ (oncoplastic surgery). Ebe a ga-ewepụrịrị ara niile (mastectomy), enwere ike ọtụtụ mgbe iwughachi ya. A na-elele lymph node dị n'okpuru aka, na-ejikarị obere ịwa ahụ maka iwere ihe nlele. Enwere ike iji vacuum-assisted biopsy chọpụta ma ọ bụ wepụ obere akpụ n'emegheghị ahụ.
treatments.breast-cancer-surgery.who: Ụmụ nwaanyị, na mgbe ụfọdụ ụmụ nwoke, nwere kansa ara, na ndị ezinụlọ ha nwere akụkọ siri ike banyere ya, ndị nyocha mkpụrụ ndụ ihe nketa (genetic testing) nwere ike ịbara uru.
treatments.breast-cancer-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 1 ruo 3 n'ụlọ ọgwụ, karịa ya na nrụzi. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.breast-cancer-surgery.recover: Ọ na-abụkarị izu 2 ruo 4. Chemotherapy, radiotherapy ma ọ bụ mkpụrụ ọgwụ hormone nwere ike iso ya, dabere na nsonaazụ nyocha.
treatments.breast-cancer-surgery.faq.0.q: Enwere m ike idobe ara m?
treatments.breast-cancer-surgery.faq.0.a: Ọtụtụ mgbe, ee, ọkachasị mgbe etuto ahụ pere mpe ma e jiri ya tụnyere ara ahụ, ma ọ bụ mgbe chemotherapy mere ka ọ belata. Dọkịta na-awa ahụ ga-adụ gị ọdụ mgbe ọ lechara foto nyocha gị.
treatments.breast-cancer-surgery.faq.1.q: Ekwesịrị m ime nyocha mkpụrụ ndụ ihe nketa?
treatments.breast-cancer-surgery.faq.1.a: Ọ bụrụ na a chọpụtara ọrịa ahụ mgbe ị ka na-eto eto ma ọ bụ i nwere ndị ikwu dị nso nwere kansa ara ma ọ bụ ovary, nyocha nwere ike inye aka n'ịhazi ọgwụgwọ gị. Dọkịta ga-adụ gị ọdụ.
treatments.hpb-cancer-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ kansa imeju, pancreas na ọwa bile (gụnyere Whipple)
treatments.hpb-cancer-surgery.summary: Ịwa ahụ iji wepụ kansa imeju, pancreas, ọwa bile na akpa bile, gụnyere ịwa ahụ Whipple maka pancreas.
treatments.hpb-cancer-surgery.what: Enwere ike iwepụ akụkụ imeju n'enweghị ihe ize ndụ, akụkụ fọdụrụ na-etolitekwa ọzọ. Maka kansa dị n'isi pancreas, ịwa ahụ Whipple (pancreaticoduodenectomy) na-ewepụ ya ya na akụkụ eriri afọ na ọwa bile, wee jikọọ ha ọzọ. Ebe etuto metụtara nnukwu akwara ọbara, enwere ike iwepụ ha ma wughachi ha n'otu ịwa ahụ ahụ. Enwere ike ime ọtụtụ n'ime ịwa ahụ ndị a site n'obere oghere ma ọ bụ site na robot.
treatments.hpb-cancer-surgery.who: Ndị nwere kansa imeju, ọwa bile, akpa bile ma ọ bụ pancreas, na kansa gbasara n'imeju site n'eriri afọ, mgbe foto nyocha gosiri na enwere ike iwepụ etuto ahụ.
treatments.hpb-cancer-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 7 ruo 14 n'ụlọ ọgwụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.hpb-cancer-surgery.recovery: Ọ na-abụkarị izu 6 ruo 8. Mee atụmatụ ịnọ n'India ihe dị ka izu 3 ruo 4 mgbe ịwa ahụ gasịrị.
treatments.hpb-cancer-surgery.faq.0.ques: Enwere m ike ibi ndụ nkịtị mgbe e wepụrụ akụkụ imeju m?
treatments.hpb-cancer-surgery.faq.0.answ: Ee. Imeju na-etolite ọzọ ruo ihe fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ nha zuru ezu n'ime izu ole na ole, ma ọ bụrụhaala na akụkụ fọdụrụ dị mma.
treatments.hpb-cancer-surgery.faq.1.answ: Ịwa ahụ na-ewepụ isi pancreas, akụkụ obere eriri afọ, akpa bile na akụkụ ọwa bile, wee jikọọ ha ọzọ. Ọ bụ isi ịwa ahụ maka kansa n'ebe ahụ.
treatments.gi-cancer-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ kansa afọ, eriri afọ na ọkpọkọ nri
treatments.gi-cancer-surgery.summary: Ịwa ahụ iji wepụ kansa ọkpọkọ nri (oesophagus), afọ, obere eriri afọ, colon na rectum.
treatments.gi-cancer-surgery.what: A na-ewepụ akụkụ eriri afọ nwere kansa ahụ ya na lymph node ya, a na-ejikọkwa nsọtụ ya ọzọ. Enwere ike ime ọtụtụ n'ime ịwa ahụ ndị a site n'obere oghere ma ọ bụ site na robot. Maka kansa rectum, dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-achọ idobe njikwa nsị nkịtị ebe ọ bụla o kwere omume.
treatments.gi-cancer-surgery.who: Ndị nwere kansa oesophagus, afọ, obere eriri afọ, colon ma ọ bụ rectum, na ụfọdụ etuto afọ dịka sarcoma.
treatments.gi-cancer-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 5 ruo 10 n'ụlọ ọgwụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.gi-cancer-surgery.recovery: Ọ na-abụkarị izu 4 ruo 8. Iri nri na-eji nwayọọ alaghachi, ya na ndụmọdụ sitere n'aka ọkachamara nri.
treatments.gi-cancer-surgery.faq.0.answe: Ọ bụghị mgbe niile. Mgbe ụfọdụ, stoma nwa oge na-echebe njikọ ahụ ka ọ na-agwọ, a na-emechikwa ya ọnwa ole na ole ma emechaa. Dọkịta na-awa ahụ ga-agwa gị tupu ịwa ahụ.
treatments.gi-cancer-surgery.faq.1.answe: Ọtụtụ mgbe, tupu ma ọ bụ mgbe ịwa ahụ gasịrị, dabere n'ọkwa ọrịa ahụ. Ndị otu ahụ na-ejikọ aka hazie ya.
treatments.hipec.name: Cytoreductive surgery na HIPEC
treatments.hipec.summary: Ịwa ahụ na-ewepụ kansa niile a na-ahụ anya n'ime afọ, nke chemotherapy e kpụrụ ọkụ a na-asachapụ n'ime afọ n'otu ịwa ahụ ahụ na-eso.
treatments.hipec.what: Dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-ewepụ etuto ọ bụla a na-ahụ anya site n'akpụkpọ dị n'ime afọ (cytoreductive surgery). E mesịa, ka a ka nọ n'ụlọ ịwa ahụ, a na-agbagharị chemotherapy e kpụrụ ọkụ n'ime afọ ihe dị ka otu awa (HIPEC) iji gwọọ mkpụrụ ndụ kansa dị obere nke na-enweghị ike ịhụ anya. Okpomọkụ na-enyere ọgwụ ahụ aka ịrụ ọrụ nke ọma, ọ bụkwa ntakịrị n'ime ya na-eru akụkụ ahụ ndị ọzọ.
treatments.hipec.who: Ndị a họọrọ nwere kansa gbasara n'akpụkpọ dị n'ime afọ (peritoneum) site na ovary, eriri afọ, appendix ma ọ bụ afọ, na ndị nwere peritoneal mesothelioma ma ọ bụ pseudomyxoma.
treatments.hipec.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 10 ruo 14 n'ụlọ ọgwụ, ya na ụbọchị ole na ole n'ICU. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.hipec.recovery: Ọ na-abụkarị izu 6 ruo 12. Mee atụmatụ ịnọ n'India ihe dị ka izu 4 mgbe ịwa ahụ gasịrị.
treatments.hipec.faq.0.question: Onye ọ bụla kansa ya gbasara n'afọ ọ kwesịrị ya?
treatments.hipec.faq.0.answer: Mba. Ndị otu ahụ na-enyocha foto nyocha gị na ahụike gị iji hụ ma enwere ike iwepụ kansa niile a na-ahụ anya, nke bụ mgbe HIPEC na-enyere aka karịa.
treatments.hipec.faq.1.question: Ọ bụ ịwa ahụ na-ewe ogologo oge?
treatments.hipec.faq.1.answer: Ee, ọtụtụ mgbe awa 8 ruo 12. A na-eme ya naanị n'ebe pụrụ iche nwere ndị otu nwere ahụmahụ.
treatments.urologic-cancer-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ kansa akụrụ, eriri afọ mamịrị na prostate
treatments.urologic-cancer-surgery.summa: Ịwa ahụ maka kansa akụrụ, eriri afọ mamịrị, prostate, akpa amụ na gland adrenal, a na-ejikarị robot eme ya.
treatments.urologic-cancer-surgery.what: Dabere na kansa ahụ, dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-ewepụ etuto ahụ ya na akụkụ akụrụ (na-eme ka nke fọdụrụ na-arụ ọrụ) ma ọ bụ akụrụ niile, prostate, ma ọ bụ eriri afọ mamịrị. Mgbe e wepụrụ eriri afọ mamịrị, a na-eme ụzọ ọhụrụ e ji amamịrị, mgbe ụfọdụ eriri afọ mamịrị ọhụrụ e ji eriri afọ mee. A na-eji ịwa ahụ robot ebe ọ dabara, dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-achọkwa idobe njikwa mamịrị na ọrụ mmekọahụ ebe ọ bụla o kwere omume.
treatments.urologic-cancer-surgery.who: Ndị nwere kansa akụrụ, eriri afọ mamịrị, prostate, akpa amụ, amụ nwoke ma ọ bụ gland adrenal.
treatments.urologic-cancer-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 3 ruo 10 n'ụlọ ọgwụ, dabere n'ịwa ahụ ahụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.urologic-cancer-surgery.faq.0: Enwere ike idobe akụkụ akụrụ m?
Ọtụtụ mgbe, maka obere etuto. Iwepụ naanị etuto ahụ (partial nephrectomy) na-echekwa ọrụ akụrụ karịa.
treatments.urologic-cancer-surgery.faq.1: Ịwa ahụ prostate ọ ga-emetụta njikwa mamịrị?
Mamịrị na-agbapụ ntakịrị bụ ihe a na-ahụkarị na mbụ, ọ na-akakwa mma n'ime izu ole na ole ruo ọnwa ole na ole, site na mmega ahụ. Dọkịta na-awa ahụ ga-akọwa ihe ize ndụ nke gị.
treatments.gynaecologic-cancer-surgery.n: Ịwa ahụ kansa ovary, akpa nwa na ọnụ akpa nwa
treatments.gynaecologic-cancer-surgery.s: Ịwa ahụ maka kansa ovary, akpa nwa (uterus), ọnụ akpa nwa (cervix) na vulva, na-echekwa ike ịmụ nwa ebe ọ dị mma.
treatments.gynaecologic-cancer-surgery.w: Dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-ewepụ kansa ahụ na, ebe ọ dị mkpa, akpa nwa, ovary na lymph node dị nso. Maka kansa ovary gbasaala, ịwa ahụ sara mbara (ultra-radical) na-achọ iwepụ ọrịa niile a na-ahụ anya. N'ime ụmụ agbọghọ nwere kansa n'oge mmalite, ịwa ahụ na-echekwa ike ịmụ nwa nwere ike idobe akpa nwa ma ọ bụ otu ovary. A na-eji ịwa ahụ site n'obere oghere na site na robot ebe ha dabara.
Ụmụ nwaanyị nwere kansa ovary, akpa nwa, ọnụ akpa nwa ma ọ bụ vulva, na ụfọdụ sarcoma nke akụkụ ọmụmụ nwaanyị.
treatments.gynaecologic-cancer-surgery.s: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 3 ruo 10 n'ụlọ ọgwụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.gynaecologic-cancer-surgery.r: Ọ na-abụkarị izu 4 ruo 6. Chemotherapy ma ọ bụ radiotherapy nwere ike iso ya.
treatments.gynaecologic-cancer-surgery.f: M ka nwere ike ịmụ ụmụ?
Mgbe ụfọdụ, maka kansa n'oge mmalite n'ime ụmụ agbọghọ. Gwa dọkịta ma nke a dị gị mkpa, ka ọ bụrụ akụkụ nke atụmatụ ahụ site ná mmalite.
A na-enye chemotherapy tupu ịwa ahụ?
Maka ụfọdụ kansa ovary gbasaala, ee, iji buru ụzọ mee ka ọrịa ahụ belata. Ndị otu ahụ na-ekpebi site na foto nyocha gị.
treatments.bone-cancer-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ kansa ọkpụkpụ (ichekwa aka ma ọ bụ ụkwụ)
treatments.bone-cancer-surgery.summary: Ịwa ahụ na-ewepụ etuto ọkpụkpụ ma ọ bụ nke anụ ahụ dị nro ma na-echekwa aka ma ọ bụ ụkwụ, kama ịbipụ ya.
treatments.bone-cancer-surgery.what: A na-ewepụ etuto ahụ ya na oke anụ ahụ dị mma, a na-ewughachikwa ọkpụkpụ furu efu site n'ihe ígwè a na-etinye n'ahụ (endoprosthesis), ọkpụkpụ sitere n'ụlọ akụ ọkpụkpụ, ma ọ bụ ọkpụkpụ onye ọrịa n'onwe ya. Taa, ọtụtụ ndị nwere kansa ọkpụkpụ na-edobe aka ma ọ bụ ụkwụ ha. A na-enyekarị chemotherapy tupu na mgbe ịwa ahụ gasịrị.
treatments.bone-cancer-surgery.who: Ụmụaka na ndị okenye nwere kansa ọkpụkpụ dịka osteosarcoma na Ewing's sarcoma, sarcoma anụ ahụ dị nro, ụfọdụ etuto ọkpụkpụ na-abụghị kansa mana na-eme ihe ike, na kansa gbasara n'ọkpụkpụ.
treatments.bone-cancer-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 5 ruo 10 n'ụlọ ọgwụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.bone-cancer-surgery.recovery: Ọ na-abụkarị izu 6 ruo 12, ya na physiotherapy iji jee ije ma ọ bụ jiri aka ọzọ.
treatments.bone-cancer-surgery.faq.0.ans: N'ọtụtụ ọnọdụ, mba. Ichekwa aka ma ọ bụ ụkwụ kwere omume maka ọtụtụ etuto ọkpụkpụ. Dọkịta na-awa ahụ ga-agwa gị mgbe ọ lechara foto nyocha gị.
treatments.bone-cancer-surgery.faq.1.que: Ogologo oge ole ka ihe a tinyere n'ahụ na-adịgide?
treatments.bone-cancer-surgery.faq.1.ans: Ọtụtụ na-adịgide ọtụtụ afọ. Ụfọdụ nwere ike ịchọ ngbanwe ma emechaa, ọkachasị n'ime ụmụaka ka na-eto.
treatments.liver-tumour-embolisation.sum: Site n'obere oghere dị ka isi ntụtụ n'ukwu ma ọ bụ n'nkwonkwo aka, a na-eduga obere ọkpọkọ na akwara ọbara na-enye etuto imeju nri, a na-ezigakwa chemotherapy (TACE) ma ọ bụ obere mkpụrụ nwere radieshọn (TARE) ozugbo n'ime ya.
treatments.liver-tumour-embolisation.wha: Dọkịta ọkachamara interventional radiology na-eduga obere ọkpọkọ site n'akwara ọbara ruo n'imeju site n'iji foto X-ray. Na TACE (chemoembolisation), a na-ezigara chemotherapy n'ime etuto ahụ ma gbochie ọbara na-eru ya. Na TARE (radioembolisation), a na-ezigara obere mkpụrụ na-ebu radieshọn kama. Ọ dịghị imeghe ahụ, naanị obere oghere dị ka isi ntụtụ.
treatments.liver-tumour-embolisation.who: Ndị nwere kansa imeju, ma ọ bụ kansa gbasara n'imeju, nke enweghị ike iwepụ site n'ịwa ahụ, ma ọ bụ dịka akwa mmiri ruo n'ịwa ahụ ma ọ bụ ntụgharị.
treatments.liver-tumour-embolisation.sta: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 1 ruo 2 n'ụlọ ọgwụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.liver-tumour-embolisation.rec: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-ada mbà, ya na ntakịrị mgbu ma ọ bụ ahụ ọkụ, ihe dị ka otu izu, wee laghachi ná ndụ nkịtị.
treatments.liver-tumour-embolisation.faq: A na-eme ya site n'ọgwụ mgbochi mgbu n'ebe ahụ na ọgwụ na-eme ka obi dajụọ. Ntakịrị mgbu na ahụ ọkụ mgbe e mechara ya bụ ihe a na-ahụkarị, a na-ejikwa ọgwụ agwọ ha.
Mgbe ụfọdụ. Foto nyocha (scan) mgbe ihe dị ka izu 4 ruo 6 gasịrị na-egosi otu etuto ahụ si nabata ya.
treatments.tumour-ablation.name: Ablation etuto (radiofrequency na microwave)
treatments.tumour-ablation.summary: Ntụtụ a na-eji foto nyocha eduzi na-eji okpomọkụ ebibi obere etuto, n'emegheghị ahụ.
treatments.tumour-ablation.what: Site n'iji ultrasound ma ọ bụ CT, dọkịta ọkachamara interventional radiology na-etinye ntụtụ dị gịrịgịrị n'ime etuto ahụ site n'akpụkpọ ahụ. Ntụtụ ahụ na-eji ebili radio ma ọ bụ microwave kpoo etuto ahụ ọkụ ruo mgbe e bibiri ya. Ọ na-ewe ihe dị ka otu awa, na-ahapụ naanị obere oghere dị ka isi ntụtụ, enwekwara ike ime ya ọzọ.
treatments.tumour-ablation.who: Ndị nwere obere etuto n'imeju, akụrụ, ngụgụ ma ọ bụ ọkpụkpụ, ọkachasị ndị ịwa ahụ na-adabaghị.
treatments.tumour-ablation.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị otu ụbọchị n'ụlọ ọgwụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.tumour-ablation.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ ha na-arụ kwa ụbọchị n'ime ụbọchị ole na ole.
treatments.tumour-ablation.faq.0.questio: Ọ dị mma ka ịwa ahụ?
treatments.tumour-ablation.faq.0.answer: Maka ụfọdụ obere akpụ, nsonaazụ ya dị nso na nke ịwa ahụ. Ndị otu dọkịta ga-agwa gị nke dabara na akpụ gị.
treatments.tumour-ablation.faq.1.questio: Kedu ka m ga-esi mara na ọ rụrụ ọrụ?
treatments.tumour-ablation.faq.1.answer: Nyocha (scan), nke a na-emekarị ihe dị ka otu ọnwa ka e mesịrị, na-enyocha na a gwọọla akpụ ahụ niile.
treatments.brain-tumour-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ akpụ ụbụrụ (craniotomy)
treatments.brain-tumour-surgery.summary: Ịwa ahụ ebe dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-emeghe obere akụkụ nke okpokoro isi iji wepụ ma ọ bụ belata akpụ dị n'ụbụrụ.
treatments.brain-tumour-surgery.what: A na-ebuli obere windo nke okpokoro isi, wepụ akpụ ahụ n'uju dịka o si dị nchebe, ma weghachi ọkpụkpụ ahụ. Igwe ntụzi ụzọ (navigation) na maịkrọskop ịwa ahụ na-eduzi dọkịta, a na-emekwa ụfọdụ ịwa ahụ mgbe onye ọrịa mụ anya iji chekwaa okwu na mmegharị ahụ. A na-enyocha anụ ahụ e wepụrụ iji hazie ọgwụgwọ ọzọ.
treatments.brain-tumour-surgery.who: Ndị nwere akpụ n'ụbụrụ, ma ọ bụ kansa ma ọ bụ na ọ bụghị, dịka glioma, meningioma, akpụ pituitary na akpụ gbasara ruo n'ụbụrụ.
treatments.brain-tumour-surgery.stay: Ihe dị ka ụbọchị 5: 1 na ngalaba nlekọta pụrụ iche (ICU) na 4 n'ọnụ ụlọ ndị ọrịa na Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.brain-tumour-surgery.recovery: Ọ na-abụkarị izu 4 ruo 8. Kwadebe ịnọ na India ihe dị ka izu 2 mgbe ịwa ahụ gasịrị.
treatments.brain-tumour-surgery.faq.0.an: Ọ na-abụkarị naanị obere akụkụ, ntutu isi na-etokwa ọzọ kpuchie ọnya ahụ.
treatments.brain-tumour-surgery.faq.1.qu: Ọ ga-adị m mkpa ọgwụgwọ radiesọn (radiotherapy) ma emechaa?
treatments.brain-tumour-surgery.faq.1.an: Ọ dabere n'ụdị akpụ ahụ. Akụkọ nyocha anụ ahụ e wepụrụ na-eduzi nke a.
treatments.deep-brain-stimulation.name: Mkpali ụbụrụ dị omimi (DBS)
treatments.deep-brain-stimulation.summar: Obere ngwaọrụ e debere n'okpuru akpụkpọ ahụ na-eziga obere mgbaàmà ọkụ eletrik n'otu akụkụ ụbụrụ, a na-eji ya maka ụfọdụ ọrịa mmegharị ahụ dịka ọrịa Parkinson.
treatments.deep-brain-stimulation.what: A na-etinye waya dị gịrịgịrị n'otu ebe a kapịrị ọnụ n'ime ime ụbụrụ ma jikọọ ha na obere batrị n'okpuru akpụkpọ ahụ nke obi, dịka pacemaker. Mgbaàmà ndị ahụ na-eme ka ọrụ ụbụrụ na-adịghị mma nke na-akpata ịma jijiji na nkwụsị ahụ dajụọ. A na-edozi ntọala ya n'izu ndị na-esote.
treatments.deep-brain-stimulation.who: Ndị nwere ọrịa Parkinson nke ọgwụ ha anaghịzi achịkwa mgbaàmà ha nke ọma, na ụfọdụ ndị nwere ịma jijiji (tremor) ma ọ bụ dystonia.
treatments.deep-brain-stimulation.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 3 ruo 5 n'ụlọ ọgwụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.deep-brain-stimulation.recove: Ọ na-abụkarị izu 2 ruo 4, a na-edozikwa ntọala ya n'ọtụtụ nleta.
Mba, mana ọ nwere ike ibelata nke ukwuu ịma jijiji, nkwụsị ahụ na mgbanwe nke ọgwụ na-akpata, ọ na-enyekarị ndị mmadụ ohere ịṅụ ọgwụ dị ntakịrị.
Enwere ike ịgbanwe ntọala ya mgbe m lọtara?
Ee. Enwere ike idozi ntọala ya na nleta ndị ọzọ, ọtụtụ ngwaọrụ dịkwa ka dọkịta ụbụrụ na akwara (neurologist) nwere ike inyocha n'obodo gị.
treatments.spinal-fusion.name: Ijikọ ọkpụkpụ azụ (spinal fusion)
treatments.spinal-fusion.summary: Ịwa ahụ na-ejikọ ọkpụkpụ azụ abụọ ma ọ bụ karịa ka ha gwọọ ghọọ otu, iji mee ka akụkụ azụ ma ọ bụ olu na-afụ ụfụ ma ọ bụ na-adịghị kwụsiri ike guzosie ike.
treatments.spinal-fusion.what: Skru na mkpanaka na-ejide ọkpụkpụ ndị ahụ ka ha ghara imegharị mgbe ọkpụkpụ a gbakwụnyere (bone graft) na-enyere ha aka ito ọnụ. Ebe ọ dabara, a na-eme ya site n'ịwa ahụ obere ọnya, na-eji igwe ntụzi ụzọ etinye skru nke ọma, nke na-apụtakarị obere mgbu na ịlọta ngwa ngwa.
treatments.spinal-fusion.who: Ndị ọkpụkpụ azụ ha na-adịghị kwụsiri ike ma ọ bụ sụchara (spondylolisthesis), diski gbasasịrị nke ukwuu, ọkpụkpụ gbajiri agbaji, ọkpụkpụ azụ gbagọrọ agbagọ, ma ọ bụ akpụ n'ọkpụkpụ azụ, mgbe ọgwụgwọ ndị ọzọ enyeghị aka.
treatments.spinal-fusion.stay: Ihe dị ka ụbọchị 5 maka ọkwa ruo abụọ: 1 na ngalaba nlekọta pụrụ iche (ICU) na 4 n'ọnụ ụlọ ndị ọrịa na Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.spinal-fusion.recovery: Ije ụkwụ na-amalite n'ụbọchị na-esote ịwa ahụ. Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ dị mfe n'ime izu 4 ruo 6, ọkpụkpụ ndị ahụ na-ejikọkwa ọnụ n'ime ọnwa 3 ruo 6.
treatments.spinal-fusion.faq.0.question: Agaghị m enwe ike imegharị azụ m dịka m na-eme?
treatments.spinal-fusion.faq.0.answer: Ijikọ otu ma ọ bụ ọkwa abụọ anaghị eweta ọtụtụ mgbanwe na mmegharị ahụ kwa ụbọchị.
treatments.spinal-fusion.faq.1.question: Olee mgbe m ga-efe ụgbọ elu laa?
treatments.spinal-fusion.faq.1.answer: Ọ na-abụkarị ihe dị ka izu 2 mgbe ịwa ahụ gasịrị, ozugbo e nyochara ọnya ahụ.
treatments.acdf.name: Iwepụ diski olu site n'ihu na ijikọ ọkpụkpụ (ACDF)
treatments.acdf.summary: Site n'obere ọnya n'ihu olu, a na-ewepụ diski mebiri emebi nke na-arụgide akwara ma ọ bụ ụdọ azụ (spinal cord), ma jikọọ ọkpụkpụ dị n'akụkụ ya abụọ.
treatments.acdf.what: Dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-esi n'ihu olu eru ọkpụkpụ azụ, wepụ diski gbasasịrị ma ọ bụ sụchara na ọkpụkpụ ọ bụla tolitere nke na-arụgide akwara, ma tinye obere ihe nkewa ka ọkpụkpụ abụọ ahụ too ọnụ.
treatments.acdf.who: Ndị nwere mgbu ogwe aka, ịnwụ ahụ ma ọ bụ adịghị ike, ma ọ bụ nsogbu nguzo na iji aka eme ihe, n'ihi diski sụchara ma ọ bụ gbasasịrị n'olu.
treatments.acdf.stay: Ihe dị ka ụbọchị 4: 1 na ngalaba nlekọta pụrụ iche (ICU) na 3 n'ọnụ ụlọ ndị ọrịa na Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.acdf.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ dị mfe n'ime izu 2 ruo 4.
treatments.acdf.faq.0.question: Ịgbanwe diski ọ ka mma?
treatments.acdf.faq.0.answer: Maka ụfọdụ mmadụ, ịgbanwe diski na-eme ka olu nọgide na-emegharị kama ijikọ ọkpụkpụ. Dọkịta na-awa ahụ ga-agwa gị nke dabara gị.
treatments.acdf.faq.1.question: M ga-enwe nsogbu ilo ihe?
treatments.acdf.faq.1.answer: Obere mgbu akpịrị ma ọ bụ isi ike ilo ihe ruo ụbọchị ole na ole bụ ihe a na-ahụkarị, ọ na-adakwa ngwa ngwa.
treatments.cervical-disc-replacement.sum: A na-eji diski arụrụ arụ dochie diski gbasasịrị ma ọ bụ sụchara n'olu, nke na-eme ka olu nọgide na-emegharị.
treatments.cervical-disc-replacement.wha: Site n'obere ọnya n'ihu olu, a na-ewepụ diski mebiri emebi ma tinye diski arụrụ arụ n'ọnọdụ ya. N'adịghị ka ijikọ ọkpụkpụ, nkwonkwo ahụ na-anọgide na-emegharị, nke nwere ike ichekwa diski ndị dị n'elu na n'okpuru ya.
treatments.cervical-disc-replacement.who: Ndị na-eto eto, ndị na-arụsi ọrụ ike nwere mgbu ogwe aka ma ọ bụ ịnwụ ahụ site n'otu ma ọ bụ diski abụọ gbasasịrị ma ọ bụ sụchara n'olu, na-enweghị ọrịa nkwonkwo (arthritis) siri ike.
treatments.cervical-disc-replacement.sta: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 2 ruo 3 n'ụlọ ọgwụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka ọnọdụ gị.
treatments.cervical-disc-replacement.rec: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ dị mfe n'ime izu 2 ruo 3.
treatments.cervical-disc-replacement.faq: Ndị nwere ọrịa nkwonkwo siri ike n'olu, ọkpụkpụ azụ na-adịghị kwụsiri ike ma ọ bụ ọkpụkpụ na-esighị ike, ijikọ ọkpụkpụ na-adabakarị ha karịa.
Ogologo oge ole ka diski arụrụ arụ na-adịgide?
E mere diski arụrụ arụ nke oge a ka ha dịgide ọtụtụ afọ. Dọkịta na-awa ahụ ga-akọwa ụdị a na-eji.
treatments.microdiscectomy.name: Microdiscectomy na laminectomy
