treatments.epilepsy-surgery.summary: Ịwa ahụ iji wepụ ma ọ bụ kewapụ akụkụ ụbụrụ ebe akwụkwụ na-amalite, mgbe ọgwụ anaghị achịkwa ya.
treatments.epilepsy-surgery.what: Nyocha gụnyere video EEG na MRI na-achọpụta ebe akwụkwụ na-amalite. Dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-ewepụzi obere ebe ahụ, ma ọ bụ tinye ngwaọrụ na-eme ka akara ụbụrụ dajụọ, dịka vagus nerve stimulator.
treatments.epilepsy-surgery.who: Ndị akwụkwụ ha na-aga n'ihu n'agbanyeghị na ha anwaala ọgwụ akwụkwụ abụọ ma ọ bụ karịa.
treatments.epilepsy-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 5 ruo 7, mgbe nyocha gasịrị. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.epilepsy-surgery.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 4 ruo 6. A na-aga n'ihu na-aṅụ ọgwụ akwụkwụ ruo oge ụfọdụ.
treatments.aneurysm-treatment.name: Ọgwụgwọ aneurysm ụbụrụ (coiling na clipping)
treatments.aneurysm-treatment.summary: Ọgwụgwọ iji mechie akwara ọbara na-adịghị ike, nke zara aza n'ụbụrụ tupu ọ gbawaa, ma ọ bụ mgbe ọ gbapụtachara ọbara.
treatments.aneurysm-treatment.what: Na coiling, a na-esi n'ebe ukwu na apata ụkwụ zutere (groin) tinye obere tube ruo n'ụbụrụ ma were coil dị nro ma ọ bụ stent mejupụta ebe zara aza ahụ. Na clipping, dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-emeghe okpokoro isi ma tinye obere clip n'olu ebe zara aza ahụ.
treatments.aneurysm-treatment.who: Ndị a chọpụtara na ha nwere aneurysm ụbụrụ na foto nyocha (scan), ma ọ bụ ndị ọbara gbapụtara n'ụbụrụ ha n'ihi ya.
treatments.aneurysm-treatment.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 2 ruo 4 mgbe coiling gasịrị; karịa mgbe clipping ma ọ bụ ọbara ọgbụgba gasịrị. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.aneurysm-treatment.recovery: Mgbe coiling gasịrị, ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 1 ruo 2; mgbe clipping gasịrị, izu 4 ruo 6.
treatments.stroke-treatment.name: Ọgwụgwọ ọrịa strok (iwepụ ọbara kpụkọrọ akpụkọ)
treatments.stroke-treatment.summary: Nlekọta mberede na nlekọta na-esote maka strok, gụnyere iwepụ ọbara kpụkọrọ akpụkọ n'akwara ụbụrụ.
treatments.stroke-treatment.what: Ọgwụ na-agbaze ọbara kpụkọrọ akpụkọ ma ọ bụ obere tube a na-esi n'ebe ukwu na apata ụkwụ zutere (groin) tinye ruo n'ụbụrụ (thrombectomy) na-emeghe akwara ahụ e gbochiri. Nlekọta na ngalaba strok na mweghachi ike ahụ (rehabilitation) na-enyezi aka na mgbake.
treatments.stroke-treatment.who: Ndị nwere strok, na ndị chọrọ mweghachi ike ahụ ma ọ bụ mgbochi mgbe ọ mesịrị ha.
treatments.stroke-treatment.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 5 ruo 10. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.stroke-treatment.recovery: Mgbake dị iche iche nke ukwuu. Physiotherapy, ọgwụgwọ ikwu okwu na occupational therapy na-aga n'ihu ruo izu ma ọ bụ ọnwa.
treatments.cranioplasty.name: Cranioplasty (nrụzi okpokoro isi)
treatments.cranioplasty.summary: Ịwa ahụ iji rụzie oghere dị n'okpokoro isi, nke na-abụkarị mgbe ịwa ahụ ụbụrụ gara aga ma ọ bụ mmerụ ahụ gasịrị.
treatments.cranioplasty.what: A na-eji ọkpụkpụ onye ọrịa n'onwe ya e chekwara ma ọ bụ ihe e mepụtara kpọmkwem maka ya dochie akụkụ okpokoro isi na-adịghị.
treatments.cranioplasty.who: Ndị e wepụrụ akụkụ okpokoro isi ha iji belata nrụgide n'ụbụrụ, ma ọ bụ ndị nwere mmebi okpokoro isi site na mmerụ ahụ.
treatments.cranioplasty.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 3 ruo 5. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.cranioplasty.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 4 ruo 6.
treatments.neuro-endoscopy.name: Ịwa ahụ ụbụrụ site na endoscope
treatments.neuro-endoscopy.summary: Ịwa ahụ ụbụrụ site n'obere oghere ma ọ bụ site n'imi, na-eji obere kamera dị gịrịgịrị.
treatments.neuro-endoscopy.what: A na-esi n'obere oghere n'okpokoro isi ma ọ bụ site n'imi tinye endoscope iji ruo etuto, cyst ma ọ bụ ụzọ mmiri e gbochiri na-enweghị nnukwu oghere.
treatments.neuro-endoscopy.who: Ndị nwere etuto pituitary, ụfọdụ etuto dị n'ala okpokoro isi, cyst ụbụrụ na hydrocephalus.
treatments.neuro-endoscopy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 3 ruo 5. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.neuro-endoscopy.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 2 ruo 4.
treatments.robotic-joint-replacement.nam: Ngbanwe ikpere na nkwonkwo site na robot
treatments.robotic-joint-replacement.sum: Ngbanwe ikpere ma ọ bụ ukwu a na-eme site na robot ịwa ahụ, ka nkwonkwo ọhụrụ ahụ dabara nke ọma.
treatments.robotic-joint-replacement.wha: Foto nyocha (scan) nke nkwonkwo gị na-ewu atụmatụ 3D. N'oge ịwa ahụ, aka robot ahụ na-enyere dọkịta na-awa ahụ aka iwepụ naanị ọkpụkpụ mebiri emebi ma tinye ihe ngbanwe ahụ kpọmkwem dịka e mere atụmatụ ya.
treatments.robotic-joint-replacement.who: Ndị nwere ọrịa nkwonkwo (arthritis) n'ikpere ma ọ bụ n'ukwu chọrọ ngbanwe nkwonkwo.
treatments.robotic-joint-replacement.sta: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 3 ruo 5. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.robotic-joint-replacement.rec: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-eji ihe nkwado eje ije n'echi ya ma laghachi ná ndụ kwa ụbọchị n'ime izu 4 ruo 6.
treatments.partial-knee-replacement.name: Ngbanwe akụkụ ikpere
treatments.partial-knee-replacement.summ: Ịgbanwe naanị akụkụ ikpere gbara agba, na-echekwa akụkụ ndị dị mma na ligament.
treatments.partial-knee-replacement.what: Site n'ọnya pere mpe, a na-eji ihe ngbanwe kpuchie naanị akụkụ ikpere mebiri emebi. Ikpere ahụ na-adịkarị ka nke okike karịa mgbe ngbanwe zuru ezu gasịrị.
treatments.partial-knee-replacement.who: Ndị arthritis ha metụtara naanị otu akụkụ ikpere, ndị ligament ha dị mma.
treatments.partial-knee-replacement.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 2 ruo 3. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.partial-knee-replacement.reco: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi ná ndụ kwa ụbọchị n'ime izu 3 ruo 4.
treatments.shoulder-replacement.name: Ngbanwe ubu
treatments.shoulder-replacement.summary: Iji nkwonkwo e mepụtara dochie nkwonkwo ubu gbara agba ma ọ bụ gbajiri agbaji, iji belata mgbu ma weghachi mmegharị.
treatments.shoulder-replacement.what: A na-eji akụkụ igwe na plastik dochie bọọlụ na oghere mebiri emebi. Reverse shoulder replacement na-agbanwe ebe bọọlụ na oghere dị, maka ndị rotator cuff ha dọwara adọwa.
treatments.shoulder-replacement.who: Ndị nwere arthritis ubu siri ike, nnukwu ndọwa rotator cuff, ma ọ bụ ọkpụkpụ gbajiri n'ụzọ siri ike.
treatments.shoulder-replacement.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 2 ruo 4. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.shoulder-replacement.recovery: Ogwe aka ahụ na-ezu ike n'ákwà nkwado (sling) ihe dị ka izu 4 ruo 6. Mgbake zuru ezu ya na physiotherapy na-ewe ihe dị ka ọnwa 6.
treatments.elbow-replacement.name: Ngbanwe ikpere aka
treatments.elbow-replacement.summary: Iji nkwonkwo e mepụtara dochie nkwonkwo ikpere aka mebiri emebi.
treatments.elbow-replacement.what: A na-eji akụkụ igwe na plastik e jikọrọ ọnụ dịka ọnụ ụzọ dochie nsọtụ ọkpụkpụ aka gbara agba n'ikpere aka.
treatments.elbow-replacement.who: Ndị nwere arthritis ikpere aka siri ike, nke na-esitekarị na rheumatoid arthritis, ma ọ bụ ọkpụkpụ gbajiri n'ụzọ siri ike.
treatments.elbow-replacement.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 2 ruo 3. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.elbow-replacement.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'iji ya eme obere ihe kwa ụbọchị n'ime izu 6 ruo 8; a na-ezere ibuli ihe dị arọ mgbe e mechara.
treatments.knee-arthroscopy.name: Knee arthroscopy (ịwa ahụ ikpere site n'obere oghere)
treatments.knee-arthroscopy.summary: Ịwa ahụ site n'obere oghere iji lee ime ikpere ma rụzie mmebi site n'obere ọnya dị ntakịrị.
treatments.knee-arthroscopy.what: Obere kamera na ngwa ọrụ dị gịrịgịrị na-abanye n'ikpere iji bezie ma ọ bụ rụzie cartilage, wepụ iberibe ihe tọgbọrọ atọgbọ ma ọ bụ gwọọ mmebi ligament.
treatments.knee-arthroscopy.who: Ndị nwere mgbu ikpere, ikpere na-ejide ma ọ bụ na-aza aza n'ihi ndọwa cartilage, iberibe ihe tọgbọrọ atọgbọ ma ọ bụ mmerụ ahụ egwuregwu.
treatments.knee-arthroscopy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị nke ụbọchị ahụ ma ọ bụ otu abalị. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.knee-arthroscopy.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-eje ije n'otu ụbọchị ahụ ma laghachi ná ndụ kwa ụbọchị n'ime izu 1 ruo 3.
treatments.meniscus-repair.name: Nrụzi meniscus ikpere
treatments.meniscus-repair.summary: Ịwa ahụ site n'obere oghere iji kwachie meniscus dọwara adọwa, cartilage na-enye ikpere nkwado dị nro.
treatments.meniscus-repair.what: Site n'arthroscope, dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-akwachi ndọwa ahụ ka o nwee ike ịgwọ, ma ọ bụ bezie akụkụ dọwara adọwa ma ọ bụrụ na a pụghị ịrụzi ya.
treatments.meniscus-repair.who: Ndị nwere meniscus dọwara adọwa na-ebute mgbu, ikpere na-ejide ma ọ bụ na-ada, nke na-esokarị mmerụ ahụ site n'ịgbagọ ikpere.
treatments.meniscus-repair.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị nke ụbọchị ahụ ma ọ bụ otu abalị. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.meniscus-repair.recovery: Mgbe nrụzi gasịrị, a na-eji osisi nkwado (crutches) izu ole na ole. A na-alaghachikarị n'egwuregwu n'ime ọnwa 4 ruo 6.
treatments.shoulder-arthroscopy.name: Shoulder arthroscopy
treatments.shoulder-arthroscopy.summary: Ịwa ahụ ubu site n'obere oghere iji rụzie rotator cuff dọwara adọwa, ubu na-anaghị eguzosi ike ma ọ bụ nkwonkwo kwụ ọtọ.
treatments.shoulder-arthroscopy.what: Obere kamera na ngwa ọrụ na-abanye n'ubu site n'obere ọnya dị ntakịrị. Dọkịta na-awa ahụ nwere ike ịrụzi akwara (tendon), mee ka nkwonkwo ahụ sie ike ma ọ bụ tọpụ isi ike ya.
treatments.shoulder-arthroscopy.who: Ndị nwere ndọwa rotator cuff, ubu na-esi n'ọnọdụ ya apụ ugboro ugboro, frozen shoulder ma ọ bụ impingement.
treatments.shoulder-arthroscopy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị nke ụbọchị ahụ ma ọ bụ otu abalị. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.shoulder-arthroscopy.recovery: A na-eyikarị ákwà nkwado (sling) izu ole na ole. Mgbake zuru ezu ya na physiotherapy na-ewe ọnwa 3 ruo 6.
treatments.elbow-arthroscopy.name: Elbow arthroscopy
treatments.elbow-arthroscopy.summary: Ịwa ahụ ikpere aka site n'obere oghere iji wepụ iberibe ihe tọgbọrọ atọgbọ, tọpụ nkwonkwo kwụ ọtọ ma ọ bụ gwọọ tennis elbow.
treatments.elbow-arthroscopy.what: Kamera dị gịrịgịrị na obere ngwa ọrụ na-abanye n'ikpere aka site n'obere ọnya dị ntakịrị iji sachaa ma ọ bụ rụzie nkwonkwo ahụ.
treatments.elbow-arthroscopy.who: Ndị nwere mgbu ikpere aka, ikpere aka na-ejide ma ọ bụ kwụ ọtọ n'ihi iberibe ihe tọgbọrọ atọgbọ, arthritis ma ọ bụ mmerụ ahụ egwuregwu.
treatments.elbow-arthroscopy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị nke ụbọchị ahụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.elbow-arthroscopy.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'iji ya kwa ụbọchị n'ime izu 2 ruo 6.
treatments.wrist-arthroscopy.name: Wrist arthroscopy
treatments.wrist-arthroscopy.summary: Ịwa ahụ nkwonkwo aka site n'obere oghere iji chọpụta ma rụzie ligament ma ọ bụ cartilage dọwara adọwa.
treatments.wrist-arthroscopy.what: Obere kamera dị ntakịrị na-abanye na nkwonkwo aka ka dọkịta na-awa ahụ nwee ike ịhụ ma rụzie ndọwa ligament ma ọ bụ cartilage, ma ọ bụ wepụ cyst.
treatments.wrist-arthroscopy.who: Ndị nwere mgbu nkwonkwo aka na-adịgide mgbe mmerụ ahụ gasịrị, ganglion cyst, ma ọ bụ ụfọdụ ọkpụkpụ nkwonkwo aka gbajiri agbaji.
treatments.wrist-arthroscopy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị nke ụbọchị ahụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.wrist-arthroscopy.recovery: Enwere ike iyi splint izu ole na ole. Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'iji ya nkịtị n'ime izu 4 ruo 8.
treatments.wrist-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ nkwonkwo aka
treatments.wrist-surgery.summary: Ịwa ahụ maka ọkpụkpụ nkwonkwo aka gbajiri agbaji, carpal tunnel syndrome, arthritis na nsogbu nkwonkwo aka ndị ọzọ.
treatments.wrist-surgery.what: Dabere na nsogbu ahụ, dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-eji efere ma ọ bụ mbọ (screw) dozie ọkpụkpụ gbajiri agbaji, tọpụ akwara a kpachiri akpachi, ma ọ bụ jikọọ ma ọ bụ gbanwee nkwonkwo gbara agba.
treatments.wrist-surgery.who: Ndị nkwonkwo aka ha gbajiri agbaji, ndị mkpịsị aka ha na-anwụ anwụ n'ihi carpal tunnel syndrome, ma ọ bụ ndị nwere arthritis nkwonkwo aka.
treatments.wrist-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị nke ụbọchị ahụ ma ọ bụ otu abalị. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.wrist-surgery.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'iji ya eme obere ihe n'ime izu 2 ruo 6, ya na ọgwụgwọ aka (hand therapy).
treatments.hip-arthroscopy.name: Hip arthroscopy
treatments.hip-arthroscopy.summary: Ịwa ahụ ukwu site n'obere oghere iji rụzie cartilage dọwara adọwa ma kpụgharịa nkwonkwo ahụ.
treatments.hip-arthroscopy.what: A na-etinye kamera na ngwa ọrụ n'ime nkwonkwo ukwu iji rụzie labrum dọwara adọwa, wepụ iberibe ihe tọgbọrọ atọgbọ ma ọ bụ bezie ọkpụkpụ na-apịkọ nkwonkwo ahụ.
treatments.hip-arthroscopy.who: Ndị na-arụsi ọrụ ike nwere mgbu ukwu site na ndọwa labrum ma ọ bụ hip impingement, tupu arthritis akawanye njọ.
treatments.hip-arthroscopy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị nke ụbọchị ahụ ma ọ bụ otu abalị. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.hip-arthroscopy.recovery: Osisi nkwado (crutches) ruo izu ole na ole. Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'egwuregwu n'ime ọnwa 3 ruo 6.
treatments.ankle-arthroscopy.name: Ankle arthroscopy
treatments.ankle-arthroscopy.summary: Ịwa ahụ nkwonkwo ụkwụ site n'obere oghere iji gwọọ mgbu, isi ike ma ọ bụ mmebi cartilage.
treatments.ankle-arthroscopy.what: Kamera na obere ngwa ọrụ na-abanye na nkwonkwo ụkwụ iji wepụ anụ ọnya, ọkpụkpụ tọrọ eto (bone spur) ma ọ bụ iberibe ihe tọgbọrọ atọgbọ, na iji gwọọ mmebi cartilage.
treatments.ankle-arthroscopy.who: Ndị nwere mgbu ma ọ bụ ọzịza nkwonkwo ụkwụ na-adịgide mgbe ụkwụ gbagọrọ agbagọ, ma ọ bụ ndị nwere arthritis nkwonkwo ụkwụ nke mmalite.
treatments.ankle-arthroscopy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị nke ụbọchị ahụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.ankle-arthroscopy.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ije ije nkịtị n'ime izu 2 ruo 6.
treatments.cartilage-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ nrụzi cartilage
treatments.cartilage-surgery.summary: Ịwa ahụ iji rụzie ma ọ bụ mee ka cartilage nkwonkwo mebiri emebi too ọzọ, ọkachasị n'ikpere.
treatments.cartilage-surgery.what: Usoro gụnyere microfracture, nke na-enyere cartilage ọhụrụ aka itolite, na ịkwaga cartilage dị mma site n'akụkụ ọzọ nke nkwonkwo ahụ ma ọ bụ nke e tolitere n'ụlọ nyocha.
treatments.cartilage-surgery.who: Ndị na-eto eto, na-arụsi ọrụ ike, nwere obere ebe cartilage mebiri emebi, tupu arthritis amalite.
treatments.cartilage-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị nke ụbọchị ahụ ma ọ bụ otu abalị. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.cartilage-surgery.recovery: Osisi nkwado (crutches) ruo izu 4 ruo 6. Mgbake zuru ezu na ịlaghachi n'egwuregwu nwere ike iwe ọnwa 6 ruo 12.
treatments.physiotherapy.name: Physiotherapy na mweghachi ike ahụ
treatments.physiotherapy.summary: Mmega ahụ, ọgwụgwọ e ji aka eme na ọgwụgwọ okpomọkụ ma ọ bụ ọkụ eletrik iji weghachi mmegharị na ike.
treatments.physiotherapy.what: Onye physiotherapist na-ahazi mmega ahụ na ọgwụgwọ dịka infrared na ọgwụgwọ okpomọkụ ndị ọzọ, ultrasound na mkpali eletrik, tupu na mgbe ịwa ahụ gasịrị, ma ọ bụ maka mmerụ ahụ na mgbu ogologo oge.
treatments.physiotherapy.who: Ndị na-agbake site na ngbanwe nkwonkwo, ịwa ahụ ọkpụkpụ azụ ma ọ bụ nke egwuregwu, strok, ma ọ bụ ndị na-ebi na mgbu azụ na nkwonkwo.
treatments.physiotherapy.stay: Ọ dịghị ịnọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ: oge a na-abịa ma laa, ma ọ bụ n'oge ị na-anọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.physiotherapy.recovery: Ọtụtụ atụmatụ na-adị izu ole na ole, ya na mmega ahụ ị ga-aga n'ihu na ya n'ụlọ.
treatments.paediatric-heart-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ obi ụmụaka
treatments.paediatric-heart-surgery.summ: Ịwa ahụ na usoro site n'obere oghere iji rụzie nsogbu obi ụmụ ọhụrụ na ụmụaka ji amụ.
treatments.paediatric-heart-surgery.what: A na-arụzi oghere n'obi, valvụ dị warara na ntụpọ ọmụmụ ndị ọzọ site n'ịwa ahụ meghere emeghe ma ọ bụ site na ngwaọrụ a na-esi n'akwara ọbara tinye, na-enweghị imeghe igbe obi.
treatments.paediatric-heart-surgery.who: Ụmụ ọhụrụ na ụmụaka nwere ọrịa obi ha ji amụ, dịka ASD, VSD, PDA na tetralogy of Fallot.
treatments.paediatric-heart-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 1 ruo 3 mgbe usoro catheter gasịrị; ụbọchị 7 ruo 14 mgbe ịwa ahụ meghere emeghe gasịrị. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.paediatric-heart-surgery.reco: Ụmụaka na-agbakekarị ngwa ngwa. Mee atụmatụ ihe dị ka izu 2 ruo 3 n'India mgbe ịwa ahụ meghere emeghe gasịrị.
treatments.icd-implantation.name: Itinye ngwaọrụ ICD na CRT
treatments.icd-implantation.summary: Obere ngwaọrụ a na-etinye n'okpuru akpụkpọ ahụ nke na-elele ịkụ obi ma na-edozi ịkụ obi dị egwu ma ọ bụ obi na-adịghị ike ịgba ọbara.
treatments.icd-implantation.what: Site n'obere ọnya n'okpuru ọkpụkpụ olu, a na-etinye waya ruo n'obi ma jikọọ ha na ngwaọrụ ahụ. ICD na-enye mkpali eletrik iji kwụsị ịkụ obi na-eyi ndụ egwu. Ngwaọrụ CRT na-enyere akụkụ abụọ nke obi aka ịgba ọbara ọnụ.
treatments.icd-implantation.who: Ndị nọ n'ihe ize ndụ nke obi ịkwụsị na mberede, na ndị nwere obi na-ada ada nke obi ha anaghị akụ n'usoro.
treatments.icd-implantation.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 1 ruo 2. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.icd-implantation.recovery: Zere ibuli ogwe aka dị n'akụkụ ahụ karịa ubu ihe dị ka izu 4 ruo 6.
treatments.arrhythmia-ablation.name: Ọgwụgwọ ịkụ obi na-adịghị n'usoro (EP study na ablation)
treatments.arrhythmia-ablation.summary: Ịchọpụta na ịgwọ ihe kpatara ịkụ obi na-adịghị n'usoro ma ọ bụ na-agba ọsọ site na waya dị gịrịgịrị a na-etinye ruo n'obi.
treatments.arrhythmia-ablation.what: N'electrophysiology (EP) study, waya na-ese map nke akara eletrik obi. Ablation na-ejizi okpomọkụ ma ọ bụ oyi gwọọ obere ebe na-ebute ịkụ obi na-adịghị mma.
treatments.arrhythmia-ablation.who: Ndị nwere atrial fibrillation, SVT, flutter na nsogbu ịkụ obi ndị ọzọ ọgwụ na-anaghị achịkwa.
treatments.arrhythmia-ablation.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 1 ruo 2. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.arrhythmia-ablation.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime otu izu.
treatments.heart-tumour-treatment.name: Ọgwụgwọ etuto obi
treatments.heart-tumour-treatment.summar: Ịwa ahụ na ọgwụgwọ ndị ọzọ maka etuto na-eto n'ime ma ọ bụ n'elu obi.
treatments.heart-tumour-treatment.what: Ọtụtụ etuto obi abụghị kansa, dịka myxoma, a na-ewepụkwa ha site n'ịwa ahụ obi meghere emeghe. A na-eji ịwa ahụ, chemotherapy na radieshọn ọnụ agwọ etuto obi bụ kansa, ndị a na-adịghị ahụkebe.
treatments.heart-tumour-treatment.who: Ndị a chọpụtara ihe tọrọ eto n'obi ha na foto nyocha (scan).
treatments.heart-tumour-treatment.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 7 ruo 10 mgbe ịwa ahụ gasịrị. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.heart-tumour-treatment.recove: Mee atụmatụ ihe dị ka izu 4 ruo 6 tupu ọrụ nkịtị.
treatments.gastric-balloon.name: Bọlụn afọ (gastric balloon)
treatments.gastric-balloon.summary: Bọlụn dị nro a na-esi n'ọnụ tinye n'afọ, iji nyere gị aka ịfọ afọ ngwa ngwa ma belata ibu. Ọ dịghị ọnya a chọrọ.
treatments.gastric-balloon.what: N'okpuru ọgwụ na-eme ka ị dajụọ obere (light sedation), a na-eji endoscope tinye bọlụn na-enweghị ikuku n'afọ ma were mmiri nnu mejupụta ya. Ọ na-anọ ihe dị ka ọnwa 6 ruo 12, a na-esizi n'otu ụzọ ahụ wepụ ya.
treatments.gastric-balloon.who: Ndị buru oke ibu chọrọ enyemaka ibelata ibu na-enweghị ịwa ahụ, ma ọ bụ ndị chọrọ ibelata ibu tupu ịwa ahụ.
treatments.gastric-balloon.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị nke ụbọchị ahụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.gastric-balloon.recovery: Ọgbụgbọ na-adịkarị ụbọchị ole na ole. Atụmatụ nri na nsochi na-enyere gị aka ka ibu ahụ ghara ịlọghachi.
treatments.gallbladder-surgery.name: Iwepụ akpa nkụ (laparoscopic cholecystectomy)
treatments.gallbladder-surgery.summary: Iwepụ akpa nkụ (gallbladder) site n'obere oghere, ọgwụgwọ a na-emekarị maka nkume akpa nkụ na-egbu mgbu.
treatments.gallbladder-surgery.what: Site n'obere ọnya atọ ma ọ bụ anọ, a na-ewepụ akpa nkụ na nkume ya. Ị nwere ike ibi ndụ nkịtị na-enweghị akpa nkụ.
treatments.gallbladder-surgery.who: Ndị nwere nkume akpa nkụ na-ebute mgbu, ọrịa nje, jaundice ma ọ bụ pancreatitis.
treatments.gallbladder-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 1 ruo 2. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.gallbladder-surgery.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 1 ruo 2.
treatments.hernia-surgery.name: Nrụzi hernia (site n'obere oghere na robot)
treatments.hernia-surgery.summary: Ịwa ahụ iji kwaghachi ebe zara aza n'ọnọdụ ya ma mee ka ebe na-adịghị ike sie ike, nke a na-ejikarị mesh eme.
treatments.hernia-surgery.what: A na-arụzi hernia ahụ site n'obere ọnya site n'obere oghere ma ọ bụ site na robot, ma ọ bụ site n'otu ọnya n'ịwa ahụ meghere emeghe. A na-etinyekarị mesh iji kwado ebe ahụ.
treatments.hernia-surgery.who: Ndị nwere hernia inguinal (n'ebe ukwu na apata ụkwụ zutere), umbilical, incisional ma ọ bụ hiatus na-egbu mgbu ma ọ bụ na-eto.
treatments.hernia-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị nke ụbọchị ahụ ma ọ bụ ụbọchị 1 ruo 2. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.hernia-surgery.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'obere ọrụ n'ime izu 1 ruo 2, na ibuli ihe dị arọ n'ime izu 4 ruo 6.
treatments.appendectomy.name: Iwepụ appendix (appendectomy)
treatments.appendectomy.summary: Iwepụ appendix na-aza aza, nke a na-emekarị site n'obere oghere.
treatments.appendectomy.what: A na-ewepụ appendix site n'obere ọnya n'afọ. Ọ na-abụkarị ịwa ahụ mberede.
treatments.appendectomy.who: Ndị nwere appendicitis, ma ọ bụ mgbu appendix na-alọghachi ugboro ugboro.
treatments.appendectomy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 1 ruo 3. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.appendectomy.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 1 ruo 3.
treatments.robotic-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ site na robot na da Vinci
treatments.robotic-surgery.summary: Ịwa ahụ a na-eji robot da Vinci eme site n'obere ọnya, maka mgbu dị nta, ọbara dị nta na-agba na ịlọta ụlọ ngwa ngwa.
treatments.robotic-surgery.what: Dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-achịkwa ngwa ọrụ robot site na kọnsolụ, na-ahụ ihe n'ụdị 3D e mere ka ọ buo ibu. A na-eji ya maka ịwa ahụ hernia, akpa nkụ, eriri afọ, ibelata ibu, urology, gynaecology na kansa.
treatments.robotic-surgery.who: Ndị chọrọ ịwa ahụ ebe dọkịta na-awa ahụ dụrụ ọdụ ka e jiri robot mee ya.
treatments.robotic-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 1 ruo 4, dabere n'ịwa ahụ ahụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.robotic-surgery.recovery: Ọ na-adịkarị ngwa karịa ịwa ahụ meghere emeghe; ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi ná ndụ kwa ụbọchị n'ime izu 1 ruo 3.
treatments.hepatobiliary-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ imeju, ọwa nkụ na pancreas
treatments.hepatobiliary-surgery.summary: Ịwa ahụ maka nsogbu na-abụghị kansa nke imeju, ọwa nkụ na pancreas, dịka nkume, cyst na ihe mgbochi.
treatments.hepatobiliary-surgery.what: Ịwa ahụ gụnyere iwepụ cyst imeju, ịrụzi ma ọ bụ ịgafe ọwa nkụ e gbochiri, na ịgbapụ mmiri ma ọ bụ iwepụ akụkụ pancreas mebiri emebi, nke a na-emekarị site n'obere oghere.
treatments.hepatobiliary-surgery.who: Ndị nwere nkume ma ọ bụ warara ọwa nkụ, choledochal cyst, cyst imeju na chronic pancreatitis.
treatments.hepatobiliary-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 3 ruo 10, dabere n'ịwa ahụ ahụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.hepatobiliary-surgery.recover: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 2 ruo 6.
treatments.endoscopy.name: Endoscopy na colonoscopy
treatments.endoscopy.summary: Kamera dị gịrịgịrị a na-esi n'ọnụ ma ọ bụ n'ọnụ ike tinye iji lee ime eriri afọ, were ihe nlele ma gwọọ nsogbu.
treatments.endoscopy.what: N'okpuru ọgwụ na-eme ka ị dajụọ obere (light sedation), dọkịta na-elele ọkpọ nri, afọ na eriri afọ. Enwere ike iwepụ polyp ma gwọọ ọbara ọgbụgba n'otu nyocha ahụ.
treatments.endoscopy.who: Ndị nwere obi ọkụ (heartburn), nsogbu ilo nri, ọbara ọgbụgba, mgbu afọ ogologo oge ma ọ bụ mgbanwe n'nsị, na maka nyocha kansa.
treatments.endoscopy.stay: Ọ dịghị ịnọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ: awa ole na ole. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.endoscopy.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'echi ya.
treatments.ercp-eus.name: ERCP na endoscopic ultrasound (EUS)
treatments.ercp-eus.summary: Endoscopy dị elu iji hụ ma gwọọ ọwa nkụ na pancreas na-enweghị ịwa ahụ.
treatments.ercp-eus.what: Na ERCP, kamera a na-esi n'ọnụ tinye na-eru ọwa nkụ iji wepụ nkume ma ọ bụ tinye stent. Na EUS, ultrasound dị na kamera ahụ na-enye ọhụhụ dị nso nke pancreas na akụkụ ahụ ndị dị nso, ọ nwekwara ike iwere ihe nlele.
treatments.ercp-eus.who: Ndị nwere nkume ọwa nkụ, jaundice, warara ọwa nkụ, ma ọ bụ akpụ na pancreas.
treatments.ercp-eus.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị nke ụbọchị ahụ ma ọ bụ otu abalị. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.ercp-eus.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime ụbọchị 1 ruo 2.
treatments.fatty-liver-treatment.name: Ọgwụgwọ abụba imeju
treatments.fatty-liver-treatment.summary: Nyocha na atụmatụ iji wepụ abụba gbakọrọ n'imeju tupu ọ kpata mmebi na-adịgide adịgide.
treatments.fatty-liver-treatment.what: FibroScan na nyocha ọbara na-atụ abụba na ọnya dị n'imeju. Ọgwụgwọ bụ atụmatụ ibu, nri na mmega ahụ, ịchịkwa ọrịa shuga na cholesterol, na ọgwụ ebe ọ dị mkpa.
treatments.fatty-liver-treatment.who: Ndị a gwara na ha nwere abụba imeju, nke na-esokarị ibu ịbawanye, ọrịa shuga ma ọ bụ cholesterol dị elu.
treatments.fatty-liver-treatment.stay: Ọ dịghị ịnọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ: nleta n'ụlọ ọgwụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.fatty-liver-treatment.recover: Ibelata ibu nwayọọ nwayọọ ruo ọnwa nwere ike ịgbanwe abụba imeju nke mmalite.
treatments.liver-cirrhosis-treatment.sum: Nlekọta iji mee ka ọnya imeju ghara ịga ngwa ngwa ma gwọọ nsogbu ọ na-ebute, na ịhazi ntụgharị ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dị mkpa.
treatments.liver-cirrhosis-treatment.wha: A na-agwọ ihe kpatara ya, dịka hepatitis, mmanya na-aba n'anya ma ọ bụ abụba imeju. A na-eji ọgwụ na endoscopy achịkwa nsogbu dịka akwara ọbara zara aza, mmiri n'afọ na mgbagwoju anya. A na-ahazi ntụgharị imeju mgbe imeju na-ada ada.
treatments.liver-cirrhosis-treatment.who: Ndị nwere cirrhosis site n'ihe ọ bụla kpatara ya.
treatments.liver-cirrhosis-treatment.sta: Ọ na-abụkarị nlekọta a na-abịa ma laa; obere oge n'ụlọ ọgwụ maka nsogbu. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.liver-cirrhosis-treatment.rec: Cirrhosis chọrọ nsochi ndụ niile site n'aka ọkachamara imeju.
treatments.kidney-stone-treatment.name: Ọgwụgwọ nkume akụrụ
treatments.kidney-stone-treatment.summar: Ịkụwa ma ọ bụ iwepụ nkume akụrụ na ureter, nke a na-emekarị na-enweghị ọnya ọ bụla.
treatments.kidney-stone-treatment.what: Usoro gụnyere ebili mmiri ike si n'èzí ahụ (ESWL), obere scope nwere laser a na-esi n'ọwa mamịrị tinye (RIRS na URS), na iwepụ nkume buru ibu site n'obere oghere n'azụ (PCNL).
treatments.kidney-stone-treatment.who: Ndị nwere nkume akụrụ ma ọ bụ ureter na-ebute mgbu, ọrịa nje ma ọ bụ mgbochi, ma ọ bụ nke na-agaghị apụ n'onwe ya.
treatments.kidney-stone-treatment.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị site n'otu ụbọchị ruo ụbọchị 2. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.kidney-stone-treatment.recove: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime ụbọchị ole na ole. Obere tube (stent) nwere ike ịnọ izu 1 ruo 2.
treatments.robotic-urology-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ akụrụ na urology site na robot
treatments.robotic-urology-surgery.summa: Ịwa ahụ site na robot maka nsogbu akụrụ, ureter, eriri afọ mamịrị na prostate, ma kansa ma ndị na-abụghị kansa.
treatments.robotic-urology-surgery.what: N'iji robot da Vinci, ndị dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-arụzi ọwa akụrụ e gbochiri (pyeloplasty), wughachi ureter, wepụ etuto akụrụ ma ọ bụ prostate ma gwọọ nsogbu mamịrị ndị ọzọ site n'obere ọnya.
treatments.robotic-urology-surgery.who: Ndị nwere akụrụ e gbochiri, ureter dị warara, prostate tooro eto, ma ọ bụ kansa akụrụ, eriri afọ mamịrị ma ọ bụ prostate.
treatments.robotic-urology-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 2 ruo 4. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.robotic-urology-surgery.recov: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 2 ruo 4.
treatments.circumcision.name: Ibe úgwù (circumcision)
treatments.circumcision.summary: Iwepụ akpụkpọ na-ekpuchi isi amụ nwoke, maka ihe gbasara ahụike ma ọ bụ site na nhọrọ.
treatments.circumcision.what: A na-ewepụ akpụkpọ ahụ n'okpuru ọgwụ mgbochi mgbu (anaesthetic), mgbe ụfọdụ site na stapler ma ọ bụ laser, a na-ejikwa eriri na-agbaze n'onwe ya kwachie akpụkpọ ahụ.
treatments.circumcision.who: Ụmụ nwoke na ndị okenye nwoke nwere akpụkpọ isi amụ siri ike (phimosis), ọrịa nje na-alọghachi ugboro ugboro, ma ọ bụ ndị họọrọ ya n'ihi omenala ma ọ bụ okpukpe.
treatments.circumcision.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị nke ụbọchị ahụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.circumcision.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 1 ruo 2.
treatments.hysterectomy.name: Hysterectomy (site n'obere oghere na robot)
treatments.hysterectomy.summary: Iwepụ akpanwa, nke a na-emekarị site n'obere ọnya site n'obere oghere ma ọ bụ site na robot.
treatments.hysterectomy.what: A na-ewepụ akpanwa, na mgbe ụfọdụ ọnụ akpanwa (cervix), eriri akpanwa na akpa nwa (ovaries). Usoro obere oghere na robot pụtara mgbu dị nta na mgbake dị ngwa karịa ịwa ahụ meghere emeghe.
treatments.hysterectomy.who: Ụmụ nwanyị nwere fibroid, oke ọbara ọgbụgba, endometriosis, akpanwa dabara ada (prolapse) ma ọ bụ ihe na-achọ ịghọ kansa nke ọgwụgwọ ndị ọzọ enyereghị aka.
treatments.hysterectomy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 1 ruo 3. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.hysterectomy.recovery: Ọtụtụ ụmụ nwanyị na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 4 ruo 6.
treatments.ovarian-cystectomy.name: Iwepụ cyst akpa nwa (ovarian cystectomy)
treatments.ovarian-cystectomy.summary: Iwepụ cyst n'akpa nwa (ovary) site n'obere oghere, na-echekwa akpa nwa ahụ.
treatments.ovarian-cystectomy.what: Site n'obere ọnya, a na-ekewapụ cyst ahụ n'akpa nwa ma wepụ ya, na-echekwa akpa nwa na ike ịmụ nwa.
treatments.ovarian-cystectomy.who: Ụmụ nwanyị nwere cyst akpa nwa buru ibu, na-egbu mgbu ma ọ bụ na-adịgide, gụnyere endometrioma na dermoid cyst.
treatments.ovarian-cystectomy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị nke ụbọchị ahụ ma ọ bụ otu abalị. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.ovarian-cystectomy.recovery: Ọtụtụ ụmụ nwanyị na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 1 ruo 2.
treatments.salpingo-oophorectomy.name: Salpingo-oophorectomy (iwepụ eriri akpanwa na akpa nwa)
treatments.salpingo-oophorectomy.summary: Iwepụ otu ma ọ bụ eriri akpanwa (fallopian tubes) na akpa nwa (ovaries) abụọ (unilateral ma ọ bụ bilateral).
treatments.salpingo-oophorectomy.what: A na-ewepụ eriri akpanwa na akpa nwa dị n'otu akụkụ, ma ọ bụ akụkụ abụọ, site n'obere oghere ma ọ bụ site na robot.
treatments.salpingo-oophorectomy.who: Ụmụ nwanyị nwere cyst ma ọ bụ etuto akpa nwa, nnukwu ihe ize ndụ kansa e ketara eketa (dịka BRCA), endometriosis siri ike ma ọ bụ ọrịa nje.
treatments.salpingo-oophorectomy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 1 ruo 2. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.salpingo-oophorectomy.recover: Ọtụtụ ụmụ nwanyị na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 2 ruo 4. Iwepụ akpa nwa abụọ na-eme ka nsọ nwanyị kwụsị (menopause).
treatments.robotic-gynaecology-surgery.n: Ịwa ahụ ụmụ nwanyị site na robot
treatments.robotic-gynaecology-surgery.s: Ịwa ahụ site na robot maka fibroid, endometriosis, prolapse na nsogbu ụmụ nwanyị ndị ọzọ.
treatments.robotic-gynaecology-surgery.w: Site na robot da Vinci, ndị dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-ewepụ fibroid ma na-echekwa akpanwa (myomectomy), wepụ endometriosis, rụzie prolapse ma mee hysterectomy site n'obere ọnya.
Ụmụ nwanyị chọrọ ịwa ahụ ụmụ nwanyị ebe izi ezi dị mkpa, dịka fibroid siri ike ma ọ bụ endometriosis miri emi.
treatments.robotic-gynaecology-surgery.s: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 1 ruo 3. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.robotic-gynaecology-surgery.r: Ọtụtụ ụmụ nwanyị na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 2 ruo 4.
treatments.sinus-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ sinus (FESS)
treatments.sinus-surgery.summary: Ịwa ahụ site n'obere oghere site n'imi iji meghee sinus e gbochiri ma wepụ polyp.
treatments.sinus-surgery.what: A na-etinye kamera dị gịrịgịrị n'imi, dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-emeghe ọnụ sinus e gbochiri ma wepụ polyp. Ọ dịghị ọnya n'ihu.
treatments.sinus-surgery.who: Ndị nwere sinusitis ogologo oge, polyp imi ma ọ bụ imi e gbochiri nke ọgwụ enyereghị aka.
treatments.sinus-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị nke ụbọchị ahụ ma ọ bụ otu abalị. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.sinus-surgery.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 1 ruo 2.
treatments.robotic-thyroidectomy.name: Robotic thyroidectomy (ịwa ahụ thyroid na-enweghị ntụpọ ọnya)
treatments.robotic-thyroidectomy.summary: Iwepụ thyroid site na robot ịwa ahụ site n'ọnya dị anya n'olu, na-ahapụghị ntụpọ ọnya a na-ahụ anya n'olu.
treatments.robotic-thyroidectomy.what: Robot ahụ na-eru thyroid site n'obere ọnya n'okpuru ogwe aka, n'azụ ntị ma ọ bụ n'ime ọnụ. A na-ewepụ akụkụ ma ọ bụ thyroid dum (total thyroidectomy).
treatments.robotic-thyroidectomy.who: Ndị nwere akpụ thyroid (nodule), goitre ma ọ bụ kansa thyroid chọrọ izere ntụpọ ọnya n'olu, ndị usoro a dabakwara.
treatments.robotic-thyroidectomy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 1 ruo 2. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.robotic-thyroidectomy.recover: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 1 ruo 2. Enwere ike ịchọ mkpụrụ ọgwụ thyroid ndụ niile.
treatments.breast-reconstruction.name: Iwughachi ara
treatments.breast-reconstruction.summary: Iwughachi ara mgbe mastectomy gasịrị, site n'ihe e tinyere n'ahụ (implant) ma ọ bụ site n'anụ ahụ nke gị.
treatments.breast-reconstruction.what: A na-ewughachi ara site na silicone implant, ma ọ bụ site n'akpụkpọ ahụ na abụba si n'afọ, azụ ma ọ bụ apata ụkwụ e jiri microsurgery bufee. Enwere ike ime ya n'oge mastectomy ma ọ bụ ma emechaa.
treatments.breast-reconstruction.who: Ụmụ nwanyị e meela, ma ọ bụ a na-eme, mastectomy.
treatments.breast-reconstruction.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 2 ruo 6, dabere n'usoro ahụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.breast-reconstruction.recover: Ọtụtụ ụmụ nwanyị na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 4 ruo 8.
treatments.body-contouring.name: Ịwa ahụ mma ahụ na ịkpụgharị ahụ
treatments.body-contouring.summary: Ịwa ahụ iji kpụgharịa ahụ, dịka tummy tuck, ibuli ma ọ bụ ibelata ara, ibuli ogwe aka na apata ụkwụ.
treatments.body-contouring.what: A na-ewepụ akpụkpọ ahụ na abụba tọgbọrọ atọgbọ ma mee ka anụ ahụ dị mkpa, nke na-esokarị mgbe e belatara nnukwu ibu ma ọ bụ mgbe ime gasịrị. A na-ejikọkarị ya na liposuction.
treatments.body-contouring.who: Ndị okenye ahụ siri ike, ibu ha kwụsiri ike, chọrọ ịgbanwe ọdịdị ahụ ha.
treatments.body-contouring.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 1 ruo 3. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.body-contouring.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'obere ọrụ n'ime izu 2 ruo 3. A na-eyi uwe na-apịkọ ahụ (compression garments) ruo ọtụtụ izu.
treatments.facial-plastic-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ plastik ihu
treatments.facial-plastic-surgery.summar: Ịwa ahụ iji mee ka ihu dị ọhụrụ ma ọ bụ kpụgharịa ya, dịka facelift, ịwa ahụ nkpuchi anya na mmezi agba ma ọ bụ ntị.
treatments.facial-plastic-surgery.what: Dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-ebuli akpụkpọ ahụ na anụ ahụ dara ada, wepụ akpụkpọ nkpuchi anya karịrị akarị, ma ọ bụ kpụgharịa agba, ntì ihu ma ọ bụ ntị, ya na ọnya e zoro n'ahịrị okike.
treatments.facial-plastic-surgery.who: Ndị okenye chọrọ ịdị ọhụrụ n'anya ma ọ bụ mezie otu akụkụ ihu, na ndị chọrọ nrụzi mgbe mmerụ ahụ gasịrị.
treatments.facial-plastic-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị nke ụbọchị ahụ ma ọ bụ otu abalị. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.facial-plastic-surgery.recove: Ọzịza na nchacha ahụ na-ebelata n'ime izu 2 ruo 3.
treatments.gender-affirming-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ nkwado nwoke ma ọ bụ nwanyị (gender-affirming surgery)
treatments.gender-affirming-surgery.summ: Ịwa ahụ iji mee ka ahụ dabara na nwoke ma ọ bụ nwanyị mmadụ ma onwe ya dị, dịka akụkụ nke usoro nlekọta a haziri ahazi.
treatments.gender-affirming-surgery.what: Ịwa ahụ nwere ike ịgụnye ịwa ahụ obi akpa, ịwa ahụ akụkụ nzuzo na ịwa ahụ ihu, nke a haziri ya na nlekọta ahụike uche na homonụ.
treatments.gender-affirming-surgery.who: Ndị okenye nwere gender dysphoria nwetarala ntụle ndị otu ịwa ahụ chọrọ.
treatments.gender-affirming-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 2 ruo 7, dabere n'ịwa ahụ ahụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.gender-affirming-surgery.reco: Mgbake na-esi n'izu 2 ruo ọnwa 2, dabere n'ịwa ahụ ahụ.
treatments.male-genital-aesthetic-surger: Ịwa ahụ mma na ịwa ahụ amụ nwoke
Ịwa ahụ iji mezie ọdịdị ma ọ bụ nha amụ nwoke, ma ọ bụ iji gwọọ ngbagọ ma ọ bụ nsogbu ike nwoke (erection).
Usoro gụnyere imezi ngbagọ (ọrịa Peyronie), penile implant maka nsogbu ike nwoke, na imeziwanye ọdịdị.
Ụmụ nwoke nwere amụ gbagọrọ agbagọ, nsogbu ike nwoke ọgwụ na-enyereghị aka, ma ọ bụ nchegbu gbasara ọdịdị.
Ọ na-abụkarị site n'otu ụbọchị ruo ụbọchị 2. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
Ọtụtụ ụmụ nwoke na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 2 ruo 4; mmekọ nwoke na nwanyị mgbe ihe dị ka izu 6 gasịrị.
Ịwa ahụ plastik na-eweghachi ahụ (fat grafting na PRP)
Iji abụba, plasma ma ọ bụ mkpụrụ ndụ nke gị weghachi oke ahụ, gwọọ ntụpọ ọnya ma mee ka akpụkpọ ahụ ka mma.
A na-eji liposuction dị nwayọọ wepụta abụba, mee ka ọ dị ọcha ma gbanye ya ebe a chọrọ ya. A na-eji platelet-rich plasma (PRP) si n'ọbara gị enyere aka na ọgwụgwọ na itolite ntutu.
Ndị nwere ntụpọ ọnya, ebe dara ada mgbe mmerụ ahụ ma ọ bụ ịwa ahụ gasịrị, akpụkpọ ahụ na-aka nka, ma ọ bụ ntutu na-agịrịgịrị.
Ọ na-abụkarị nke ụbọchị ahụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.reconstructive-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ nrụzi
treatments.reconstructive-surgery.summar: Ịwa ahụ iji weghachi ọdịdị na ọrụ ahụ mgbe kansa, mmerụ ahụ, ọkụ gbara ma ọ bụ ihe dị iche e ji amụ gasịrị.
treatments.reconstructive-surgery.what: A na-eji ịkụnye akpụkpọ ahụ (skin graft), anụ ahụ e si n'akụkụ dị nso bufee (flap) na microsurgery arụzi ihu, isi na olu, aka na ụkwụ, na ahụ.
treatments.reconstructive-surgery.who: Ndị mgbe ịwa ahụ kansa gasịrị, ihe mberede, ọkụ gbara, ma ọ bụ ndị nwere ihe dị iche ha ji amụ.
treatments.reconstructive-surgery.stay: Ọ dabere n'ịwa ahụ ahụ, site n'otu ụbọchị ruo izu 2. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.reconstructive-surgery.recove: Ọ dabere na nrụzi ahụ; dọkịta na-awa ahụ ga-enye atụmatụ.
treatments.oral-maxillofacial-surgery.na: Ịwa ahụ ọnụ na agba (oral and maxillofacial)
treatments.oral-maxillofacial-surgery.su: Ịwa ahụ ọnụ, agba na ihu, site n'ezé amamihe (wisdom teeth) ruo na mmezi agba.
treatments.oral-maxillofacial-surgery.wh: Ọ gụnyere iwepụ ezé amamihe nọ n'ime ọkpụkpụ (impacted), ịwa ahụ mmezi agba (orthognathic surgery), idozi ọkpụkpụ ihu gbajiri agbaji na iwepụ cyst agba.
Ndị nwere ezé nọ n'ime ọkpụkpụ, agba na-adabaghị nke ọma, mmerụ ihu ma ọ bụ cyst agba.
treatments.oral-maxillofacial-surgery.st: Otu ụbọchị maka ezé; ụbọchị 2 ruo 4 maka ịwa ahụ agba. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.oral-maxillofacial-surgery.re: Mgbe ịwa ahụ agba gasịrị, a chọrọ nri dị nro ihe dị ka izu 6.
treatments.back-pain-management.name: Nlekọta mgbu azụ (na-enweghị ịwa ahụ)
treatments.back-pain-management.summary: Ọgwụgwọ maka mgbu azụ na olu na-adịte aka site n'ịgba ọgwụ, nerve block na ọgwụgwọ, nke na-ezerekarị ịwa ahụ.
treatments.back-pain-management.what: Mgbe foto nyocha (scan) chọpụtara ihe kpatara ya, ọkachamara mgbu na-agba ọgwụ e duziri eduzi n'ọkpụkpụ azụ (epidural ma ọ bụ facet joint injection), nerve block ma ọ bụ ọgwụgwọ radiofrequency iji mee ka akwara na-egbu mgbu dajụọ, ya na atụmatụ physiotherapy.
treatments.back-pain-management.who: Ndị nwere mgbu azụ ma ọ bụ olu na-adịte aka, sciatica ma ọ bụ disc si n'ọnọdụ ya pụọ chọrọ izere ịwa ahụ ma ọ bụ ahụ ha esighị ike maka ya.
treatments.back-pain-management.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị nke ụbọchị ahụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.back-pain-management.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-eje ije pụọ n'otu ụbọchị ahụ. Ahụ efe nwere ike ịdị ọnwa, mmega ahụ na-emekwa ka ọ nọgide.
treatments.spinal-cord-stimulation.name: Mkpali eriri ọkpụkpụ azụ na akwara
treatments.spinal-cord-stimulation.summa: Obere ngwaọrụ a na-etinye n'ahụ nke na-ezigara eriri ọkpụkpụ azụ ma ọ bụ akwara mkpali eletrik dị nwayọọ iji gbochie mgbu ogologo oge.
treatments.spinal-cord-stimulation.what: A na-etinye waya dị gịrịgịrị nso n'eriri ọkpụkpụ azụ (ma ọ bụ akwara dị n'azụ isi, maka occipital nerve stimulation) ma jikọọ ha na obere batrị n'okpuru akpụkpọ ahụ. A na-ebu ụzọ nwalee ya iji hụ ma ọ̀ na-enyere aka.
treatments.spinal-cord-stimulation.who: Ndị nwere mgbu azụ ma ọ bụ ụkwụ ogologo oge mgbe ịwa ahụ ọkpụkpụ azụ gasịrị, mgbu akwara, ma ọ bụ isi ọwụwa siri ike nke ọgwụgwọ ndị ọzọ enyereghị aka.
treatments.spinal-cord-stimulation.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 1 ruo 2. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.spinal-cord-stimulation.recov: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'obere ọrụ n'ime izu 2 ma zere ihulata na ibuli ihe ihe dị ka izu 6.
Ịwa ahụ etuto, mmerụ na ọrịa nje ọkpụkpụ azụ
Ịwa ahụ iji wepụ etuto n'ọkpụkpụ azụ, dozie ọkpụkpụ azụ gbajiri agbaji, ma ọ bụ wepụ ọrịa nje, ya na nlekọta akwara n'oge ịwa ahụ.

Dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-ewepụ etuto ma ọ bụ anụ ahụ nwere ọrịa nje, ebe ọ dị mkpa, ọ na-eji mbọ (screw) na mkpanaka jide ọkpụkpụ azụ ka o guzosie ike. A na-elele akara eriri ọkpụkpụ azụ n'oge niile iji chebe mmegharị na mmetụta.
Ndị nwere etuto n'ime ma ọ bụ nso n'ọkpụkpụ azụ, ọkpụkpụ azụ gbajiri agbaji, ma ọ bụ ụkwara nta (tuberculosis) ọkpụkpụ azụ ma ọ bụ ọrịa nje ọzọ.
Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 5 ruo 10. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
Mgbake na-ewe izu ruo ọnwa, ya na physiotherapy. Ndị otu ahụ na-ahazi mweghachi ike ahụ tupu ị laa n'ụlọ.
treatments.hydrocephalus-treatment.name: Ọgwụgwọ hydrocephalus (VP shunt na ETV)
treatments.hydrocephalus-treatment.summa: Ọgwụgwọ maka mmiri na-agbakọ n'ụbụrụ, site n'iji shunt gbapụ ya ma ọ bụ iji endoscope meghee ụzọ ọhụrụ.
treatments.hydrocephalus-treatment.what: VP shunt bụ tube dị gịrịgịrị na-agbapụ mmiri karịrị akarị site n'ụbụrụ ruo n'afọ. N'endoscopic third ventriculostomy (ETV), a na-eji kamera mee obere oghere ka mmiri ahụ nwee ike ịgafe n'onwe ya.
treatments.hydrocephalus-treatment.who: Ụmụ ọhụrụ, ụmụaka na ndị okenye nwere hydrocephalus, site n'ọmụmụ, etuto, ọbara ọgbụgba ma ọ bụ ọrịa nje.
treatments.hydrocephalus-treatment.stay: Ihe dị ka ụbọchị 4 maka VP shunt: 1 n'ICU na 3 n'ụlọ ndị ọrịa na Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.hydrocephalus-treatment.recov: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 2 ruo 4.
treatments.botulinum-toxin-injections.na: Ịgba ọgwụ botulinum toxin maka akwara anụ ahụ siri ike na nsogbu mmegharị ahụ
treatments.botulinum-toxin-injections.su: Ịgba ọgwụ e duziri site na nyocha akwara anụ ahụ (EMG) iji mee ka akwara anụ ahụ siri ike ma ọ bụ na-arụ ọrụ karịa akarị dajụọ.
treatments.botulinum-toxin-injections.wh: Dọkịta akwara ozi (neurologist) na-anwale akwara anụ ahụ ndị na-arụ ọrụ karịa akarị, wee gbanye obere botulinum toxin n'ime ha. Mmetụta ya na-adị ihe dị ka ọnwa 3, enwekwara ike imeghachi ya.
Ndị nwere isi ike ahụ mgbe strok ma ọ bụ mmerụ ụbụrụ gasịrị, cerebral palsy, dystonia, ihu na-ama jijiji (facial spasm) ma ọ bụ migraine na-adịte aka.
treatments.botulinum-toxin-injections.st: Ọ dịghị ịnọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ: otu nleta n'ụlọ ọgwụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.botulinum-toxin-injections.re: Ọ dịghị oge mgbake. Mmetụta ya na-amalite n'ime izu 1 ruo 2.
treatments.foot-ankle-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ ụkwụ na nkwonkwo ụkwụ
treatments.foot-ankle-surgery.summary: Ịwa ahụ maka ọkpụkpụ ụkwụ na nkwonkwo ụkwụ gbajiri agbaji, mkpịsị ụkwụ gbagọrọ agbagọ dịka bunion, ụkwụ dị larịị (flat feet) na ụkwụ na-adịghị ike ma ọ bụ kpọnwụrụ akpọnwụ.
treatments.foot-ankle-surgery.what: Dabere na nsogbu ahụ, dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-eme ka ọkpụkpụ mkpịsị ụkwụ kwụ ọtọ, wughachi arch ụkwụ, rụzie akwara (tendon), were efere ma ọ bụ mbọ (screw) dozie ọkpụkpụ gbajiri agbaji, ma ọ bụ bufee akwara iji nyere ụkwụ na-ada ada aka.
treatments.foot-ankle-surgery.who: Ndị nwere ọkpụkpụ ụkwụ ma ọ bụ nkwonkwo ụkwụ gbajiri agbaji, bunion, hammer toes, ụkwụ dị larịị, foot drop ma ọ bụ ụkwụ gbagọrọ agbagọ n'ihi ahụ ikpọnwụ.
treatments.foot-ankle-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 1 ruo 3. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.foot-ankle-surgery.recovery: A na-eyi cast ma ọ bụ akpụkpọ ụkwụ pụrụ iche ihe dị ka izu 6. Mgbake zuru ezu na-ewe ọnwa 3 ruo 6.
treatments.diabetic-foot-care.name: Nlekọta ụkwụ ndị ọrịa shuga na ọnya na-adịte aka
treatments.diabetic-foot-care.summary: Ọgwụgwọ maka ọnya ụkwụ na ọnya na-anaghị ala, ọkachasị n'ime ndị nwere ọrịa shuga, iji zọpụta ụkwụ ahụ.
treatments.diabetic-foot-care.what: A na-asacha ọnya ahụ, wepụ anụ ahụ nwụrụ anwụ ma gwọọ ọrịa nje. A na-elele ọbara na-asọ, meekwa ka ọ ka mma ma ọ dị mkpa, a na-ejikwa ịkụnye akpụkpọ ahụ (skin graft) ma ọ bụ flap mechie ọnya ahụ. Akpụkpọ ụkwụ pụrụ iche na-enyere aka igbochi ọnya ọhụrụ.
treatments.diabetic-foot-care.who: Ndị nwere ọrịa shuga na ọnya ụkwụ, ọrịa nje ma ọ bụ ọnya na-anaghị ala ngwa ngwa, na onye ọ bụla nwere ọnya na-adịte aka.
treatments.diabetic-foot-care.stay: Site na nleta n'ụlọ ọgwụ ruo izu 1 ruo 2, dabere n'ọnya ahụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.diabetic-foot-care.recovery: Ọgwụgwọ na-ewe izu ruo ọnwa. Ịchịkwa shuga ọbara nke ọma na ilekọta ụkwụ dị oke mkpa.
treatments.limb-lengthening.name: Ime ka aka ma ọ bụ ụkwụ dị ogologo na mmezi ngbagọ
treatments.limb-lengthening.summary: Ịwa ahụ iji mee ka ụkwụ ma ọ bụ aka gbagọrọ agbagọ kwụ ọtọ, ma ọ bụ mee ka nke dị mkpụmkpụ dị ogologo, a na-eme ya nwayọọ nwayọọ site na frame ma ọ bụ ntu pụrụ iche.
treatments.limb-lengthening.what: A na-egbu ọkpụkpụ ahụ ma dọkasịa ya nwayọọ nwayọọ, ihe dị ka 1 mm kwa ụbọchị, site na frame dị n'èzí ma ọ bụ ntu dị n'ime, ka ọkpụkpụ ọhụrụ too n'oghere ahụ. Enwere ike ime ka ọkpụkpụ gbagọrọ agbagọ kwụ ọtọ n'otu ụzọ ahụ.
treatments.limb-lengthening.who: Ụmụaka na ndị okenye ogologo ụkwụ ha adịghị otu, ụkwụ gbagọrọ agbagọ (bowed legs ma ọ bụ knock knees), ma ọ bụ ngbagọ mgbe ọkpụkpụ gbajiri ma ọ bụ ọrịa nje gasịrị.
treatments.limb-lengthening.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 3 ruo 5. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.limb-lengthening.recovery: Ime ka ọ dị ogologo na-ewe ọnwa, ya na nlele mgbe niile na physiotherapy. Ndị otu ahụ na-eso gị hazie oge ya.
treatments.tendon-repair.name: Nrụzi na iwughachi akwara (tendon)
treatments.tendon-repair.summary: Ịwa ahụ iji kwachie ma ọ bụ wughachi akwara (tendon) dọwara adọwa n'aka, ụkwụ, ubu ma ọ bụ nkwonkwo ụkwụ.
treatments.tendon-repair.what: A na-akwakọta nsọtụ ndị dọwara adọwa, ma ọ bụ were akwara si n'akụkụ ahụ ọzọ wughachi ya. Ọgwụgwọ aka (hand therapy) ma ọ bụ physiotherapy na-eweghachi mmegharị.
treatments.tendon-repair.who: Ndị nwere akwara Achilles dọwara adọwa, akwara e bepụrụ n'aka, ma ọ bụ rotator cuff ma ọ bụ akwara ọzọ dọwara adọwa.
treatments.tendon-repair.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị nke ụbọchị ahụ ma ọ bụ abalị 1 ruo 2. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.tendon-repair.recovery: A na-eyi splint ma ọ bụ akpụkpọ ụkwụ pụrụ iche ihe dị ka izu 6. Ike zuru ezu na-alọghachi n'ime ọnwa 3 ruo 6.
treatments.revision-joint-replacement.su: Iji nke ọhụrụ dochie ikpere ma ọ bụ ukwu e mepụtara gbara agba, tọgbọrọ atọgbọ ma ọ bụ na-egbu mgbu.
treatments.revision-joint-replacement.wh: A na-ewepụ ihe ngbanwe ochie ahụ ma tinye nke ọhụrụ, mgbe ụfọdụ ya na ịkụnye ọkpụkpụ (bone graft) ma ọ bụ ihe ngbanwe pụrụ iche iji kwụọ ụgwọ ọkpụkpụ furu efu.
Ndị ngbanwe ikpere ma ọ bụ ukwu ha gbara agba, tọgbọrọ atọgbọ, butere ọrịa nje ma ọ bụ ka na-egbu mgbu.
treatments.revision-joint-replacement.st: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 5 ruo 7. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.revision-joint-replacement.re: Mgbake na-ewe ogologo oge karịa mgbe ngbanwe mbụ gasịrị, ọ na-abụkarị ọnwa 2 ruo 3, ya na physiotherapy.
treatments.fracture-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ ọkpụkpụ gbajiri agbaji na mmerụ ahụ
treatments.fracture-surgery.summary: Ịwa ahụ iji dozie ọkpụkpụ gbajiri agbaji site na efere, mbọ (screw), mkpanaka ma ọ bụ frame ka ha gwọọ kwụ ọtọ.
treatments.fracture-surgery.what: A na-ahazi iberibe ọkpụkpụ ahụ n'ahịrị ma were ihe igwe e tinyere n'ahụ jide ha. Enwekwara ike imezi ọkpụkpụ gbajiri agbaji siri ike ma ọ bụ ndị ochie gwọrọ n'ụzọ na-adịghị mma.
treatments.fracture-surgery.who: Ndị nwere ọkpụkpụ gbajiri agbaji, ọkpụkpụ gbajiri agbaji na-agwọbeghị (non-union), ma ọ bụ ọkpụkpụ gwọrọ n'ụzọ gbagọrọ agbagọ.
treatments.fracture-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 2 ruo 5. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.fracture-surgery.recovery: Ọkpụkpụ na-agwọkarị n'ime izu 6 ruo 12, ya na physiotherapy iji weghachi mmegharị.
treatments.nerve-decompression.name: Ịwa ahụ ịtọpụ akwara (carpal tunnel na ndị ọzọ)
treatments.nerve-decompression.summary: Ịwa ahụ iji tọpụ akwara a kpachiri akpachi, dịka na nkwonkwo aka na carpal tunnel syndrome, iji belata ịnwụ anwụ na mgbu.
treatments.nerve-decompression.what: A na-atọpụ eriri anụ ahụ siri ike na-apịkọ akwara ahụ site n'obere ọnya ma ọ bụ site n'obere oghere, na-enye akwara ahụ ohere.
treatments.nerve-decompression.who: Ndị nwere ịnwụ anwụ, ntụgharị ahụ ma ọ bụ adịghị ike n'ihi akwara a kpachiri akpachi na nkwonkwo aka, ikpere aka ma ọ bụ nkwonkwo ụkwụ.
treatments.nerve-decompression.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị nke ụbọchị ahụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.nerve-decompression.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-eji aka eme obere ihe n'ime ụbọchị ole na ole ma laghachi n'ọnọdụ nkịtị n'ime izu 4 ruo 6.
treatments.tavi.name: TAVI (ngbanwe aortic valve site na catheter)
treatments.tavi.summary: Aortic valve ọhụrụ a na-etinye site n'akwara ọbara dị n'ụkwụ, na-enweghị imeghe igbe obi.
treatments.tavi.what: A na-eduzi valvụ a pịrị apị nọ n'obere tube site n'ebe ukwu na apata ụkwụ zutere (groin) ruo n'obi ma meghee ya n'ime valvụ ochie dị warara.
treatments.tavi.who: Ndị nwere aortic stenosis siri ike, ọkachasị ndị agadi ma ọ bụ ndị nọ n'oké ihe ize ndụ site n'ịwa ahụ obi meghere emeghe.
treatments.tavi.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 3 ruo 5. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.tavi.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 1 ruo 2.
treatments.balloon-valvuloplasty.name: Balloon valvuloplasty
treatments.balloon-valvuloplasty.summary: Bọlụn a na-esi n'akwara ọbara tinye na-emeghe valvụ obi dị warara, na-enweghị ịwa ahụ.
treatments.balloon-valvuloplasty.what: A na-eduzi obere tube nwere bọlụn ruo na valvụ dị warara ma fụọ ya ikuku iji mee ka o saa mbara.
treatments.balloon-valvuloplasty.who: Ụmụaka na ndị okenye nwere mitral, pulmonary ma ọ bụ aortic valve dị warara, nke na-esitekarị n'ọrịa obi rheumatic ma ọ bụ ntụpọ ọmụmụ.
treatments.balloon-valvuloplasty.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 1 ruo 2. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.balloon-valvuloplasty.recover: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime otu izu.
treatments.vascular-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ aortic aneurysm na akwara ọbara
treatments.vascular-surgery.summary: Ịwa ahụ ma ọ bụ stent graft iji rụzie akwara ọbara bụ isi zara aza ma ọ bụ e gbochiri, dịka aortic aneurysm.
treatments.vascular-surgery.what: A na-eji stent graft a na-esi n'ebe ukwu na apata ụkwụ zutere (groin) tinye (EVAR ma ọ bụ TEVAR) mee ka akụkụ aorta na-adịghị ike, zara aza sie ike, ma ọ bụ dochie ya n'ịwa ahụ meghere emeghe. Enwekwara ike ime ka akwara ọbara e gbochiri n'olu na ụkwụ dị ọcha ma ọ bụ gafee ha.
treatments.vascular-surgery.who: Ndị nwere aortic aneurysm ma ọ bụ dissection, akwara ọbara olu (carotid) dị warara, ma ọ bụ akwara ọbara ụkwụ e gbochiri nke ukwuu.
treatments.vascular-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 2 ruo 4 site na stent graft; ụbọchị 7 ruo 10 mgbe ịwa ahụ meghere emeghe gasịrị. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.vascular-surgery.recovery: Site n'izu 2 mgbe stent graft gasịrị ruo izu 6 ruo 8 mgbe ịwa ahụ meghere emeghe gasịrị.
treatments.lung-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ ngụgụ (site n'obere oghere na nke meghere emeghe)
treatments.lung-surgery.summary: Iwepụ akụkụ ngụgụ maka kansa, cyst ma ọ bụ ọrịa nje, nke a na-emekarị site n'obere oghere (VATS) ma ọ bụ site na robot.
treatments.lung-surgery.what: A na-ewepụ otu akụkụ, lobe ma ọ bụ, ọ dịkarịghị, ngụgụ dum. Ịwa ahụ site n'obere oghere na-eji obere ọnya n'etiti ọkpụkpụ ọgịrịga, ya na mgbake dị ngwa.
treatments.lung-surgery.who: Ndị nwere kansa ngụgụ, cyst ngụgụ, ngụgụ mebiri emebi site n'ọrịa nje ma ọ bụ ụkwara nta (tuberculosis), ma ọ bụ ngụgụ dara ada na-alọghachi ugboro ugboro.
treatments.lung-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 4 ruo 7. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.lung-surgery.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 4 ruo 6. Mmega iku ume na-enyere aka.
treatments.lung-transplant.name: Ntụgharị ngụgụ
treatments.lung-transplant.summary: Iji ngụgụ dị mma sitere n'aka onye nwụrụ anwụ dochie otu ma ọ bụ ngụgụ abụọ na-ada ada.
treatments.lung-transplant.what: A na-ewepụ ngụgụ rịara ọrịa ma jikọọ ngụgụ onye nyere ya na ọkpọ ikuku na akwara ọbara. A na-aṅụ ọgwụ mgbochi ịjụ akụkụ ahụ ndụ niile.
treatments.lung-transplant.who: Ndị nwere ọrịa ngụgụ nke ọkwa ikpeazụ, dịka pulmonary fibrosis ma ọ bụ COPD siri ike, nke ọgwụgwọ ndị ọzọ na-enweghị ike inyere aka.
treatments.lung-transplant.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị izu 3 ruo 4 n'ụlọ ọgwụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.lung-transplant.recovery: Mee atụmatụ ịnọ n'India ihe dị ka ọnwa 3 maka nlele siri ike na mweghachi ike ahụ.
treatments.poem.name: POEM maka achalasia (endoscopic myotomy)
treatments.poem.summary: Usoro a na-esi n'ọnụ eme nke na-eme ka akwara anụ ahụ ọkpọ nri siri ike dajụọ ka nri nwee ike ịgafe ọzọ, na-enweghị ọnya ọ bụla n'ahụ.
treatments.poem.what: N'iji endoscope, dọkịta na-eme ọwara n'ime mgbidi ọkpọ nri ma bepụ akwara anụ ahụ siri ike dị na nsọtụ ala ya.
treatments.poem.who: Ndị nwere achalasia na nsogbu ilo nri ndị ọzọ ebe nri na-araparakwa n'obi akpa.
treatments.poem.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 2 ruo 3. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.poem.recovery: Nri mmiri mmiri, wee nri dị nro ihe dị ka izu 2. Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime otu izu.
treatments.capsule-endoscopy.name: Capsule endoscopy na endoscopy obere eriri afọ
treatments.capsule-endoscopy.summary: Kapsụl kamera a na-elo, ma ọ bụ endoscope dị ogologo, iji lee ime obere eriri afọ ebe scope nkịtị na-enweghị ike iru.
treatments.capsule-endoscopy.what: Na capsule endoscopy, ị na-elo kamera hà ka mkpụrụ ọgwụ nke na-ese foto ka ọ na-agafe. Balloon ma ọ bụ spiral enteroscopy na-eji scope dị ogologo ele anya ma gwọọ, dịka ịkwụsị ọbara ọgbụgba.
treatments.capsule-endoscopy.who: Ndị nwere ọbara ọgbụgba ma ọ bụ ụkọ ọbara (anaemia) a na-amaghị ihe kpatara ya, a na-enyo enyo na ha nwere ọrịa Crohn, ma ọ bụ etuto obere eriri afọ.
treatments.capsule-endoscopy.stay: Ọ dịghị ịnọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ maka kapsụl; otu ụbọchị ma ọ bụ otu abalị maka enteroscopy. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.capsule-endoscopy.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'otu ụbọchị ahụ ma ọ bụ n'echi ya.
treatments.endoscopic-sleeve-gastroplast: Ime ka afọ dị obere site n'akwa a na-esi n'ọnụ eme, maka ibelata ibu na-enweghị ọnya.
N'okpuru ọgwụ mgbochi mgbu (anaesthetic), a na-etinye endoscope n'afọ, akwa na-apịaji ya ka ọ ghọọ tube dị warara, ka ị na-afọ afọ ngwa ngwa.
Ndị buru oke ibu na-achọghị, ma ọ bụ na-ezughị ọnọdụ maka, ịwa ahụ ibelata ibu.
Ọ na-abụkarị otu abalị. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
Nri mmiri mmiri, wee nri dị nro ruo izu ole na ole. Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ n'ime otu izu.
treatments.splenectomy.name: Iwepụ spleen (splenectomy)
treatments.splenectomy.summary: Iwepụ spleen site n'obere oghere, maka ọrịa ọbara, mmerụ ahụ ma ọ bụ spleen tooro eto.
treatments.splenectomy.what: A na-ewepụ spleen site n'obere ọnya. A na-enye ọgwụ mgbochi (vaccine) tupu ma ọ bụ mgbe e mechara iji chebe gị pụọ n'ọrịa nje.
treatments.splenectomy.who: Ndị nwere ụfọdụ ọrịa ọbara (dịka ITP ma ọ bụ thalassaemia), spleen tooro eto ma ọ bụ merụrụ emerụ, ma ọ bụ cyst ma ọ bụ etuto na spleen.
treatments.splenectomy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 2 ruo 4. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.splenectomy.recovery: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 2 ruo 4.
treatments.paediatric-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ ụmụaka (ịwa ahụ ụmụaka na ụmụ ọhụrụ)
treatments.paediatric-surgery.summary: Ịwa ahụ maka ụmụ ọhụrụ na ụmụaka, site na hernia na ntụpọ ọmụmụ ruo n'ịwa ahụ obi akpa, eriri afọ na imeju siri ike.
treatments.paediatric-surgery.what: Ndị dọkịta na-awa ahụ ụmụaka na-agwọ ọrịa dị mgbe a mụrụ nwa na n'oge nwata, nke a na-emekarị site n'obere oghere ma ọ bụ site na robot dabara n'obere ahụ, ya na ICU ụmụaka dị njikere.
treatments.paediatric-surgery.who: Ụmụ ọhụrụ na ụmụaka nwere ntụpọ ọmụmụ nke eriri afọ, ọkpọ nri, ngụgụ ma ọ bụ akụrụ, hernia, mkpụrụ amụ na-arịdatabeghị, ma ọ bụ etuto.
treatments.paediatric-surgery.stay: Site n'otu ụbọchị ruo izu 2, dabere n'ịwa ahụ ahụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.paediatric-surgery.recovery: Ụmụaka na-agbakekarị ngwa ngwa. Dọkịta na-awa ahụ ga-enye atụmatụ maka nwa gị.
treatments.myomectomy.name: Myomectomy (iwepụ fibroid, na-echekwa akpanwa)
treatments.myomectomy.summary: Iwepụ fibroid ma na-echekwa akpanwa, site n'obere oghere, robot ma ọ bụ ịwa ahụ meghere emeghe.
treatments.myomectomy.what: A na-ebepụ fibroid ọ bụla ma kwachie akpanwa ahụ, ka ime n'ọdịnihu ka kwe omume.
treatments.myomectomy.who: Ụmụ nwanyị nwere fibroid na-ebute oke nsọ nwanyị, mgbu, nrụgide ma ọ bụ nsogbu ịtụrụ ime, ndị chọrọ ichekwa akpanwa ha.
treatments.myomectomy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 1 ruo 3. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.myomectomy.recovery: Ọtụtụ ụmụ nwanyị na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 2 ruo 6.
treatments.hysteroscopy.name: Hysteroscopy (iwepụ polyp na fibroid n'ime akpanwa)
treatments.hysteroscopy.summary: Kamera dị gịrịgịrị a na-esi n'ọnụ akpanwa (cervix) tinye iji lee ime akpanwa ma wepụ polyp, obere fibroid ma ọ bụ anụ ọnya.
treatments.hysteroscopy.what: A naghị ebe ọnya. Site na kamera ahụ, dọkịta nwere ike iwere ihe nlele, wepụ polyp ma ọ bụ fibroid, ma ọ bụ coil furu efu.
treatments.hysteroscopy.who: Ụmụ nwanyị nwere oke ọbara ọgbụgba ma ọ bụ nke na-adịghị n'usoro, ọbara ọgbụgba mgbe nsọ nwanyị kwụsịrị (menopause), polyp, ma ọ bụ nsogbu ịtụrụ ime.
treatments.hysteroscopy.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị nke ụbọchị ahụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.hysteroscopy.recovery: Ọtụtụ ụmụ nwanyị na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime ụbọchị 1 ruo 2.
treatments.prolapse-repair.name: Nrụzi pelvic organ prolapse
treatments.prolapse-repair.summary: Ịwa ahụ iji bulie ma kwado akpanwa, eriri afọ mamịrị ma ọ bụ eriri afọ dabara ada n'ime ọtụ.
treatments.prolapse-repair.what: A na-arụzi ihe nkwado ndị na-adịghị ike site n'ọtụ ma ọ bụ site n'obere oghere, mgbe ụfọdụ ya na hysterectomy.
treatments.prolapse-repair.who: Ụmụ nwanyị na-enwe mmetụta ihe zara aza ma ọ bụ ịdị arọ, ma ọ bụ nsogbu eriri afọ mamịrị ma ọ bụ eriri afọ site na prolapse.
treatments.prolapse-repair.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 1 ruo 3. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.prolapse-repair.recovery: Zere ibuli ihe dị arọ ihe dị ka izu 6.
treatments.vaginal-reconstruction.name: Ịwa ahụ nrụzi ọtụ na labiaplasty
treatments.vaginal-reconstruction.summar: Ịwa ahụ iji rụzie ma ọ bụ kpụgharịa ọtụ na egbugbere ọtụ (labia), mgbe ịmụ nwa ma ọ bụ mmerụ ahụ gasịrị ma ọ bụ maka ahụ iru ala.
treatments.vaginal-reconstruction.what: A na-arụzi ma mee ka anụ ahụ gbatịrị agbatị ma ọ bụ dọwara adọwa dị mkpa, ma ọ bụ kpụgharịa egbugbere ọtụ, n'okpuru ọgwụ mgbochi mgbu (anaesthetic).
treatments.vaginal-reconstruction.who: Ụmụ nwanyị nwere mmebi mgbe ịmụ nwa gasịrị, fistula, ahụ erughị ala, ma ọ bụ nchegbu gbasara ọdịdị.
treatments.vaginal-reconstruction.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị nke ụbọchị ahụ ma ọ bụ otu abalị. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.vaginal-reconstruction.recove: Ọtụtụ ụmụ nwanyị na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 1 ruo 2; zere mmekọ nwoke na nwanyị ihe dị ka izu 6.
treatments.high-risk-pregnancy-care.name: Nlekọta ime dị ize ndụ na ịmụ nwa
treatments.high-risk-pregnancy-care.summ: Nlekọta nso maka ime nwere ihe ize ndụ ọzọ, na ịmụ nwa a haziri ahazi ya na ICU dị njikere maka nne na nwa.
treatments.high-risk-pregnancy-care.what: Ndị dọkịta ime (obstetricians) na-elekọta ma gwọọ ọnọdụ dịka ọbara mgbali elu, ọrịa shuga n'oge ime, ejima ma ọ bụ nwa na-adịghị eto nke ọma, ma hazie ịmụ nwa n'ụzọ nchekwa site n'ọtụ ma ọ bụ site na caesarean, ya na ICU ụmụ ọhụrụ.
treatments.high-risk-pregnancy-care.who: Ụmụ nwanyị dị ime ejima, nwere pre-eclampsia, ọrịa shuga n'oge ime, ime mebiri emebi n'oge gara aga ma ọ bụ ihe ize ndụ ndị ọzọ.
treatments.high-risk-pregnancy-care.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 2 ruo 4 mgbe ịmụ nwa gasịrị. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.high-risk-pregnancy-care.reco: Ndị otu ahụ na-ahazi nlele maka nne na nwa mgbe a mụsịrị nwa.
treatments.vulvar-cancer-surgery.name: Ịwa ahụ kansa vulva (vulvectomy)
treatments.vulvar-cancer-surgery.summary: Iwepụ kansa vulva, ya na lymph node si n'ebe ukwu na apata ụkwụ zutere (groin) ebe ọ dị mkpa.
treatments.vulvar-cancer-surgery.what: A na-ewepụ akụkụ (hemivulvectomy) ma ọ bụ vulva dum (radical vulvectomy) ya na oke anụ ahụ dị mma, a na-ewughachikwa ebe ahụ ebe ọ dị mkpa.
treatments.vulvar-cancer-surgery.who: Ụmụ nwanyị nwere kansa vulva ma ọ bụ ụfọdụ ihe na-achọ ịghọ kansa.
treatments.vulvar-cancer-surgery.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 3 ruo 7. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.vulvar-cancer-surgery.recover: Ọtụtụ ụmụ nwanyị na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 4 ruo 8.
treatments.reconstructive-urology.name: Urology nrụzi (urethral stricture na ndị ọzọ)
treatments.reconstructive-urology.summar: Ịwa ahụ iji rụzie ọwa mamịrị (urethra) dị warara ma ọ bụ wughachi ụzọ mamịrị mgbe mmerụ ahụ ma ọ bụ ịwa ahụ gara aga gasịrị.
treatments.reconstructive-urology.what: A na-emeghe akụkụ dị warara ahụ ma ọ bụ were anụ ahụ si n'ọnụ ma ọ bụ ebe ọzọ dochie ya, ka mamịrị nwee ike ịsọpụta nke ọma ọzọ.
treatments.reconstructive-urology.who: Ụmụ nwoke na ụmụ nwanyị nwere urethral stricture, mmerụ ụzọ mamịrị, ma ọ bụ nsogbu mgbe ịwa ahụ gara aga gasịrị.
treatments.reconstructive-urology.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 2 ruo 5. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.reconstructive-urology.recove: Catheter na-anọ izu 1 ruo 3. Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọnọdụ nkịtị n'ime izu 4 ruo 6.
Ịwa ahụ maka mamịrị na-agbapụ n'onwe ya
Ọgwụgwọ maka mamịrị na-agbapụ, site na sling na ịgba ọgwụ ruo n'ịwa ahụ eriri afọ mamịrị.

Maka mamịrị na-agbapụ n'oge nrụgide, sling na-akwado urethra. Maka eriri afọ mamịrị na-arụ ọrụ karịa akarị, ọgwụ, ịgba Botox n'ime eriri afọ mamịrị ma ọ bụ mkpali akwara na-enyere aka. Bladder augmentation na-eme ka eriri afọ mamịrị dị obere buo ibu.
Ụmụ nwanyị na ụmụ nwoke mamịrị na-agbapụ mgbe ha na-akwa ụkwara ma ọ bụ na-achị ọchị, ma ọ bụ ndị na-enwe agụụ mberede ịgba mamịrị.
Ọ na-abụkarị nke ụbọchị ahụ ma ọ bụ otu abalị. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-alaghachi n'ọrụ nkịtị n'ime izu 1 ruo 2.
treatments.paediatric-urology.name: Ịwa ahụ urology ụmụaka
treatments.paediatric-urology.summary: Ịwa ahụ maka nsogbu akụrụ, eriri afọ mamịrị na akụkụ nzuzo ụmụaka, nke a na-emekarị site n'obere oghere ma ọ bụ site na robot.
treatments.paediatric-urology.what: Ndị dọkịta na-awa ahụ na-edozi akụrụ e gbochiri, mamịrị na-asọghachi n'akụrụ (reflux), mkpụrụ amụ na-arịdatabeghị, hypospadias na ọnọdụ ndị ọzọ ụmụaka ji amụ.
treatments.paediatric-urology.who: Ụmụ ọhụrụ na ụmụaka nwere hydronephrosis, reflux, hypospadias, mkpụrụ amụ na-arịdatabeghị ma ọ bụ nsogbu eriri afọ mamịrị.
treatments.paediatric-urology.stay: Ọ na-abụkarị site n'otu ụbọchị ruo ụbọchị 3. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.burn-reconstruction.name: Ọgwụgwọ ọkụ gbara na nrụzi ntụpọ ọnya ọkụ
treatments.burn-reconstruction.summary: Nlekọta maka ọkụ gbara ọhụrụ na ịwa ahụ iji tọpụ ntụpọ ọnya ọkụ siri ike ma weghachi mmegharị na ọdịdị.
treatments.burn-reconstruction.what: Ịkụnye akpụkpọ ahụ (skin graft) na flap na-ekpuchi ebe ọkụ gbara. Maka ọkụ gbara n'oge gara aga, a na-atọpụ ntụpọ ọnya siri ike na-egbochi mmegharị ma wughachi akpụkpọ ahụ, ya na laser na ọgwụgwọ nrụgide iji mee ka ntụpọ ọnya ka mma.
treatments.burn-reconstruction.who: Ndị ọkụ gbara n'oge na-adịbeghị anya, ma ọ bụ ndị nwere ntụpọ ọnya ọkụ ochie siri ike, na-egbu mgbu ma ọ bụ na-egbochi mmegharị.
treatments.burn-reconstruction.stay: Site n'otu ụbọchị ruo ọtụtụ izu, dabere n'ọkụ gbara ahụ. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.burn-reconstruction.recovery: Nlekọta ntụpọ ọnya na ọgwụgwọ na-aga n'ihu ruo ọnwa.
treatments.facial-palsy-reconstruction.s: Ịwa ahụ iji weghachi mmegharị na nhazi ziri ezi n'ihu nke mmebi akwara mere ka ọ ghara ike.
treatments.facial-palsy-reconstruction.w: Ịkwaga akwara ozi, ịkwaga akwara anụ ahụ site na microsurgery na sling na-anaghị emegharị na-enyere aka iweghachi ọchị, imechi anya na ihu dị n'usoro.
Ndị ihu ha kpọnwụrụ akpọnwụ site na Bell's palsy na-agbakeghị, ịwa ahụ, mmerụ ahụ ma ọ bụ ọmụmụ.
treatments.facial-palsy-reconstruction.s: Ọ na-abụkarị ụbọchị 2 ruo 5. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.facial-palsy-reconstruction.r: Mmegharị na-aka mma nwayọọ nwayọọ n'ime ọnwa 6 ruo 12, ya na ọgwụgwọ ihu.
treatments.skin-laser-treatments.name: Ọgwụgwọ akpụkpọ ahụ, ntụpọ ọnya na laser (dermatology)
treatments.skin-laser-treatments.summary: Laser na obere usoro maka ntụpọ ọnya ntụpọ ihu (acne), ntụpọ ojii (moles), warts, obere akpụ akpụkpọ ahụ, vitiligo na ntutu na-akwọ n'ebe ụfọdụ.
treatments.skin-laser-treatments.what: Ọgwụgwọ gụnyere CO2 laser na dermabrasion maka ntụpọ ọnya acne, radiocautery iji wepụ ihe tọrọ eto, ịwa ahụ mbọ, na ọgwụgwọ maka vitiligo na alopecia areata.
treatments.skin-laser-treatments.who: Ndị nwere ntụpọ ọnya acne, ihe tọrọ eto a na-achọghị, vitiligo, ntutu na-akwọ n'ebe ụfọdụ ma ọ bụ nchegbu akpụkpọ ahụ ndị ọzọ.
treatments.skin-laser-treatments.stay: Ọ dịghị ịnọ n'ụlọ ọgwụ: oge n'ụlọ ọgwụ a na-abịa ma laa. Ụlọ ọgwụ gị ga-akwado ya maka okwu gị.
treatments.skin-laser-treatments.recover: Ọcha ọbara ọbara na-ebelatakarị n'ime ụbọchị ole na ole ruo izu 2.

hospitals.kenia-eye.overview: Ụlọ ọgwụ anya ọkachamara dị na Santacruz, Mumbai, nke na-elekọta ndị ọrịa kemgbe 1998. Dr. Vaishal Kenia, dọkịta na-awa cataract na ndozi ọhụhụ (refractive), na-edu ya, yana otu ndị dọkịta na ndị ndụmọdụ na-ekpuchi akụkụ ọ bụla nke nlekọta anya. A kwadoro ya maka ịkụnye cornea, o nwekwara laser FEMTO Z8 NEO na-enweghị mma, nke mbụ na Western India, yana igwe nyocha dị elu dịka IOL Master 700, Pentacam, Verion na onyonyo retina OPTOS sara mbara nke ukwuu. Ọ na-agwọ ihe niile site na cataract na LASIK ruo na cornea, glaucoma, retina, anya ngọngọ na nsogbu nkpuchi anya. Kenia Dental Clinic, nke Dr. Pallavi Kenia na-elekọta, dị n'otu ụlọ ahụ.

hospitals.wockhardt-mumbai-central.overv: Isi ụlọ ọgwụ Wockhardt Hospitals dị na South Mumbai. Wockhardt Hospitals bụ otu ụlọ ọgwụ kacha ukwuu na-enye nlekọta dị elu n'ọtụtụ ngalaba ọgwụ n'ọdịda anyanwụ India, nwere ụlọ ọgwụ 5 na ihe ndina 1,050. Ụlọ ọgwụ a bụ ụlọ elu nwere okpukpu 20, nwere ihe ndina 350, ihe ndina 100 maka nlekọta pụrụ iche, ụlọ ịwa ahụ 8 nke e ji ngwa ọgbara ọhụrụ wuo, ụlọ nyocha obi (cath lab) abụọ, ngalaba obi ụmụaka kacha ukwuu na South Mumbai na nnukwu ngalaba ihe mberede. N'ime afọ 11 gara aga, otu ahụ agwọọla ihe karịrị ndị ọrịa 63,000 si n'ihe karịrị mba 100, ọtụtụ ndị dọkịta ya gụkwara akwụkwọ ma ọ bụ rụọ ọrụ na US, UK na Europe. N'ụlọ ọgwụ ya niile, ha na-eme ntụgharị akụrụ, imeju na ụmị ọkpụkpụ, ha debekwara ihe ndina 27 n'ime ihe ndina 300 nlekọta pụrụ iche ha maka ndị ọrịa ntụgharị, ha na-emekwa ịgbanwe ikpere na úkwù site na robot, deep brain stimulation na TAVI.

posts.bilateral-hand-transplant-nanavati: Ịkụnye aka abụọ weghachiri nwa okorobịa dị afọ 18 aka ya
Otu nwa okorobịa onye ọrụ ugbo nke tụfuru aka ya abụọ n'ihe mberede natara aka abụọ e nyere n'onyinye n'ịwa ahụ were awa 13 na Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital, Mumbai.
Na Jenụwarị 2024, nwa nwoke onye ọrụ ugbo dị afọ 18 si Gujarat tụfuru aka ya abụọ n'ihe mberede igwe ọrụ ugbo. Mmerụ ahụ ahụ siri ike nke ukwuu idozi, a ghaghịkwa ibepụ aka abụọ ahụ.
Mgbe nyocha ahụike, nke uche na nke usoro mgbochi ọrịa zuru ezu gasịrị, ndị dọkịta kpebiri na ọ dabara maka ịkụnye aka abụọ. Aka onyinye dị ụkọ, ha ga-ekwekọrịta nke ọma, ya mere o chere ọnwa 13.

Na Jenụwarị 2026, ezinụlọ otu nwanyị dị afọ 50 nwụrụ na Surat kwetara inye akụkụ ahụ ya n'onyinye. Ngụgụ ya, imeju ya na cornea ya gara n'aka ndị ọrịa na Mumbai na Surat, aka ya abụọ gakwara n'aka ya. Ndị otu na Gujarat na Maharashtra rụkọrọ ọrụ ọnụ iji bubata aka ndị ahụ na Mumbai n'obere oge dịnụ.

Ịwa ahụ ahụ mere n'abalị 9 ruo 10 Jenụwarị 2026, nke Dr Nilesh Satbhai, Director nke Ịwa Ahụ Plastik, Microsurgery Iwughachi Ahụ na Ịkụnye Aka, duru. N'ime awa 13, ndị otu ahụ jikọrọ ọkpụkpụ, jikọọ akwara ọbara niile, dozie eriri akwara (tendon), jikọọ akwara ozi ma mechie akpụkpọ ahụ. Ọbara banyere n'aka abụọ ahụ ozugbo e jikọrọ akwara ọbara.

Mgbe e mechara, otu ndị nlekọta lekọtara ya, ndị jikwara ọgwụ iji gbochie ahụ ịjụ aka ndị ahụ, lekọta ọbara na-eru ha nke ọma, gbochie ọrịa nje ma malite ọgwụgwọ mgbake n'oge. Ọ bụ ịkụnye aka abụọ mbụ na Nanavati Max.

Ịkụnye aka siri ike karịa ịkụnye akụkụ ahụ dị n'ime, n'ihi na ọ na-ebufe akpụkpọ ahụ, anụ ahụ, eriri akwara, ọkpụkpụ, akwara ọbara na akwara ozi ọnụ, ahụ na-ajụkwa akpụkpọ ahụ ọzọ nke ukwuu. Mgbe ọ rụrụ ọrụ, ọ nwere ike iweghachi mmetụta na mmegharị a haziri ahazi nke aka arụrụ arụ na-enweghị ike inye.
Ọ bụrụ na gị ma ọ bụ onye n'ezinụlọ gị atụfuola aka ma ọ bụ ogwe aka, ziga anyị akụkọ ahụike ya. Ọkachamara ga-agwa gị ma ịkụnye ma ọ bụ iwughachi nwere ike inyere aka.
Onye ọrịa ahụ na ndị dọkịta, ndị nọọsụ na ndị ọrụ Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital lekọtara ya
Max Healthcare: Ịkụnye aka abụọ site n'aka nwanyị nyere onyinye gaa n'aka nwoke natara ya
posts.thumb-reconstruction-toddler-nanav: A mụrụ ya na-enweghị isi mkpịsị aka: otu ndị dọkịta na-awa ahụ siri wughachi ijide aka nwatakịrị
Nwa nwanyị ọhụrụ a mụrụ nwere nnukwu nkwarụ isi mkpịsị aka n'aka abụọ nwere ike ijide ma jigide ihe ugbu a, mgbe ịwa ahụ abụọ gasịrị na Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital, Mumbai.

A mụrụ otu nwatakịrị nwanyị na-enweghị isi mkpịsị aka ekpe, isi mkpịsị aka nri ya etozughịkwa nke ọ ga-eji ya. Na-enweghị isi mkpịsị aka na-arụ ọrụ, nwatakịrị na-enwe nsogbu ịmụta ijide, ịkpachi na ijigide ihe.

Dr Nilesh G Satbhai, Director nke Ịwa Ahụ Plastik, Microsurgery Iwughachi Ahụ na Ịkụnye Aka, na ndị otu ya haziri ịwa ahụ abụọ. Akwara ọbara na akwara ozi ya dị nnọọ ntakịrị, nke mere ka ọrụ ahụ chọọ nlezianya, ebe ọ bụkwa na aka abụọ metụtara, ịwa ahụ abụọ ahụ ga-aga nke ọma.

Ịwa ahụ mbụ, na Disemba 2025, mere ka isi mkpịsị aka nri na-esighị ike guzosie ike ma bufee otu anụ ahụ site n'ọbụ aka ya ka isi mkpịsị aka ahụ wee nwee ike ịtụgharị ma metụ mkpịsị aka ndị ọzọ. N'ime izu ole na ole, ọ malitere iji ya.

Nke abụọ, na Febụwarị 2026, wuru isi mkpịsị aka ekpe ọhụrụ site n'ibufe mkpịsị ụkwụ nke abụọ site n'ụkwụ ekpe ya gaa n'aka ya ma jikọọ akwara ọbara ya, akwara ozi ya na eriri akwara ya n'okpuru maịkrọskop. Ndị dọkịta na-awa ahụ wughachikwara ụkwụ ahụ ka ọ nọgide na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma.
Mgbe ọ dị ọnwa 13, ọ nwere ike ijide mkpịsị aka nne na nna ya. Ịwa ahụ dị otu a na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma n'oge, mgbe nwatakịrị ka na-amụta iji aka ya.
Ọ bụrụ na a mụrụ nwa gị nwere aka dị iche, ziga anyị foto na akụkọ ahụike ọ bụla. Ọkachamara ga-adụ ọdụ ihe a pụrụ ime na mgbe a ga-eme ya.

bodyAreas.pelvis.hint: Nsogbu ịtụrụ ime, fibroid, cyst ma ọ bụ oke ọbara ọgbụgba, nsogbu prostate ma ọ bụ eriri afọ mamịrị, ma ọ bụ kansa akpanwa, akpa nwa, ọnụ akpanwa, eriri afọ mamịrị, prostate ma ọ bụ mkpụrụ amụ.

bodyAreas.hips.hint: Mgbu ukwu, isi ike, cartilage ukwu dọwara adọwa ma ọ bụ nkwonkwo ukwu gbara agba.
bodyAreas.knees.name: Ikpere
bodyAreas.knees.hint: Mgbu ikpere site na arthritis, ligament ma ọ bụ meniscus dọwara adọwa, ma ọ bụ cartilage mebiri emebi mgbe mmerụ ahụ egwuregwu gasịrị.
bodyAreas.legs.name: Ụkwụ
bodyAreas.legs.hint: Varicose veins, mgbu ụkwụ mgbe a na-eje ije, mmerụ nkwonkwo ụkwụ, etuto ọkpụkpụ, ụkwụ merụrụ ahụ nke ukwuu, ma ọ bụ ụkwụ zara aza.
bodyAreas.feet.name: Nkwonkwo ụkwụ na ụkwụ
bodyAreas.feet.hint: Mgbu nkwonkwo ụkwụ ma ọ bụ ụkwụ, ụkwụ gbagọrọ agbagọ na-anaghị ala, bunion ma ọ bụ mkpịsị ụkwụ gbagọrọ agbagọ, ụkwụ dị larịị, foot drop, ma ọ bụ ọnya ụkwụ ọrịa shuga.
bodyAreas.hands.name: Ogwe aka na aka
bodyAreas.hands.hint: Mgbu ma ọ bụ isi ike ubu, ikpere aka ma ọ bụ nkwonkwo aka, akwara ubu dọwara adọwa, aka merụrụ ahụ ma ọ bụ kwụ ọtọ, adịghị ike ogwe aka mgbe mmerụ akwara gasịrị, ma ọ bụ ogwe aka zara aza.
wholeBody.cancer.name: Kansa, ebe ọ bụla
wholeBody.cancer.hint: Ọgwụgwọ kansa n'ebe ọ bụla ọ dị n'ahụ. Ndị dọkịta na-ejikọkarị ha ọnụ.
wholeBody.blood.name: Ọbara na bone marrow
wholeBody.blood.hint: Kansa ọbara dịka leukaemia, lymphoma na myeloma, nsogbu ọbara dịka thalassaemia, na kansa n'ụmụaka.
wholeBody.skin.name: Akpụkpọ ahụ, ntụpọ ọnya na ọkụ gbara
wholeBody.skin.hint: Kansa akpụkpọ ahụ, ntụpọ ọnya acne, ọkụ gbara na ntụpọ ọnya ọkụ, ọnya na-anaghị ala, ma ọ bụ vitiligo.
wholeBody.children.name: Ụmụaka
wholeBody.children.hint: Ịwa ahụ na ọgwụgwọ e mere maka ụmụ ọhụrụ na ụmụaka.
